        'Saint Noble'
      ]
    )[1 + ((na.global_sequence - 1) % 844)] as name,
    lpad(na.comp_sequence::text, 3, '0') as climber_number,
    (
      array[
        'NB','NS','PE','NL','QC','ON','MB','SK','AB','BC','YT','NT'
      ]
    )[1 + (((na.global_sequence - 1) * 5) % 12)] as province,
    na.category_id,
    na.gender_division,
    na.age_group,
    na.display_name as display_category,
    case
      when na.slug = 'spring-send-recreational' and na.age_group in ('Rec', 'Masters') then
        (
          select csb.id
          from public.competition_schedule_blocks csb
          where csb.competition_id = na.competition_id
            and csb.label = 'Rec / Masters Session'
          limit 1
        )
      when na.slug = 'spring-send-recreational' and na.age_group = 'Open' then
        (
          select csb.id
          from public.competition_schedule_blocks csb
          where csb.competition_id = na.competition_id
            and csb.label = 'Open Session'
          limit 1
        )
      when na.slug = 'spring-send-youth' and na.age_group in ('Youth D', 'Youth C') then
        (
          select csb.id
          from public.competition_schedule_blocks csb
          where csb.competition_id = na.competition_id
            and csb.label = 'Youth D / Youth C Wave'
          limit 1
        )
      when na.slug = 'spring-send-youth' and na.age_group in ('Youth B', 'Youth A') then
        (
          select csb.id
          from public.competition_schedule_blocks csb
          where csb.competition_id = na.competition_id
            and csb.label = 'Youth B / Youth A Wave'
          limit 1
        )
      when na.slug = 'spring-send-youth' and na.age_group = 'Junior' then
        (
          select csb.id
          from public.competition_schedule_blocks csb
          where csb.competition_id = na.competition_id
            and csb.label = 'Junior Wave'
          limit 1
        )
      when na.slug = 'mock-rec-scramble-live' and na.age_group in ('Rec', 'Masters') then
        (
          select csb.id
          from public.competition_schedule_blocks csb
          where csb.competition_id = na.competition_id
            and csb.label = 'Rec / Masters Session'
          limit 1
        )
      when na.slug = 'mock-rec-scramble-live' and na.age_group = 'Open' then
        (
          select csb.id
          from public.competition_schedule_blocks csb
          where csb.competition_id = na.competition_id
            and csb.label = 'Open Session'
          limit 1
        )
      when na.slug = 'mock-youth-series-live' and na.age_group in ('Youth D', 'Youth C') then
        (
          select csb.id
          from public.competition_schedule_blocks csb
          where csb.competition_id = na.competition_id
            and csb.label = 'Youth D / Youth C Wave'
          limit 1
        )
      when na.slug = 'mock-youth-series-live' and na.age_group in ('Youth B', 'Youth A') then
        (
          select csb.id
          from public.competition_schedule_blocks csb
          where csb.competition_id = na.competition_id
            and csb.label = 'Youth B / Youth A Wave'
          limit 1
        )
      when na.slug = 'mock-youth-series-live' and na.age_group = 'Junior' then
        (
          select csb.id
          from public.competition_schedule_blocks csb
          where csb.competition_id = na.competition_id
            and csb.label = 'Junior Wave'
          limit 1
        )
      when na.slug = 'mock-flash-upcoming' and na.age_group in ('Youth B', 'Youth A') then
        (
          select csb.id
          from public.competition_schedule_blocks csb
          where csb.competition_id = na.competition_id
            and csb.label = 'Youth B / Youth A Rotation'
          limit 1
        )
      when na.slug = 'mock-flash-upcoming' and na.age_group in ('Junior', 'Open') then
        (
          select csb.id
          from public.competition_schedule_blocks csb
          where csb.competition_id = na.competition_id
            and csb.label = 'Junior / Open Rotation'
          limit 1
        )
      when na.slug = 'mock-scramble-upcoming' and na.age_group in ('Rec', 'Masters') then
        (
          select csb.id
          from public.competition_schedule_blocks csb
          where csb.competition_id = na.competition_id
            and csb.label = 'Rec / Masters Session'
          limit 1
        )
      when na.slug = 'mock-scramble-upcoming' and na.age_group = 'Open' then
        (
          select csb.id
          from public.competition_schedule_blocks csb
          where csb.competition_id = na.competition_id
            and csb.label = 'Open Session'
          limit 1
        )
      else null
    end as time_slot_id,
    md5(na.competition_id::text || ':' || na.category_id || ':' || na.athlete_index || ':mock') as access_token,
    now() - (((na.comp_sequence % 18) + 1) || ' hours')::interval as registered_at
  from numbered_athletes na
)
insert into public.climbers (
  id,
  competition_id,
  name,
  climber_number,
  province,
  category_id,
  gender_division,
  age_group,
  display_category,
  time_slot_id,
  access_token,
  access_token_created_at,
  registered_at
)
select
  id,
  competition_id,
  name,
  climber_number,
  province,
  category_id,
  gender_division,
  age_group,
  display_category,
  time_slot_id,
  access_token,
  registered_at,
  registered_at
from resolved_athletes;

-- 6. Seed live boulder queue traffic for active scramble sessions.
with live_scramble_blocks as (
  select
    c.id as competition_id,
    c.slug,
    c.total_climbs,
    csb.id as schedule_block_id
  from public.competitions c
  join public.competition_schedule_blocks csb
    on csb.competition_id = c.id
   and csb.is_active = true
   and csb.phase_type = 'qualifier_round'
  where c.slug in ('spring-send-recreational', 'mock-rec-scramble-live')
    and c.format = 'scramble'
    and c.current_phase = 'qualifier_open'
),
queued_climbers as (
  select
    lsb.competition_id,
    lsb.slug,
    lsb.total_climbs,
    lsb.schedule_block_id,
    c.id as climber_id,
    row_number() over (
      partition by lsb.competition_id
      order by c.climber_number, c.name
    ) as queue_seed
  from live_scramble_blocks lsb
  join public.climbers c
    on c.competition_id = lsb.competition_id
   and c.time_slot_id = lsb.schedule_block_id
),
materialized_queue as (
  select
    competition_id,
    climber_id,
    schedule_block_id,
    least(
      total_climbs,
      case
        when slug = 'spring-send-recreational' then
          case
            when queue_seed in (1, 2, 3, 4) then 2
            when queue_seed in (5, 6, 7) then 5
            when queue_seed in (8, 9) then 8
            when queue_seed = 10 then 12
            when queue_seed = 11 then 16
            else 20
          end
        else
          case
            when queue_seed in (1, 2, 3, 4, 5) then 3
            when queue_seed in (6, 7, 8) then 6
            when queue_seed in (9, 10) then 9
            when queue_seed = 11 then 14
            else 18
          end
      end
    ) as climb_number,
    now()
      - (
        case
          when slug = 'spring-send-recreational' then ((queue_seed - 1) * 11 + 8)
          else ((queue_seed - 1) * 13 + 12)
        end || ' seconds'
      )::interval as checked_in_at
  from queued_climbers
  where queue_seed <= 12
)
insert into public.competition_boulder_queue (
  competition_id,
  climber_id,
  schedule_block_id,
  climb_number,
  checked_in_at
)
select
  competition_id,
  climber_id,
  schedule_block_id,
  climb_number,
  checked_in_at
from materialized_queue;

-- 7. Seed qualifier attempts for live/finals/results competitions,
--    including the live Spring Send youth qualifier.
with scored_events as (
  select id, slug, format, total_climbs
  from public.competitions
  where slug in (
    'spring-send-recreational',
    'spring-send-youth',
    'mock-rec-scramble-live',
    'mock-youth-series-live',
    'mock-national-finals-live',
    'mock-city-boulder-results'
  )
),
attempt_source as (
  select
    c.competition_id,
    c.id as climber_id,
    se.slug,
    se.format,
    se.total_climbs,
    c.age_group,
    c.gender_division,
    gs.climb_number,
    get_byte(decode(md5(c.id::text || ':profile:a'), 'hex'), 0) as profile_seed_a,
    get_byte(decode(md5(c.id::text || ':profile:b'), 'hex'), 0) as profile_seed_b,
    get_byte(decode(md5(c.id::text || ':profile:c'), 'hex'), 0) as profile_seed_c,
    get_byte(decode(md5(c.id::text || ':profile:d'), 'hex'), 0) as profile_seed_d,
    get_byte(decode(md5(c.id::text || ':profile:e'), 'hex'), 0) as profile_seed_e,
    get_byte(decode(md5(c.id::text || ':' || gs.climb_number::text || ':a'), 'hex'), 0) as seed_a,
    get_byte(decode(md5(c.id::text || ':' || gs.climb_number::text || ':b'), 'hex'), 0) as seed_b,
    get_byte(decode(md5(c.id::text || ':' || gs.climb_number::text || ':c'), 'hex'), 0) as seed_c,
    get_byte(decode(md5(c.id::text || ':' || gs.climb_number::text || ':d'), 'hex'), 0) as seed_d,
    get_byte(decode(md5(c.id::text || ':' || gs.climb_number::text || ':e'), 'hex'), 0) as seed_e
  from public.climbers c
  join scored_events se
    on se.id = c.competition_id
  cross join lateral generate_series(1, se.total_climbs) as gs(climb_number)
),
athlete_profiles as (
  select distinct on (competition_id, climber_id)
    competition_id,
    climber_id,
    slug,
    format,
    total_climbs,
    age_group,
    gender_division,
    case age_group
      when 'Rec' then 8.9
      when 'Masters' then 9.8
      when 'Youth D' then 9.6
      when 'Youth C' then 10.4
      when 'Youth B' then 11.8
      when 'Youth A' then 12.6
      when 'Junior' then 13.4
      else 12.2
    end
      + case gender_division when 'Men' then 0.8 when 'Women' then 0.35 else 0.15 end
      + case slug
        when 'spring-send-recreational' then -0.8
        when 'mock-rec-scramble-live' then -0.5
        when 'spring-send-youth' then 0.35
        when 'mock-youth-series-live' then 0.55
        when 'mock-national-finals-live' then 1.1
        when 'mock-city-boulder-results' then 0.85
        else 0
      end
      + round(((profile_seed_a::numeric / 255) * 4.8) - 2.4, 2) as base_strength,
    4 + (profile_seed_b % 7) as consistency_band,
    4 + (profile_seed_c % 8) as endurance_band,
    3 + (profile_seed_d % 6) as volatility_band,
    (profile_seed_e % 9) - 4 as upset_band
  from attempt_source
  order by competition_id, climber_id
),
attempt_outcomes as (
  select
    src.competition_id,
    src.climber_id,
    src.climb_number,
    src.slug,
    src.format,
    src.total_climbs,
    case
      when src.format = 'scramble' then
        src.climb_number <= least(src.total_climbs, 10 + ap.endurance_band + (src.seed_a % 8))
      else
        src.climb_number <= least(src.total_climbs, 5 + ap.endurance_band + (src.seed_a % 4))
    end as attempted,
    (
      ap.base_strength
      + (ap.consistency_band * 0.34)
      + case when src.climb_number <= greatest(3, least(5, src.total_climbs / 3)) then 0.7 else 0 end
      - greatest(src.climb_number - ap.endurance_band, 0) * case when src.format = 'scramble' then 0.08 else 0.16 end
      + ((src.seed_c % 11) - 5) * 0.22
      + (ap.upset_band * case when (src.seed_d % 7) = 0 then 0.34 else 0.09 end)
    ) as performance_rating,
    (
      case src.slug
        when 'spring-send-recreational' then 8.6
        when 'mock-rec-scramble-live' then 9.1
        when 'spring-send-youth' then 10.4
        when 'mock-youth-series-live' then 10.8
        when 'mock-national-finals-live' then 11.7
        when 'mock-city-boulder-results' then 11.2
        else 10.3
      end
      + src.climb_number * case when src.format = 'scramble' then 0.34 else 0.56 end
      + ((src.seed_b % 9) - 4) * 0.17
      + case when src.climb_number > (src.total_climbs * 3 / 4) then 0.75 else 0 end
    ) as difficulty_rating,
    case
      when (
        ap.base_strength
        + (ap.consistency_band * 0.34)
        + case when src.climb_number <= greatest(3, least(5, src.total_climbs / 3)) then 0.7 else 0 end
        - greatest(src.climb_number - ap.endurance_band, 0) * case when src.format = 'scramble' then 0.08 else 0.16 end
        + ((src.seed_c % 11) - 5) * 0.22
        + (ap.upset_band * case when (src.seed_d % 7) = 0 then 0.34 else 0.09 end)
      ) - (
        case src.slug
          when 'spring-send-recreational' then 8.6
          when 'mock-rec-scramble-live' then 9.1
          when 'spring-send-youth' then 10.4
          when 'mock-youth-series-live' then 10.8
          when 'mock-national-finals-live' then 11.7
          when 'mock-city-boulder-results' then 11.2
          else 10.3
        end
        + src.climb_number * case when src.format = 'scramble' then 0.34 else 0.56 end
        + ((src.seed_b % 9) - 4) * 0.17
        + case when src.climb_number > (src.total_climbs * 3 / 4) then 0.75 else 0 end
      ) >= case when src.format = 'scramble' then 0.25 else 0.95 end
        then true
      else false
    end as topped_raw,
    case
      when src.format = 'scramble' then false
      when (
        ap.base_strength
        + (ap.consistency_band * 0.34)
        + case when src.climb_number <= greatest(3, least(5, src.total_climbs / 3)) then 0.7 else 0 end
        - greatest(src.climb_number - ap.endurance_band, 0) * case when src.format = 'scramble' then 0.08 else 0.16 end
        + ((src.seed_c % 11) - 5) * 0.22
        + (ap.upset_band * case when (src.seed_d % 7) = 0 then 0.34 else 0.09 end)
        + 1.4
      ) - (
        case src.slug
          when 'spring-send-recreational' then 8.6
          when 'mock-rec-scramble-live' then 9.1
          when 'spring-send-youth' then 10.4
          when 'mock-youth-series-live' then 10.8
          when 'mock-national-finals-live' then 11.7
          when 'mock-city-boulder-results' then 11.2
          else 10.3
        end
        + src.climb_number * case when src.format = 'scramble' then 0.34 else 0.56 end
        + ((src.seed_b % 9) - 4) * 0.17
        + case when src.climb_number > (src.total_climbs * 3 / 4) then 0.75 else 0 end
      ) >= 0.15
        then true
      else false
    end as zone_raw,
    case
      when src.format = 'scramble' then
        greatest(1, least(6, 2 + (src.seed_b % 3) + greatest(src.climb_number - ap.endurance_band, 0) / 3))
      else
        greatest(1, least(5, 1 + (src.seed_b % 2) + greatest(src.climb_number - ap.consistency_band, 0) / 4))
    end as top_tries,
    case
      when src.format = 'scramble' then null
      else greatest(1, least(6, 2 + (src.seed_c % 3) + greatest(src.climb_number - ap.endurance_band, 0) / 3))
    end as zone_tries,
    case
      when src.format = 'scramble' then 1 + (src.seed_d % 4)
      else 2 + (src.seed_e % 4)
    end as generic_tries
  from attempt_source src
  join athlete_profiles ap
    on ap.competition_id = src.competition_id
   and ap.climber_id = src.climber_id
),
materialized_attempts as (
  select
    competition_id,
    climber_id,
    climb_number,
    case when format = 'scramble' then topped_raw else (topped_raw or zone_raw) end as zone,
    topped_raw as topped,
    case
      when topped_raw then top_tries
      when format <> 'scramble' and zone_raw then zone_tries
      else generic_tries
    end as attempt_count,
    case when topped_raw then top_tries end as attempts_to_top,
    case
      when topped_raw then top_tries
      when format <> 'scramble' and zone_raw then zone_tries
      else null
    end as attempts_to_zone,
    case
      when format = 'scramble' and (climb_number <= 10 or ((climb_number + generic_tries) % 4) <> 0) then 'climber'
      when format = 'scramble' then 'staff'
      when ((climb_number + generic_tries + top_tries) % 3) = 0 then 'climber'
      else 'staff'
    end as entered_by
  from attempt_outcomes
  where attempted
    and not (
      format <> 'scramble'
      and climb_number > greatest(4, total_climbs - 2)
      and ((competition_id::text || ':' || climber_id::text || ':' || climb_number::text) is not null)
      and generic_tries >= 5
      and ((climb_number + generic_tries + zone_tries) % 5) = 0
    )
)
insert into public.qualifier_attempts (
  competition_id,
  round_id,
  climber_id,
  climb_number,
  attempt_count,
  zone,
  topped,
  attempts_to_top,
  attempts_to_zone,
  entered_by
)
select
  ma.competition_id,
  qr.round_id,
  ma.climber_id,
  ma.climb_number,
  ma.attempt_count,
  ma.zone,
  ma.topped,
  ma.attempts_to_top,
  ma.attempts_to_zone,
  ma.entered_by
from materialized_attempts ma
join lateral (
  select cr.id as round_id
  from public.competition_rounds cr
  where cr.competition_id = ma.competition_id
    and cr.round_type = 'qualifier'
  order by cr.sort_order, cr.round_number
  limit 1
) qr on true;

-- 8. Persist finalists for finals-live and results events using the official scoring function.
with finals_competitions as (
  select id
  from public.competitions
  where slug in ('mock-national-finals-live', 'mock-city-boulder-results')
)
insert into public.competition_finalists (
  competition_id,
  climber_id,
  name,
  category_id,
  display_category,
  gender_division,
  age_group,
  qualifier_rank,
  advanced_with_tie,
  climbing_order
)
select distinct on (fc.id, fs.climber_id)
  fc.id,
  fs.climber_id,
  fs.name,
  fs.category_id,
  fs.display_category,
  fs.gender_division,
  fs.age_group,
  fs.qualifier_rank,
  fs.advanced_with_tie,
  fs.climbing_order
from finals_competitions fc
cross join lateral public.compute_finalist_selection(fc.id) fs;

-- 9. Seed finals attempts:
--    - live finals event has partial scores
--    - results event has complete scores
with finals_events as (
  select
    c.id as competition_id,
    c.slug,
    c.current_phase,
    c.finals_problem_count
  from public.competitions c
  where c.slug in ('mock-national-finals-live', 'mock-city-boulder-results')
),
finalist_profiles as (
  select
    fe.competition_id,
    fe.slug,
    fe.current_phase,
    fe.finals_problem_count,
    cf.climber_id,
    cf.qualifier_rank,
    cf.age_group,
    cf.gender_division,
    13.4
      - least(cf.qualifier_rank, 10) * 0.42
      + case cf.age_group when 'Junior' then 0.2 else 0.7 end
      + case cf.gender_division when 'Men' then 0.25 when 'Women' then 0.15 else 0 end
      + round((((get_byte(decode(md5(cf.climber_id::text || ':final-profile'), 'hex'), 0))::numeric / 255) * 2.8) - 1.4, 2) as finals_strength,
    4 + (get_byte(decode(md5(cf.climber_id::text || ':final-consistency'), 'hex'), 0) % 5) as consistency_band,
    3 + (get_byte(decode(md5(cf.climber_id::text || ':final-volatility'), 'hex'), 0) % 5) as volatility_band
  from finals_events fe
  join public.competition_finalists cf
    on cf.competition_id = fe.competition_id
),
final_attempt_source as (
  select
    fp.competition_id,
    fp.slug,
    fp.current_phase,
    fp.climber_id,
    fp.qualifier_rank,
    fp.finals_strength,
    fp.consistency_band,
    fp.volatility_band,
    gs.climb_number,
    get_byte(decode(md5(fp.climber_id::text || ':' || gs.climb_number::text || ':fa'), 'hex'), 0) as seed_a,
    get_byte(decode(md5(fp.climber_id::text || ':' || gs.climb_number::text || ':fb'), 'hex'), 0) as seed_b,
    get_byte(decode(md5(fp.climber_id::text || ':' || gs.climb_number::text || ':fc'), 'hex'), 0) as seed_c
  from finalist_profiles fp
  cross join lateral generate_series(1, fp.finals_problem_count) as gs(climb_number)
),
final_attempts_seed as (
  select
    competition_id,
    climber_id,
    climb_number,
    case
      when current_phase = 'finals_open' then climb_number <= 2
      else true
    end as should_insert,
    (
      finals_strength
      + (consistency_band * 0.32)
      - qualifier_rank * 0.08
      + (((seed_a % 11) - 5) * 0.18)
      + (((seed_b % 7) - 3) * 0.12)
    ) >= (
      14.1
      + climb_number * 0.78
      + (((seed_c % 9) - 4) * 0.14)
      + 0.65
    ) as top_raw,
    (
      finals_strength
      + (consistency_band * 0.32)
      - qualifier_rank * 0.08
      + (((seed_a % 11) - 5) * 0.18)
      + (((seed_b % 7) - 3) * 0.12)
      + 1.1
    ) >= (
      14.1
      + climb_number * 0.78
      + (((seed_c % 9) - 4) * 0.14)
    ) as zone_raw,
    greatest(1, least(4, 1 + (seed_b % 3) + greatest(climb_number - consistency_band, 0) / 3)) as top_tries,
    greatest(1, least(5, 1 + (seed_c % 3) + greatest(climb_number - volatility_band, 0) / 3)) as zone_tries
  from final_attempt_source
),
materialized_final_attempts as (
  select
    competition_id,
    climber_id,
    climb_number,
    top_raw as top,
    (top_raw or zone_raw) as zone,
    case when top_raw then top_tries end as attempts_to_top,
    case when top_raw then top_tries when zone_raw then zone_tries end as attempts_to_zone
  from final_attempts_seed
  where should_insert
)
insert into public.final_attempts (
  competition_id,
  round_id,
  climber_id,
  climb_number,
  top,
  zone,
  attempts_to_top,
  attempts_to_zone,
  entered_by
)
select
  mfa.competition_id,
  fr.round_id,
  mfa.climber_id,
  mfa.climb_number,
  mfa.top,
  mfa.zone,
  mfa.attempts_to_top,
  mfa.attempts_to_zone,
  'staff'
from materialized_final_attempts mfa
join lateral (
  select cr.id as round_id
  from public.competition_rounds cr
  where cr.competition_id = mfa.competition_id
    and cr.scoring_bucket = 'finals'
  order by cr.sort_order, cr.round_number
  limit 1
) fr on true;

commit;


--- sql\refresh-mock-events-stage-logic.sql ---

begin;

-- Normalize the current mock event slate to the newer stage-based model
-- without deleting climbers or attempt history.

with mock_competitions as (
  select c.id, c.slug
  from public.competitions c
  where c.slug like 'mock-%'
     or c.slug in ('spring-send-recreational', 'spring-send-youth')
)
update public.competition_schedule_blocks csb
set is_active = false
from mock_competitions mc
where csb.competition_id = mc.id;

with removable_rounds as (
  select cr.id
  from public.competition_rounds cr
  join public.competitions c on c.id = cr.competition_id
  where (c.slug like 'mock-%' or c.slug in ('spring-send-recreational', 'spring-send-youth'))
    and cr.round_type = 'finals'
    and cr.scoring_bucket = 'none'
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from public.competition_schedule_blocks csb
      where csb.round_id = cr.id
    )
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from public.final_attempts fa
      where fa.round_id = cr.id
    )
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from public.qualifier_attempts qa
      where qa.round_id = cr.id
    )
)
delete from public.competition_rounds cr
using removable_rounds rr
where cr.id = rr.id;

with semifinal_targets as (
  select
    c.id as competition_id,
    c.slug,
    c.format,
    c.finals_cutoff,
    array(
      select cat.id
      from public.competition_categories cat
      where cat.competition_id = c.id
        and cat.age_group in (
          select jsonb_array_elements_text(c.finals_eligible_age_groups)
        )
      order by cat.sort_order
    ) as eligible_category_ids
  from public.competitions c
  where c.slug in ('spring-send-youth', 'mock-youth-series-live', 'mock-flash-upcoming')
)
insert into public.competition_rounds (
  id,
  competition_id,
  round_number,
  sort_order,
  name,
  round_type,
  format,
  status,
  runtime_phase,
  is_enabled,
  is_active,
  activated_at,
  problem_count,
  counting_climbs,
  finals_cutoff,
  eligible_category_ids,
  advancement_source_round_id,
  advancement_cutoff,
  scoring_bucket,
  scoring_config,
  started_at,
  closed_at
)
select
  gen_random_uuid(),
  st.competition_id,
  2,
  2,
  'Semifinal',
  'semifinal',
  st.format,
  'pending',
  'qualifier_open',
  true,
  false,
  null,
  4,
  4,
  null,
  coalesce(st.eligible_category_ids, '{}'::text[]),
  null,
  st.finals_cutoff,
  'qualifier',
  '{}'::jsonb,
  null,
  null
from semifinal_targets st
where not exists (
  select 1
  from public.competition_rounds existing
  where existing.competition_id = st.competition_id
    and existing.round_type = 'semifinal'
);

with semifinal_blocks(slug, label, audience_label, start_time, end_time, capacity) as (
  values
    ('spring-send-youth', 'Semifinal', 'Top qualifiers', '1:00 PM', '1:30 PM', 24),
    ('mock-youth-series-live', 'Semifinal', 'Top qualifiers', '1:00 PM', '1:35 PM', 24),
    ('mock-flash-upcoming', 'Semifinal', 'Top qualifiers', '7:45 AM', '8:30 AM', 24)
)
insert into public.competition_schedule_blocks (
  id,
  competition_id,
  round_id,
  sort_order,
  label,
  phase_type,
  audience_label,
  is_active,
  start_time,
  end_time,
  capacity,
  eligible_category_ids
)
select
  gen_random_uuid(),
  c.id,
  null,
  0,
  sb.label,
  'qualifier_round',
  sb.audience_label,
  false,
  sb.start_time,
  sb.end_time,
  sb.capacity,
  coalesce(
    (
      select jsonb_agg(cat.id order by cat.sort_order)
      from public.competition_categories cat
      where cat.competition_id = c.id
        and cat.age_group in (
          select jsonb_array_elements_text(c.finals_eligible_age_groups)
        )
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
from semifinal_blocks sb
join public.competitions c on c.slug = sb.slug
where not exists (
  select 1
  from public.competition_schedule_blocks existing
  where existing.competition_id = c.id
    and existing.label = sb.label
);

with qualifier_rounds as (
  select
    c.id as competition_id,
    c.slug,
    c.format,
    c.current_phase,
    c.total_climbs,
    c.qualifier_counting_climbs,
    c.finals_cutoff,
    c.has_finals,
    c.registration_opens_at,
    c.qualifier_locked_at,
    cr.id as round_id,
    array(
      select cat.id
      from public.competition_categories cat
      where cat.competition_id = c.id
        and cat.age_group in (
          select jsonb_array_elements_text(c.qualifier_eligible_age_groups)
        )
      order by cat.sort_order
    ) as eligible_category_ids
  from public.competitions c
  join public.competition_rounds cr
    on cr.competition_id = c.id
   and cr.round_type = 'qualifier'
  where c.slug like 'mock-%'
     or c.slug in ('spring-send-recreational', 'spring-send-youth')
)
update public.competition_rounds cr
set
  round_number = 1,
  sort_order = 1,
  name = 'Qualifier',
  round_type = 'qualifier',
  format = qr.format,
  status = case
    when qr.current_phase = 'qualifier_open' then 'active'
    when qr.current_phase in ('qualifier_closed', 'wall_reset', 'observation', 'finals_open', 'finals_closed', 'results') then 'closed'
    else 'pending'
  end,
  runtime_phase = 'qualifier_open',
  is_enabled = true,
  is_active = qr.current_phase in ('qualifier_open', 'qualifier_closed', 'wall_reset'),
  activated_at = case
    when qr.current_phase in ('qualifier_open', 'qualifier_closed', 'wall_reset', 'observation', 'finals_open', 'finals_closed', 'results')
      then coalesce(cr.activated_at, qr.registration_opens_at, cr.started_at, now())
    else null
  end,
  problem_count = qr.total_climbs,
  counting_climbs = qr.qualifier_counting_climbs,
  finals_cutoff = case when qr.has_finals then qr.finals_cutoff else null end,
  eligible_category_ids = coalesce(qr.eligible_category_ids, '{}'::text[]),
  advancement_source_round_id = null,
  advancement_cutoff = case when qr.has_finals then qr.finals_cutoff else null end,
  scoring_bucket = 'qualifier',
  scoring_config = '{}'::jsonb,
  started_at = coalesce(cr.started_at, qr.registration_opens_at),
  closed_at = case
    when qr.current_phase in ('qualifier_closed', 'wall_reset', 'observation', 'finals_open', 'finals_closed', 'results')
      then coalesce(cr.closed_at, qr.qualifier_locked_at, now())
    else null
  end
from qualifier_rounds qr
where cr.id = qr.round_id;

with semifinal_rounds as (
  select
    c.id as competition_id,
    c.slug,
    c.format,
    c.current_phase,
    c.finals_cutoff,
    semi.id as round_id,
    qual.id as qualifier_round_id,
    array(
      select cat.id
      from public.competition_categories cat
      where cat.competition_id = c.id
        and cat.age_group in (
          select jsonb_array_elements_text(c.finals_eligible_age_groups)
        )
      order by cat.sort_order
    ) as eligible_category_ids
  from public.competitions c
  join public.competition_rounds semi
    on semi.competition_id = c.id
   and semi.round_type = 'semifinal'
  join public.competition_rounds qual
    on qual.competition_id = c.id
   and qual.round_type = 'qualifier'
  where c.slug in ('spring-send-youth', 'mock-youth-series-live', 'mock-flash-upcoming')
)
update public.competition_rounds cr
set
  round_number = 2,
  sort_order = 2,
  name = 'Semifinal',
  round_type = 'semifinal',
  format = sr.format,
  status = case
    when sr.current_phase in ('finals_open', 'finals_closed', 'results') then 'closed'
    else 'pending'
  end,
  runtime_phase = 'qualifier_open',
  is_enabled = true,
  is_active = false,
  activated_at = null,
  problem_count = 4,
  counting_climbs = 4,
  finals_cutoff = null,
  eligible_category_ids = coalesce(sr.eligible_category_ids, '{}'::text[]),
  advancement_source_round_id = sr.qualifier_round_id,
  advancement_cutoff = sr.finals_cutoff,
  scoring_bucket = 'qualifier',
  scoring_config = jsonb_build_object('stage_label', 'semifinal'),
  started_at = null,
  closed_at = case
    when sr.current_phase in ('finals_open', 'finals_closed', 'results') then coalesce(cr.closed_at, now())
    else null
  end
from semifinal_rounds sr
where cr.id = sr.round_id;

with finals_rounds as (
  select
    c.id as competition_id,
    c.slug,
    c.current_phase,
    c.finals_problem_count,
    c.finals_cutoff,
    c.finals_started_at,
    fr.id as round_id,
    qual.id as qualifier_round_id,
    semi.id as semifinal_round_id,
    array(
      select cat.id
      from public.competition_categories cat
      where cat.competition_id = c.id
        and cat.age_group in (
          select jsonb_array_elements_text(c.finals_eligible_age_groups)
        )
      order by cat.sort_order
    ) as eligible_category_ids
  from public.competitions c
  join public.competition_rounds fr
    on fr.competition_id = c.id
   and fr.scoring_bucket = 'finals'
  join public.competition_rounds qual
    on qual.competition_id = c.id
   and qual.round_type = 'qualifier'
  left join public.competition_rounds semi
    on semi.competition_id = c.id
   and semi.round_type = 'semifinal'
  where c.slug like 'mock-%'
     or c.slug in ('spring-send-recreational', 'spring-send-youth')
)
update public.competition_rounds cr
set
  round_number = case when fr.semifinal_round_id is null then 2 else 3 end,
  sort_order = case when fr.semifinal_round_id is null then 2 else 3 end,
  name = 'Finals',
  round_type = 'finals',
  format = 'ifsc_finals_format',
  status = case
    when fr.current_phase = 'results' then 'results'
    when fr.current_phase in ('observation', 'finals_open') then 'active'
    when fr.current_phase = 'finals_closed' then 'closed'
    else 'pending'
  end,
  runtime_phase = 'finals_open',
  is_enabled = true,
  is_active = fr.current_phase in ('observation', 'finals_open', 'finals_closed', 'results'),
  activated_at = case
    when fr.current_phase in ('observation', 'finals_open', 'finals_closed', 'results')
      then coalesce(cr.activated_at, fr.finals_started_at, now())
    else null
  end,
  problem_count = fr.finals_problem_count,
  counting_climbs = null,
  finals_cutoff = fr.finals_cutoff,
  eligible_category_ids = coalesce(fr.eligible_category_ids, '{}'::text[]),
  advancement_source_round_id = coalesce(fr.semifinal_round_id, fr.qualifier_round_id),
  advancement_cutoff = fr.finals_cutoff,
  scoring_bucket = 'finals',
  scoring_config = '{}'::jsonb,
  started_at = coalesce(cr.started_at, fr.finals_started_at),
  closed_at = case
    when fr.current_phase in ('finals_closed', 'results') then coalesce(cr.closed_at, fr.finals_started_at, now())
    else null
  end
from finals_rounds fr
where cr.id = fr.round_id;

with stage_rounds as (
  select
    c.id as competition_id,
    c.slug,
    (array_agg(cr.id order by cr.sort_order, cr.round_number) filter (where cr.round_type = 'qualifier'))[1] as qualifier_round_id,
    (array_agg(cr.id order by cr.sort_order, cr.round_number) filter (where cr.round_type = 'semifinal'))[1] as semifinal_round_id,
    (array_agg(cr.id order by cr.sort_order, cr.round_number) filter (where cr.scoring_bucket = 'finals'))[1] as finals_round_id
  from public.competitions c
  left join public.competition_rounds cr on cr.competition_id = c.id
  where c.slug like 'mock-%'
     or c.slug in ('spring-send-recreational', 'spring-send-youth')
  group by c.id, c.slug
),
block_map(slug, label, sort_order, is_active, link_stage) as (

    ('mock-flash-upcoming', 'Check-in', 3, false, null),
    ('mock-flash-upcoming', 'Technical meeting', 4, false, null),
    ('mock-flash-upcoming', 'Youth B / Youth A Rotation', 5, false, 'qualifier'),
    ('mock-flash-upcoming', 'Junior / Open Rotation', 6, false, 'qualifier'),
    ('mock-flash-upcoming', 'Semifinal', 7, false, 'semifinal'),
    ('mock-flash-upcoming', 'Isolation', 8, false, 'finals'),
    ('mock-flash-upcoming', 'Observation', 9, false, 'finals'),

    ('mock-national-finals-live', 'Technical meeting', 2, false, null),
    ('mock-national-finals-live', 'Isolation', 3, false, 'finals'),

    ('mock-scramble-upcoming', 'Open Session', 4, false, 'qualifier'),
    ('mock-scramble-upcoming', 'Score verification', 5, false, null),
    ('mock-scramble-upcoming', 'Awards', 6, false, null)
),
resolved_blocks as (
  select
    csb.id as block_id,
    bm.sort_order,
    bm.is_active,
    case bm.link_stage
      when 'qualifier' then sr.qualifier_round_id
      when 'semifinal' then sr.semifinal_round_id
      when 'finals' then sr.finals_round_id
      else null
    end as round_id
  from block_map bm
  join public.competitions c on c.slug = bm.slug
  join public.competition_schedule_blocks csb
    on csb.competition_id = c.id
   and csb.label = bm.label
  join stage_rounds sr on sr.competition_id = c.id
)
update public.competition_schedule_blocks csb
set
  sort_order = rb.sort_order,
  is_active = rb.is_active,
  round_id = rb.round_id
from resolved_blocks rb
where csb.id = rb.block_id;

commit;


--- sql\spring-send\00-reset-and-configure.sql ---

do $$
begin
  if to_regclass('public.competitions') is null then
    raise exception 'Missing multi-competition schema. Run supabase-repair.sql or supabase-schema.sql first.';
  end if;

  if to_regclass('public.final_attempts') is not null then
    execute 'delete from public.final_attempts';
  end if;
  if to_regclass('public.competition_finalists') is not null then
    execute 'delete from public.competition_finalists';
  end if;
  if to_regclass('public.qualifier_attempts') is not null then
    execute 'delete from public.qualifier_attempts';
  end if;
  if to_regclass('public.climbers') is not null then
    execute 'delete from public.climbers';
  end if;
  if to_regclass('public.competition_schedule_blocks') is not null then
    execute 'delete from public.competition_schedule_blocks';
  end if;
  if to_regclass('public.competition_categories') is not null then
    execute 'delete from public.competition_categories';
  end if;

  execute 'delete from public.competitions';
end $$;

insert into public.competitions (
  id,
  slug,
  name,
  status,
  format,
  discipline_label,
  stage_mode,
  location_name,
  start_date,
  end_date,
  registration_opens_at,
  registration_closes_at,
  description,
  total_climbs,
  max_climbers,
  qualifier_counting_climbs,
  finals_cutoff,
  finals_tie_advances,
  finals_eligible_age_groups
)
values
  (
    gen_random_uuid(),
    'spring-send-recreational',
    'Spring Send Recreational Scramble',
    'active',
    'scramble',
    'Boulder',
    'qualifier',
    'Halifax',
    current_date,
    current_date,
    now(),
    now() + interval '8 hours',
    'Recreational scramble competition.',
    20,
    80,
    6,
    6,
    true,
    '["Open"]'::jsonb
  ),
  (
    gen_random_uuid(),
    'spring-send-youth-competitive',
    'Spring Send Youth Competitive',
    'active',
    'five_on_five_off',
    'Boulder',
    'qualifier',
    'Halifax',
    current_date,

    'Youth competitive qualifier and finals competition.',
    20,
    120,
    6,
    8,
    true,
    '["Youth D","Youth B","Youth A","Junior"]'::jsonb
  );

insert into public.competition_categories (
  id,
  competition_id,
  gender_division,
  age_group,
  display_name,
  sort_order
)
select
  division || '::' || age_group,
  competitions.id,
  division,
  age_group,
  division || ' / ' || age_group,
  row_number() over (partition by competitions.id order by division, age_group) - 1
from public.competitions competitions
cross join (values ('Men'), ('Women'), ('X')) as divisions(division)
cross join (values ('Youth D'), ('Youth C'), ('Youth B'), ('Youth A'), ('Junior'), ('Rec'), ('Masters'), ('Open')) as ages(age_group);

insert into public.competition_schedule_blocks (
  competition_id,
  label,
  phase_type,
  audience_label,
  is_active,
  start_time,
  end_time,
  capacity,
  eligible_category_ids
)

  competitions.id,
  schedule.label,
  schedule.phase_type,
  schedule.audience_label,
  schedule.is_active,
  schedule.start_time,
  schedule.end_time,
  schedule.capacity,

from public.competitions competitions

--- sql\spring-send\01-load-schedule.sql ---

delete from public.competition_schedule_blocks
where competition_id in (
  select id
  from public.competitions
  where slug in ('spring-send-recreational', 'spring-send-youth-competitive')
);

  competition_id,
  label,
  phase_type,
  audience_label,
  is_active,
  start_time,
  end_time,
  capacity,
  eligible_category_ids
)

  schedule.label,
  schedule.phase_type,
  schedule.audience_label,

from public.competitions competitions
join (

    ('spring-send-recreational', 'Technical Meeting - Recreational Scramble', 'technical_meeting', 'Recreational Scramble', false, '07:50', null, 80),

--- sql\spring-send\02-seed-registrations.sql ---

do $$
begin
  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.competition_schedule_blocks blocks
    join public.competitions competitions on competitions.id = blocks.competition_id
    where competitions.slug in ('spring-send-recreational', 'spring-send-youth-competitive')
  ) then
    raise exception 'Spring Send schedule blocks are missing. Run 00-reset-and-configure.sql or 01-load-schedule.sql first.';
  end if;
end $$;

      ]
    )[1 + (((series.n - 1) * 11) % 844)] as athlete_name,
    case ((series.n * 23) % 13)
      when 0 then 'AB' when 1 then 'BC' when 2 then 'MB'
      when 3 then 'NB' when 4 then 'NL' when 5 then 'NS'
      when 6 then 'NT' when 7 then 'NU' when 8 then 'ON'
      when 9 then 'PE' when 10 then 'QC' when 11 then 'SK' else 'YT'
    end as province,
    case
      when series.n <= 48 then
        (array['Rec', 'Rec', 'Rec', 'Open', 'Masters', 'Rec', 'Open', 'Masters'])[((series.n * 5) % 8) + 1]
      else
        (array['Youth D', 'Youth C', 'Youth B', 'Youth A', 'Junior', 'Youth B', 'Youth A', 'Junior'])[((series.n * 7) % 8) + 1]
    end as age_group,
    case
      when series.n <= 48 then
        (array['Men', 'Women', 'X', 'Women', 'Men', 'X'])[((series.n * 11) % 6) + 1]
      else
        (array['Men', 'Women', 'Men', 'Women', 'Men', 'Women', 'X'])[((series.n * 13) % 7) + 1]
    end as gender_division,
    case
      when series.n <= 48 and (series.n % 3) = 0 then 'Check-in - Recreational Scramble'
      when series.n <= 48 then 'Recreational Scramble'
      when (series.n % 4) in (0, 1) then 'Check-in / Isolation - Youth Competitive Qualifiers'
      else 'Event - Youth Competitive Qualifiers'
    end as slot_label
  from generate_series(1, 124) as series(n)
)
insert into public.climbers (
  competition_id,
  name,
  climber_number,
  province,
  category_id,
  gender_division,
  age_group,
  display_category,
  time_slot_id,
  access_token
)
select
  competition_map.id,
  athletes.athlete_name,
  lpad(athletes.athlete_number::text, 3, '0'),
  athletes.province,
  athletes.gender_division || '::' || athletes.age_group,
  athletes.gender_division,
  athletes.age_group,
  athletes.gender_division || ' / ' || athletes.age_group,
  slot_map.id,
  athletes.competition_slug || '-token-' || lpad(athletes.athlete_number::text, 3, '0')
from athletes
join competition_map on competition_map.slug = athletes.competition_slug
left join slot_map
  on slot_map.competition_id = competition_map.id
 and slot_map.label = athletes.slot_label;


--- sql\spring-send\03-seed-qualifier-attempts.sql ---

with athlete_profiles as (
  select
    c.id as climber_id,
    c.competition_id,
    c.climber_number::int as athlete_number,
    c.age_group,
    c.gender_division,
    case c.age_group
      when 'Open' then 14.6
      when 'Masters' then 12.8
      when 'Rec' then 9.4
      when 'Junior' then 14.1
      when 'Youth A' then 12.9
      when 'Youth B' then 11.8
      when 'Youth C' then 10.7
      else 10.1
    end
      + case c.gender_division when 'Men' then 0.75 when 'Women' then 0.35 else 0.15 end
      + round((((c.climber_number::int * 29) % 17)::numeric / 17.0) * 4.4 - 2.2, 2) as base_strength,
    4 + ((c.climber_number::int * 31) % 7) as consistency_band,
    4 + ((c.climber_number::int * 37) % 8) as endurance_band,
    3 + ((c.climber_number::int * 41) % 6) as volatility_band,
    ((c.climber_number::int * 43) % 9) - 4 as upset_band
  from public.climbers c
  where c.competition_id in (
    select id
    from public.competitions
    where slug in ('spring-send-recreational', 'spring-send-youth-competitive')
  )
),
qualifier_attempt_seed as (
  select
    profiles.competition_id,
    profiles.climber_id,
    profiles.athlete_number,
    profiles.age_group,
    profiles.base_strength,
    profiles.consistency_band,
    profiles.endurance_band,
    profiles.volatility_band,
    profiles.upset_band,
    climbs.climb_number,
    case
      when profiles.age_group = 'Rec' then least(20, 8 + profiles.endurance_band + ((profiles.athlete_number * 41) % 5))
      when profiles.age_group = 'Masters' then least(20, 9 + profiles.endurance_band + ((profiles.athlete_number * 43) % 4))
      else least(20, 7 + profiles.endurance_band + ((profiles.athlete_number * 47) % 4))
    end as max_logged_climb,
    (
      profiles.base_strength
      + (profiles.consistency_band * 0.38)
      + case
        when climbs.climb_number <= 5 then 0.9
        when climbs.climb_number <= 10 then 0.4
        else 0
      end
      - greatest(climbs.climb_number - profiles.endurance_band, 0) * 0.15
      + (((profiles.athlete_number * 53 + climbs.climb_number * 59 + profiles.volatility_band * 61) % 11) - 5) * 0.28
      + (profiles.upset_band * case when ((profiles.athlete_number + climbs.climb_number) % 6) = 0 then 0.36 else 0.1 end)
    ) as performance_score,
    case
      when profiles.competition_id = (select id from public.competitions where slug = 'spring-send-recreational')
        then 8.7
          + climbs.climb_number * 0.36
          + (((climbs.climb_number * 67 + profiles.volatility_band * 71) % 7) - 3) * 0.16
      else 10.1
        + climbs.climb_number * 0.52
        + (((climbs.climb_number * 73 + profiles.volatility_band * 79) % 9) - 4) * 0.18
    end as difficulty_score
  from athlete_profiles profiles
  cross join generate_series(1, 20) as climbs(climb_number)
),
qualifier_attempt_rows as (
  select
    competition_id,
    climber_id,
    climb_number,
    case
      when competition_id = (select id from public.competitions where slug = 'spring-send-recreational')
        then performance_score >= difficulty_score - 0.2
      else performance_score >= difficulty_score - 1.25
    end as zone,
    performance_score >= difficulty_score + case
      when competition_id = (select id from public.competitions where slug = 'spring-send-recreational') then 0.1
      else 0.7
    end as topped,
    case
      when performance_score >= difficulty_score
        then greatest(1, least(5, 1 + ((athlete_number * 83 + climb_number * 89 + volatility_band * 97) % 3) + greatest(climb_number - consistency_band, 0) / 4))
      else greatest(1, least(7, 2 + ((athlete_number * 101 + climb_number * 103 + endurance_band * 107) % 4) + greatest(climb_number - endurance_band, 0) / 3))
    end as attempt_count,
    case
      when performance_score >= difficulty_score + case
        when competition_id = (select id from public.competitions where slug = 'spring-send-recreational') then 0.1
        else 0.7
      end
        then greatest(1, least(5, 1 + ((athlete_number * 149 + climb_number * 151 + volatility_band * 157) % 3) + greatest(climb_number - consistency_band, 0) / 4))
      else null
    end as raw_top_attempts,
    case
      when competition_id = (select id from public.competitions where slug = 'spring-send-recreational')
        then case when performance_score >= difficulty_score - 0.2 then greatest(1, least(5, 1 + ((athlete_number * 163 + climb_number * 167) % 3))) else null end
      when performance_score >= difficulty_score - 1.25
        then greatest(1, least(6, 1 + ((athlete_number * 173 + climb_number * 179 + endurance_band) % 4) + greatest(climb_number - endurance_band, 0) / 4))
      else null
    end as raw_zone_attempts,
    case
      when competition_id = (select id from public.competitions where slug = 'spring-send-recreational')
        and (climb_number <= 10 or ((athlete_number * 109 + climb_number * 113) % 4) <> 0)
        then 'climber'
      when (athlete_number * 127 + climb_number * 131) % 3 = 0
        then 'climber'
      else 'staff'
    end as entered_by
  from qualifier_attempt_seed
  where climb_number <= max_logged_climb
    and not (
      competition_id <> (select id from public.competitions where slug = 'spring-send-recreational')
      and climb_number > 11
      and ((athlete_number * 137 + climb_number * 139 + volatility_band + consistency_band) % 5) = 0
    )
)
insert into public.qualifier_attempts (
  competition_id,
  climber_id,
  climb_number,
  attempt_count,
  zone,
  topped,
  attempts_to_top,
  attempts_to_zone,
  entered_by
)
select
  rows.competition_id,
  rows.climber_id,
  rows.climb_number,
  rows.attempt_count,
  rows.zone or rows.topped,
  rows.topped,
  case
    when rows.topped
      then greatest(1, rows.raw_top_attempts)
    else null
  end,
  case
    when rows.zone or rows.topped
      then case
        when rows.topped
          then least(greatest(1, rows.raw_zone_attempts), greatest(1, rows.raw_top_attempts))
        else greatest(1, rows.raw_zone_attempts)
      end
    else null
  end,
  rows.entered_by
from qualifier_attempt_rows rows;


--- sql\spring-send\03b-refresh-mock-youth-qualifier-attempts.sql ---

begin;

do $$
begin
  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.competitions
    where slug = 'spring-send-youth'
  ) then
    raise exception 'Missing spring-send-youth competition. Run sql/mock-events-seed.sql first.';
  end if;
end $$;

delete from public.qualifier_attempts
where competition_id = (
  select id
  from public.competitions
  where slug = 'spring-send-youth'
  limit 1
);

with scored_event as (
  select id, slug, format, total_climbs
  from public.competitions
  where slug = 'spring-send-youth'
),
attempt_source as (
  select
    c.competition_id,
    c.id as climber_id,
    se.slug,
    se.format,
    gs.climb_number,
    get_byte(decode(md5(c.id::text || ':' || gs.climb_number::text || ':a'), 'hex'), 0) as seed_a,
    get_byte(decode(md5(c.id::text || ':' || gs.climb_number::text || ':b'), 'hex'), 0) as seed_b,
    get_byte(decode(md5(c.id::text || ':' || gs.climb_number::text || ':c'), 'hex'), 0) as seed_c,
    get_byte(decode(md5(c.id::text || ':' || gs.climb_number::text || ':d'), 'hex'), 0) as seed_d
  from public.climbers c
  join scored_event se
    on se.id = c.competition_id
  cross join lateral generate_series(1, se.total_climbs) as gs(climb_number)
),
attempt_outcomes as (
  select
    competition_id,
    climber_id,
    climb_number,
    slug,
    format,
    seed_a < 90 as attempted,
    seed_b < case
      when climb_number <= 5 then 34
      when climb_number <= 10 then 24
      when climb_number <= 14 then 16
      else 10
    end as topped_raw,
    seed_c < case
      when climb_number <= 5 then 78
      when climb_number <= 10 then 62
      when climb_number <= 14 then 48
      else 34
    end as zone_raw,
    1 + (seed_b % 3) as top_tries,
    1 + (seed_c % 4) as zone_tries,
    1 + (seed_d % 5) as generic_tries
  from attempt_source
),
materialized_attempts as (
  select
    competition_id,
    climber_id,
    climb_number,
    (topped_raw or zone_raw) as zone,
    topped_raw as topped,
    case
      when topped_raw then top_tries
      when zone_raw then zone_tries
      else generic_tries
    end as attempt_count,
    case when topped_raw then top_tries end as attempts_to_top,
    case
      when topped_raw then top_tries
      when zone_raw then zone_tries
      else null
    end as attempts_to_zone,
    'staff' as entered_by
  from attempt_outcomes
  where attempted
)
insert into public.qualifier_attempts (
  competition_id,
  climber_id,
  climb_number,
  attempt_count,
  zone,
  topped,
  attempts_to_top,
  attempts_to_zone,
  entered_by
)
select
  competition_id,
  climber_id,
  climb_number,
  attempt_count,
  zone,
  topped,
  attempts_to_top,
  attempts_to_zone,
  entered_by
from materialized_attempts;

commit;


--- sql\spring-send\04-advance-to-finals.sql ---

update public.competition_schedule_blocks
set is_active = false
where competition_id = (select id from public.competitions where slug = 'spring-send-youth-competitive');

update public.competition_schedule_blocks
set is_active = true
where competition_id = (select id from public.competitions where slug = 'spring-send-youth-competitive')
  and phase_type = 'finals_round';

delete from public.final_attempts
where competition_id = (select id from public.competitions where slug = 'spring-send-youth-competitive');

delete from public.competition_finalists
where competition_id = (select id from public.competitions where slug = 'spring-send-youth-competitive');

with target as (
  select *
  from public.competitions
  where slug = 'spring-send-youth-competitive'
),
climber_scores as (
  select
    c.id as climber_id,
    c.name,
    c.category_id,
    c.display_category,
    c.gender_division,
    c.age_group,
    q.climb_number,
    q.attempt_count,
    q.topped,
    case
      when q.topped
        then greatest(0, q.climb_number * 1000 - least(greatest(q.attempt_count - 1, 0), 3) * 200)
      else 0
    end as score
  from public.climbers c
  join target on target.id = c.competition_id
  left join public.qualifier_attempts q on q.climber_id = c.id
),
counting_scores as (
  select *
  from (
    select
      climber_scores.*,
      row_number() over (
        partition by climber_id
        order by score desc, climb_number desc, attempt_count asc
      ) as score_row
    from climber_scores
    where score > 0
  ) ranked_scores
  where score_row <= (select qualifier_counting_climbs from target)
),
qualifier_totals as (
  select
    c.id as climber_id,
    c.name,
    c.category_id,
    c.display_category,
    c.gender_division,
    c.age_group,
    coalesce(sum(cs.score), 0) as total_score,
    coalesce(count(*) filter (where cs.topped), 0) as topped_count,
    coalesce(sum(cs.attempt_count), 0) as counting_attempt_total
  from public.climbers c
  join target on target.id = c.competition_id
  left join counting_scores cs on cs.climber_id = c.id
  group by c.id, c.name, c.category_id, c.display_category, c.gender_division, c.age_group
),
ranked as (
  select
    qualifier_totals.*,
    row_number() over (
      partition by category_id
      order by total_score desc, topped_count desc, counting_attempt_total asc, name asc
    ) as category_rank
  from qualifier_totals
  where gender_division in ('Men', 'Women')
    and age_group in (
      select jsonb_array_elements_text((select finals_eligible_age_groups from target))
    )
),
cutoff as (
  select
    category_id,
    total_score,
    topped_count,
    counting_attempt_total
  from ranked
  where category_rank = (select finals_cutoff from target)
)
insert into public.competition_finalists (
  competition_id,
  climber_id,
  name,
  category_id,
  display_category,
  gender_division,
  age_group,
  qualifier_rank,
  advanced_with_tie
)
select
  target.id,
  ranked.climber_id,
  ranked.name,
  ranked.category_id,
  ranked.display_category,
  ranked.gender_division,
  ranked.age_group,
  ranked.category_rank,
  ranked.category_rank > target.finals_cutoff
from ranked
cross join target
left join cutoff using (category_id)
where ranked.category_rank <= target.finals_cutoff
   or (
     target.finals_tie_advances
     and cutoff.category_id is not null
     and ranked.category_rank > target.finals_cutoff
     and ranked.total_score = cutoff.total_score
     and ranked.topped_count = cutoff.topped_count
     and ranked.counting_attempt_total = cutoff.counting_attempt_total
   );

update public.competitions
set
  format = 'ifsc_finals_format',
  stage_mode = 'finals',
  qualifier_locked_at = now(),
  finals_started_at = now(),
  finals_problem_count = 4
where slug = 'spring-send-youth-competitive';


--- sql\spring-send\05-seed-finals-attempts.sql ---

with finalist_pool as (
  select
    c.id as climber_id,
    c.competition_id,
    c.climber_number::int as athlete_number,
    ef.qualifier_rank,
    greatest(1, 12 - ef.qualifier_rank) as qualifier_bonus,
    1 + ((c.climber_number::int * 149) % 7) as finals_attack,
    1 + ((c.climber_number::int * 151) % 7) as finals_precision,
    1 + ((c.climber_number::int * 157) % 6) as finals_composure
  from public.climbers c
  join public.competition_finalists ef on ef.climber_id = c.id
  where c.competition_id = (select id from public.competitions where slug = 'spring-send-youth-competitive')
),
final_attempt_seed as (
  select
    finalists.competition_id,
    finalists.climber_id,
    finalists.athlete_number,
    finalists.qualifier_rank,
    finalists.qualifier_bonus,
    finalists.finals_attack,
    finalists.finals_precision,
    finalists.finals_composure,
    climbs.climb_number,
    case climbs.climb_number
      when 1 then 11
      when 2 then 14
      when 3 then 13
      else 16
    end as problem_difficulty
  from finalist_pool finalists
  cross join (values (1), (2), (3), (4)) as climbs(climb_number)
),
final_attempt_rows as (
  select
    competition_id,
    climber_id,
    climb_number,
    (
      qualifier_bonus
      + finals_precision
      + finals_composure
      + ((athlete_number * 163 + climb_number * 167) % 9)
      >= problem_difficulty + 2
    ) as top,
    (
      qualifier_bonus
      + finals_attack
      + ((athlete_number * 173 + climb_number * 179) % 8)
      >= problem_difficulty - 2
    ) as zone,
    1 + ((athlete_number * 181 + climb_number * 191 + finals_precision * 193) % 6) as raw_top_attempts,
    1 + ((athlete_number * 197 + climb_number * 199 + finals_attack * 211) % 8) as raw_zone_attempts
  from final_attempt_seed
)
insert into public.final_attempts (
  competition_id,
  climber_id,
  climb_number,
  top,
  zone,
  attempts_to_top,
  attempts_to_zone,
  entered_by
)
select
  rows.competition_id,
  rows.climber_id,
  rows.climb_number,
  rows.top,
  rows.top or rows.zone,
  case
    when rows.top then rows.raw_top_attempts
    else null
  end,
  case
    when rows.top or rows.zone
      then case
        when rows.top then least(rows.raw_zone_attempts, rows.raw_top_attempts)
        else rows.raw_zone_attempts
      end
    else null
  end,
  'staff'
from final_attempt_rows rows;


--- sql\spring-send\README.md ---

# Spring Send SQL

These scripts seed Spring Send as two separate competitions:

- `spring-send-recreational`
- `spring-send-youth-competitive`

Run them in this order:

1. `00-reset-and-configure.sql`
2. `01-load-schedule.sql`
3. `02-seed-registrations.sql`
4. `03-seed-qualifier-attempts.sql`
5. `04-advance-to-finals.sql`
6. `05-seed-finals-attempts.sql`

Notes:

- `00-reset-and-configure.sql` now creates the Spring Send competitions, categories, and default schedule blocks in one shot.
- `01-load-schedule.sql` is safe to rerun if you want to refresh just the schedule block set.
- The recreational scramble stays in qualifier mode.
- The youth competition advances to finals separately.
- Finals eligibility is driven by the competition's `finals_eligible_age_groups` setting.
- These scripts assume the multi-competition schema from `supabase-schema.sql` is already applied.
- Registration, qualifier attempts, and finals attempts are intentionally seeded with much higher variation now:
  - larger name pool
  - broader province/category mix
  - assigned schedule blocks
  - uneven climb logging
  - more realistic top / no-top / zone-only spread
  - less repetitive leaderboard clustering

--- src\app\api\demo\complete\route.ts ---

import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { createServiceRoleSupabaseClient } from "@/lib/server-supabase";

type DemoCompleteRequest = {
  competitionId?: string;
};

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  let body: DemoCompleteRequest;

  try {
    body = (await request.json()) as DemoCompleteRequest;
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Invalid request body." }, { status: 400 });
  }

  if (!body.competitionId) {
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "competitionId is required." }, { status: 400 });
  }

  try {
    const supabase = createServiceRoleSupabaseClient();
    const { data: competition, error: competitionError } = await supabase
      .from("competitions")
      .select("id, is_demo")
      .eq("id", body.competitionId)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (competitionError) {
      throw new Error(competitionError.message);
    }

    if (!competition) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Demo competition not found." }, { status: 404 });
    }

    if (competition.is_demo !== true) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Refusing to delete a non-demo competition." }, { status: 403 });
    }

    const { error: deleteError } = await supabase.from("competitions").delete().eq("id", body.competitionId);
    if (deleteError) {
      throw new Error(deleteError.message);
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, competitionId: body.competitionId, deleted: true });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("DEMO COMPLETE ERROR:", error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { ok: false, error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unable to finish demo." },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

type QueryResult = { data?: unknown; error: { message: string } | null };

const mockState = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  competition: {

    is_demo: true,

  },
  finalsRound: {

  },

class SupabaseQueryMock {
  private operation: "select" | "upsert" | "delete" | null = null;
  private payload: unknown = null;

  constructor(private readonly table: string) {}

  select() {
    this.operation = "select";
    return this;
  }

  upsert(payload: unknown) {
    this.operation = "upsert";
    this.payload = payload;
    return this;
  }

  delete() {
    this.operation = "delete";
    return this;
  }

  eq() {
    return this;
  }

  or() {
    return this;
  }

  order() {
    return this;
  }

  limit() {
    return this;
  }

  async maybeSingle(): Promise<QueryResult> {
    if (this.table === "competitions") {
      return { data: mockState.competition, error: null };
    }
    if (this.table === "competition_rounds") {
      return { data: mockState.finalsRound, error: null };
    }
    return { data: null, error: null };
  }

  then<TResult1 = QueryResult, TResult2 = never>(
    onfulfilled?: ((value: QueryResult) => TResult1 | PromiseLike<TResult1>) | null,
    onrejected?: ((reason: unknown) => TResult2 | PromiseLike<TResult2>) | null
  ) {
    return this.resolve().then(onfulfilled, onrejected);
  }

  private async resolve(): Promise<QueryResult> {
    if (this.table === "competition_finalists" && this.operation === "select") {
      return { data: mockState.finalists, error: null };
    }

    if (this.table === "final_attempts" && this.operation === "upsert") {
      mockState.upsertedFinalAttempts = Array.isArray(this.payload)
        ? (this.payload as Array<Record<string, unknown>>)
        : [];
      return { error: null };
    }

    if (this.table === "final_attempts" && this.operation === "delete") {
      mockState.deletedFinalAttempts = true;
      return { error: null };
    }

    return { data: null, error: null };
  }
}

--- src\app\api\demo\finals-results\route.ts ---

import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { buildDemoFinalScore } from "@/lib/demo-seed-data";
import { createServiceRoleSupabaseClient } from "@/lib/server-supabase";

type DemoFinalsResultsRequest = {
  competitionId?: string;
};

type CompetitionRow = {
  id: string;
  is_demo: boolean;
  finals_problem_count: number | null;
};

type FinalsRoundRow = {
  id: string;
  problem_count: number | null;
};

type FinalistRow = {
  climber_id: string;
  qualifier_rank: number | null;
  climbing_order: number | null;
};

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  let body: DemoFinalsResultsRequest;

  try {
    body = (await request.json()) as DemoFinalsResultsRequest;
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Invalid request body." }, { status: 400 });
  }

  if (!body.competitionId) {
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "competitionId is required." }, { status: 400 });
  }

  try {
    const supabase = createServiceRoleSupabaseClient();
    const { data: competition, error: competitionError } = await supabase
      .from("competitions")
      .select("id, is_demo, finals_problem_count")
      .eq("id", body.competitionId)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (competitionError) {
      throw new Error(competitionError.message);
    }

    const competitionRow = competition as CompetitionRow | null;
    if (!competitionRow) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Competition not found." }, { status: 404 });
    }

    if (competitionRow.is_demo !== true) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, error: "Refusing to seed finals results into a non-demo competition." },
        { status: 403 }
      );
    }

    const { data: finalsRound, error: roundError } = await supabase
      .from("competition_rounds")
      .select("id, problem_count")
      .eq("competition_id", competitionRow.id)
      .or("round_type.eq.finals,scoring_bucket.eq.finals")
      .order("sort_order", { ascending: true })
      .limit(1)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (roundError) {
      throw new Error(roundError.message);
    }

    const finalsRoundRow = finalsRound as FinalsRoundRow | null;
    if (!finalsRoundRow?.id) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Demo finals round not found." }, { status: 409 });
    }

    const { data: finalists, error: finalistsError } = await supabase
      .from("competition_finalists")
      .select("climber_id, qualifier_rank, climbing_order")
      .eq("competition_id", competitionRow.id)
      .order("climbing_order", { ascending: true })
      .order("qualifier_rank", { ascending: true });

    if (finalistsError) {
      throw new Error(finalistsError.message);
    }

    const finalistRows = (finalists ?? []) as FinalistRow[];
    if (!finalistRows.length) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, error: "Demo finalists must be advanced before finals results can be seeded." },
        { status: 409 }
      );
    }

    const problemCount = Math.max(1, Math.min(finalsRoundRow.problem_count ?? competitionRow.finals_problem_count ?? 4, 8));
    const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
    const attempts = finalistRows.flatMap((finalist, finalistIndex) =>
      Array.from({ length: problemCount }, (_, problemIndex) => {
        const climbNumber = problemIndex + 1;
        const score = buildDemoFinalScore({
          competitionId: competitionRow.id,
          roundId: finalsRoundRow.id,
          climberId: finalist.climber_id,
          qualifierRank: finalist.qualifier_rank,
          climbingOrder: finalist.climbing_order,
          finalistIndex,
          climbNumber,
          problemCount,
        });
        return {
          competition_id: competitionRow.id,
          round_id: finalsRoundRow.id,
          climber_id: finalist.climber_id,
          climb_number: climbNumber,
          top: score.top,
          zone: score.zone,
          attempts_to_top: score.attempts_to_top,
          attempts_to_zone: score.attempts_to_zone,
          entered_by: "staff",
          updated_at: timestamp,
        };
      })
    );

    const { error: deleteError } = await supabase
      .from("final_attempts")
      .delete()
      .eq("competition_id", competitionRow.id)
      .eq("round_id", finalsRoundRow.id);

    if (deleteError) {
      throw new Error(deleteError.message);
    }

    const { error: upsertError } = await supabase.from("final_attempts").upsert(attempts, {
      onConflict: "competition_id,round_id,climber_id,climb_number",
    });

    if (upsertError) {
      throw new Error(upsertError.message);
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      ok: true,
      competitionId: competitionRow.id,
      inserted: {
        finalists: finalistRows.length,
        attempts: attempts.length,
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("DEMO FINALS RESULTS ERROR:", error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { ok: false, error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unable to seed demo finals results." },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

class SupabaseQueryMock {
  private operation: "select" | "insert" | "update" | "delete" | null = null;
  private payload: unknown = null;

  constructor(private readonly table: string) {}

  select() {
    if (this.operation !== "insert") {
      this.operation = "select";
    }
    return this;
  }

  insert(payload: unknown) {
    this.operation = "insert";
    this.payload = payload;
    return this;
  }

  update(payload: unknown) {
    this.operation = "update";
    this.payload = payload;
    return this;
  }

  delete() {
    this.operation = "delete";
    return this;
  }

  eq() {
    return this;
  }

  neq() {
    return this;
  }

  in() {
    return this;
  }

  or() {
    return this;
  }

  order() {
    return this;
  }

  limit() {
    return this;
  }

  async maybeSingle(): Promise<QueryResult> {
    if (this.table === "competitions") {
      return { data: mockState.competition, error: null };
    }

    return { data: null, error: null };
  }

  async single(): Promise<QueryResult> {
    if (this.table === "competition_rounds" && this.operation === "insert") {
      mockState.inserts.push({ table: this.table, payload: this.payload });
      return { data: { id: "round-qualifier" }, error: null };
    }

    if (this.table === "competition_schedule_blocks" && this.operation === "insert") {
      mockState.inserts.push({ table: this.table, payload: this.payload });
      return { data: { id: "session-1" }, error: null };
    }

    return { data: { id: "inserted" }, error: null };
  }

  then<TResult1 = QueryResult, TResult2 = never>(
    onfulfilled?: ((value: QueryResult) => TResult1 | PromiseLike<TResult1>) | null,
    onrejected?: ((reason: unknown) => TResult2 | PromiseLike<TResult2>) | null
  ) {
    return this.resolve().then(onfulfilled, onrejected);
  }

  private async resolve(): Promise<QueryResult> {
    if (this.operation === "update") {
      mockState.updates.push({ table: this.table, payload: this.payload as Record<string, unknown> });
      return { error: null };
    }

    if (this.operation === "delete") {
      mockState.deletes.push({ table: this.table });
      return { error: null };
    }

    if (this.table === "competition_categories") {
      return { data: mockState.categories, error: null };
    }

    if (this.table === "competition_rounds") {
      return { data: mockState.rounds, error: null };
    }

    if (this.table === "competition_schedule_blocks") {
      return { data: mockState.scheduleBlocks, error: null };
    }

    if (this.table === "climbers" && this.operation === "select") {
      return { data: mockState.existingClimbers, error: null };
    }

    if (this.table === "climbers" && this.operation === "insert") {
      mockState.inserts.push({ table: this.table, payload: this.payload });
      const payload = Array.isArray(this.payload)
        ? (this.payload as Array<{ id: string; climber_number: string }>)
        : [];
      mockState.insertedClimbers = payload.map((row) => ({
        id: row.id,
        climber_number: row.climber_number,
      }));
      return { data: mockState.insertedClimbers, error: null };
    }

    if (this.table === "qualifier_attempts" && this.operation === "insert") {
      mockState.inserts.push({ table: this.table, payload: this.payload });
      mockState.insertedAttempts = Array.isArray(this.payload)
        ? (this.payload as typeof mockState.insertedAttempts)
        : [];
      return { error: null };
    }

    return { data: null, error: null };
  }
}

vi.mock("@/lib/server-supabase", () => ({

  }),
}));

  return new Request("http://localhost/api/demo/seed", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify(payload),
  }) as NextRequest;
}

describe("demo seed route", () => {
  it("refuses to seed non-demo competitions", async () => {
    mockState.competition = {
      ...mockState.competition,
      is_demo: false,
    };

    const response = await POST(jsonRequest({ competitionId: "competition-1" }));

    expect(response.status).toBe(403);
    expect(mockState.insertedClimbers).toEqual([]);
    expect(mockState.insertedAttempts).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("requires at least one selected category", async () => {
    mockState.competition = {
      ...mockState.competition,
      qualifier_eligible_age_groups: [],
      finals_eligible_age_groups: [],
    };

    const response = await POST(jsonRequest({ competitionId: "competition-1" }));
    const body = await response.json();

    expect(response.status).toBe(409);
    expect(body.error).toBe("You must add at least one category");
    expect(mockState.insertedClimbers).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("rejects setup without a finals scoring round", async () => {
    mockState.rounds = mockState.rounds.filter((round) => round.scoring_bucket !== "finals");

    const response = await POST(jsonRequest({ competitionId: "competition-1" }));
    const body = await response.json();

    expect(response.status).toBe(409);
    expect(body.error).toBe("Add a Finals stage.");
    expect(mockState.insertedClimbers).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("rejects setup without a linked finals schedule block", async () => {
    mockState.scheduleBlocks = mockState.scheduleBlocks.filter((block) => block.phase_type !== "finals_round");

    const response = await POST(jsonRequest({ competitionId: "competition-1" }));
    const body = await response.json();

    expect(response.status).toBe(409);
    expect(body.error).toBe("Add a Finals schedule block linked to the Finals stage.");
    expect(mockState.insertedClimbers).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("rejects setup without a linked semifinal schedule block", async () => {
    const qualifierRound = mockState.rounds[0];
    const finalsRound = mockState.rounds[1];
    mockState.rounds = [
      qualifierRound,
      {
        ...qualifierRound,
        id: "round-semi",
        round_number: 2,
        sort_order: 2,
        name: "Semifinal",
        round_type: "semifinal",
        problem_count: 4,
        counting_climbs: 4,
      },
      {
        ...finalsRound,
        round_number: 3,
        sort_order: 3,
        advancement_source_round_id: "round-semi",
      },
    ];

    const response = await POST(jsonRequest({ competitionId: "competition-1" }));
    const body = await response.json();

    expect(response.status).toBe(409);
    expect(body.error).toBe("Add a semifinal schedule block linked to the Semifinal stage.");
    expect(mockState.insertedClimbers).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("seeds realistic Summit Series climbers, scores, and the correction target", async () => {
    const response = await POST(jsonRequest({ competitionId: "competition-1" }));
    const body = await response.json();
    const climberInsert = mockState.inserts.find((entry) => entry.table === "climbers")?.payload as
      | Array<{ name: string; province: string; climber_number: string }>
      | undefined;
    const target = mockState.insertedClimbers.find(
      (climber) => climber.climber_number === DEMO_TARGET_CLIMBER_NUMBER
    );
    const targetB3 = mockState.insertedAttempts.find(
      (attempt) => attempt.climber_id === target?.id && attempt.climb_number === DEMO_TARGET_CLIMB_NUMBER
    );

    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    expect(body).toMatchObject({
      ok: true,
      competitionId: "competition-1",
      slug: "summit-demo",
      activeRoundId: "round-qualifier",
      target: {
        climberNumber: DEMO_TARGET_CLIMBER_NUMBER,
        before: DEMO_TARGET_BEFORE_LABEL,
      },
      inserted: {
        climbers: 36,
        attempts: 216,
      },
    });
    expect(climberInsert?.[0].name).toMatch(/^[A-Z][a-z]+ [A-Z][A-Za-z]+$/);
    expect(climberInsert?.[0].name).not.toBe("Athlete A");
    expect(climberInsert?.[0].province).toMatch(/^[A-Z]{2}$/);
    expect(body.target.name).not.toBe("Athlete C");
    expect(targetB3).toMatchObject({
      attempt_count: 3,
      topped: true,
      zone: true,
      attempts_to_top: 3,
      attempts_to_zone: 1,
    });
    expect(body.judgeUrl).toContain("/staff/c/summit-demo/judge?demo=act2");
    expect(body.judgeUrl).toContain("boulder=3");
    expect(body.judgeUrl).toContain(`climberId=${target?.id}`);
    expect(body.organizerUrl).toBe("/staff/c/summit-demo?demo=act3");
    expect(body.publicUrl).toBe("/c/summit-demo?demo=act4");
  });

  it("seeds semifinal scores when Finals advance from a semifinal", async () => {
    const qualifierRound = mockState.rounds[0];
    const finalsRound = mockState.rounds[1];
    mockState.rounds = [
      qualifierRound,
      {
        ...qualifierRound,
        id: "round-semi",
        round_number: 2,
        sort_order: 2,
        name: "Semifinal",
        round_type: "semifinal",
        problem_count: 4,
        counting_climbs: 4,
      },
      {
        ...finalsRound,
        round_number: 3,
        sort_order: 3,
        advancement_source_round_id: "round-semi",
      },
    ];
    mockState.scheduleBlocks = [
      mockState.scheduleBlocks[0],
      {
        ...mockState.scheduleBlocks[0],
        id: "session-semi",
        round_id: "round-semi",
        label: "Semifinal",
        sort_order: 2,
      },
      {
        ...mockState.scheduleBlocks[1],
        sort_order: 3,
      },
    ];

    const response = await POST(jsonRequest({ competitionId: "competition-1" }));
    const body = await response.json();

    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    expect(body.inserted).toMatchObject({
      attempts: 360,
      qualifierRounds: 2,
      semifinalsSeeded: true,
      advancementSourceRoundId: "round-semi",
    });
    expect(mockState.insertedAttempts.some((attempt) => attempt.round_id === "round-semi")).toBe(true);
  });

  it("clears previous seeded rows before inserting fresh demo data", async () => {
    mockState.existingClimbers = [{ id: "old-athlete-c" }];

    const response = await POST(jsonRequest({ competitionId: "competition-1" }));

    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    expect(mockState.deletes.map((entry) => entry.table)).toEqual(
      expect.arrayContaining(["competition_finalists", "final_attempts", "qualifier_attempts", "climbers"])
    );
    expect(mockState.insertedClimbers).toHaveLength(36);
  });
});

  has_finals: boolean | null;

  age_group: string;
  display_name: string;
  sort_order?: number | null;
