function createId() {
  return crypto.randomUUID();
}

function asStringArray(value: unknown) {
  return Array.isArray(value) ? value.filter((entry): entry is string => typeof entry === "string") : [];
}

async function getCompetition(
  supabase: ReturnType<typeof createServiceRoleSupabaseClient>,
  body: DemoSeedRequest
) {
  const query = supabase
    .from("competitions")
    .select(
      "id, slug, name, is_demo, format, has_finals, location_name, start_date, end_date, total_climbs, qualifier_counting_climbs, finals_cutoff, finals_problem_count, qualifier_eligible_age_groups, finals_eligible_age_groups, current_phase"
    )
    .limit(1);

  const { data, error } = body.competitionId
    ? await query.eq("id", body.competitionId).maybeSingle()
    : await query.eq("slug", body.slug ?? "").maybeSingle();

  if (error) {
    throw new Error(error.message);
  }

  return data as CompetitionRow | null;
}

async function getCompetitionCategories(
  supabase: ReturnType<typeof createServiceRoleSupabaseClient>,
  competition: CompetitionRow
) {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("competition_categories")
    .select("id, competition_id, gender_division, age_group, display_name, sort_order")
    .eq("competition_id", competition.id)
    .order("sort_order", { ascending: true });

  if (error) {
    throw new Error(error.message);
  }

  return (data ?? []) as CategoryRow[];
}

async function getCompetitionRounds(
  supabase: ReturnType<typeof createServiceRoleSupabaseClient>,
  competition: CompetitionRow
) {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("competition_rounds")
    .select(
      "id, competition_id, round_number, sort_order, name, round_type, format, status, runtime_phase, is_enabled, is_active, activated_at, problem_count, counting_climbs, finals_cutoff, eligible_category_ids, advancement_source_round_id, advancement_cutoff, scoring_bucket, scoring_config, started_at, closed_at"
    )
    .eq("competition_id", competition.id)
    .order("sort_order", { ascending: true });

  if (error) {
    throw new Error(error.message);
  }

  return (data ?? []) as RoundRow[];
}

async function getCompetitionScheduleBlocks(
  supabase: ReturnType<typeof createServiceRoleSupabaseClient>,
  competition: CompetitionRow
) {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("competition_schedule_blocks")
    .select(
      "id, competition_id, round_id, sort_order, label, phase_type, audience_label, is_active, start_time, end_time, capacity, eligible_category_ids"
    )
    .eq("competition_id", competition.id)
    .order("sort_order", { ascending: true });

  if (error) {
    throw new Error(error.message);
  }

  return (data ?? []) as ScheduleBlockRow[];
}

function asNumber(value: number | null | undefined, fallback: number) {
  return typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : fallback;
}

function asFinalsCutoff(value: number | null | undefined): 6 | 8 | null {
  if (value === 8) {
    return 8;
  }
  if (value === 6) {
    return 6;
  }
  return null;
}

function buildSetupCompetition(
  competition: CompetitionRow,
  categories: CategoryRow[],
  rounds: RoundRow[],
  scheduleBlocks: ScheduleBlockRow[]
) {
  return {
    id: competition.id,
    slug: competition.slug,
    name: competition.name ?? "",
    is_demo: competition.is_demo,
    format: (competition.format ?? "scramble") as Competition["format"],
    has_finals: competition.has_finals === true,
    location_name: competition.location_name ?? "",
    start_date: competition.start_date,
    end_date: competition.end_date,
    total_climbs: asNumber(competition.total_climbs, DEMO_DEFAULT_QUALIFIER_PROBLEM_COUNT),
    qualifier_counting_climbs: asNumber(
      competition.qualifier_counting_climbs,
      DEMO_DEFAULT_QUALIFIER_PROBLEM_COUNT
    ),
    finals_cutoff: asFinalsCutoff(competition.finals_cutoff) ?? 6,
    finals_problem_count: asNumber(competition.finals_problem_count, 4),
    qualifier_eligible_age_groups: asStringArray(competition.qualifier_eligible_age_groups),
    finals_eligible_age_groups: asStringArray(competition.finals_eligible_age_groups),
    categories: categories.map((category) => ({
      ...category,
      sort_order: category.sort_order ?? 0,
    })),
    rounds: rounds.map((round, index) => ({
      id: round.id,
      competition_id: round.competition_id ?? competition.id,
      round_number: round.round_number ?? index + 1,
      sort_order: round.sort_order ?? index + 1,
      name: round.name ?? "",
      round_type: (round.round_type ?? "qualifier") as CompetitionRound["round_type"],
      format: (round.format ?? competition.format ?? "scramble") as CompetitionRound["format"],
      status: (round.status ?? "pending") as CompetitionRound["status"],
      runtime_phase: (round.runtime_phase ?? "qualifier_open") as CompetitionRound["runtime_phase"],
      is_enabled: round.is_enabled !== false,
      is_active: round.is_active === true,
      activated_at: round.activated_at ?? null,
      problem_count: asNumber(round.problem_count, 0),
      counting_climbs: typeof round.counting_climbs === "number" ? round.counting_climbs : null,
      finals_cutoff: asFinalsCutoff(round.finals_cutoff),
      eligible_category_ids: asStringArray(round.eligible_category_ids),
      advancement_source_round_id: round.advancement_source_round_id ?? null,
      advancement_cutoff: typeof round.advancement_cutoff === "number" ? round.advancement_cutoff : null,
      scoring_bucket: (round.scoring_bucket ?? "none") as CompetitionRound["scoring_bucket"],
      scoring_config:
        round.scoring_config && typeof round.scoring_config === "object" && !Array.isArray(round.scoring_config)
          ? (round.scoring_config as Record<string, unknown>)
          : {},
      started_at: round.started_at ?? null,
      closed_at: round.closed_at ?? null,
    })),
    schedule_blocks: scheduleBlocks.map((block, index) => ({
      id: block.id,
      competition_id: block.competition_id ?? competition.id,
      round_id: block.round_id,
      sort_order: block.sort_order ?? index + 1,
      label: block.label ?? "",
      phase_type: (block.phase_type ?? "custom") as CompetitionScheduleBlock["phase_type"],
      audience_label: block.audience_label ?? "",
      is_active: block.is_active === true,
      start_time: block.start_time ?? null,
      end_time: block.end_time ?? null,
      capacity: asNumber(block.capacity, 0),
      eligible_category_ids: asStringArray(block.eligible_category_ids),
    })),
  };
}

type PreparedQualifierRound = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  roundIndex: number;
  roundType: string | null | undefined;
  problemCount: number;
};

async function prepareQualifierRounds(
  supabase: ReturnType<typeof createServiceRoleSupabaseClient>,
  competition: CompetitionRow,
  qualifierRounds: ReturnType<typeof getDemoQualifierStyleRounds>
): Promise<PreparedQualifierRound[]> {
  if (!qualifierRounds.length) {
    throw new Response("Add a qualifier scoring stage.", { status: 409 });
  }

  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const prepared: PreparedQualifierRound[] = [];
  for (let roundIndex = 0; roundIndex < qualifierRounds.length; roundIndex += 1) {
    const round = qualifierRounds[roundIndex];
    const fallbackProblemCount =
      round.round_type === "semifinal"
        ? Math.min(DEMO_DEFAULT_QUALIFIER_PROBLEM_COUNT, Math.max(4, competition.total_climbs ?? 4))
        : (competition.total_climbs ?? DEMO_DEFAULT_QUALIFIER_PROBLEM_COUNT);
    const problemCount = Math.max(
      asNumber(round.problem_count, fallbackProblemCount),
      roundIndex === 0 ? DEMO_TARGET_CLIMB_NUMBER : 1
    );
    const countingClimbs = Math.min(
      Math.max(asNumber(round.counting_climbs, competition.qualifier_counting_climbs ?? problemCount), 1),
      problemCount
    );
    const active = roundIndex === 0;
    const update = await supabase
      .from("competition_rounds")
      .update({
        status: active ? "scoring" : "pending",
        runtime_phase: round.round_type === "semifinal" ? "wall_reset" : "qualifier_open",
        is_enabled: true,
        is_active: active,
        activated_at: active ? now : null,
        started_at: active ? now : null,
        closed_at: null,
        problem_count: problemCount,
        counting_climbs: countingClimbs,
        scoring_bucket: "qualifier",
      })
      .eq("competition_id", competition.id)
      .eq("id", round.id);

    if (update.error) {
      throw new Error(update.error.message);
    }

    prepared.push({
      id: round.id,
      name: round.name || (round.round_type === "semifinal" ? "Semifinal" : "Qualifier"),
      roundIndex,
      roundType: round.round_type,
      problemCount,
    });
  }

  return prepared;
}

async function prepareQualifierSessions(
  supabase: ReturnType<typeof createServiceRoleSupabaseClient>,
  competitionId: string,
  setupCompetition: ReturnType<typeof buildSetupCompetition>,
  qualifierRounds: ReturnType<typeof getDemoQualifierStyleRounds>,
  categoryIds: string[],
  fieldSize: number
) {
  let firstSessionId: string | null = null;
  for (let index = 0; index < qualifierRounds.length; index += 1) {
    const round = qualifierRounds[index];
    const session = getDemoScheduleBlockForRound(setupCompetition, round);
    if (!session?.id) {
      throw new Response(
        round.round_type === "semifinal"
          ? "Add a semifinal schedule block linked to the Semifinal stage."
          : "Add a qualifier schedule block linked to the qualifier stage.",
        { status: 409 }
      );
    }

    const update = await supabase
      .from("competition_schedule_blocks")
      .update({
        is_active: index === 0,
        capacity: Math.max(session.capacity ?? 0, DEMO_MIN_FIELD_SIZE, fieldSize),
        eligible_category_ids: categoryIds,
      })
      .eq("competition_id", competitionId)
      .eq("id", session.id);

    if (update.error) {
      throw new Error(update.error.message);
    }

    firstSessionId ??= session.id;
  }

  if (!firstSessionId) {
    throw new Response("Add a qualifier schedule block linked to the qualifier stage.", { status: 409 });
  }

  return firstSessionId;
}

async function resetDemoProgress(
  supabase: ReturnType<typeof createServiceRoleSupabaseClient>,
  competitionId: string,
  qualifierRoundId: string,
  qualifierSessionId: string
) {
  const finalistDelete = await supabase.from("competition_finalists").delete().eq("competition_id", competitionId);
  if (finalistDelete.error) {
    throw new Error(finalistDelete.error.message);
  }

  const finalAttemptDelete = await supabase.from("final_attempts").delete().eq("competition_id", competitionId);
  if (finalAttemptDelete.error) {
    throw new Error(finalAttemptDelete.error.message);
  }

  const competitionUpdate = await supabase
    .from("competitions")
    .update({
      current_phase: "qualifier_open",
      stage_mode: "qualifier",
      qualifier_locked_at: null,
      finals_started_at: null,
    })
    .eq("id", competitionId);
  if (competitionUpdate.error) {
    throw new Error(competitionUpdate.error.message);
  }

  const inactiveRounds = await supabase
    .from("competition_rounds")
    .update({
      status: "pending",
      is_active: false,
      activated_at: null,
      started_at: null,
      closed_at: null,
    })
    .eq("competition_id", competitionId)
    .neq("id", qualifierRoundId);
  if (inactiveRounds.error) {
    throw new Error(inactiveRounds.error.message);
  }

  const activeRound = await supabase
    .from("competition_rounds")
    .update({
      status: "scoring",
      is_active: true,
      closed_at: null,
    })
    .eq("competition_id", competitionId)
    .eq("id", qualifierRoundId);
  if (activeRound.error) {
    throw new Error(activeRound.error.message);
  }

  const clearBlocks = await supabase
    .from("competition_schedule_blocks")
    .update({ is_active: false })
    .eq("competition_id", competitionId);
  if (clearBlocks.error) {
    throw new Error(clearBlocks.error.message);
  }

  const activateBlock = await supabase
    .from("competition_schedule_blocks")
    .update({ is_active: true })
    .eq("competition_id", competitionId)
    .eq("id", qualifierSessionId);
  if (activateBlock.error) {
    throw new Error(activateBlock.error.message);
  }
}

async function clearPreviousSeed(
  supabase: ReturnType<typeof createServiceRoleSupabaseClient>,
  competitionId: string,
  climberNumbers: string[]
) {
  const { data: existingClimbers, error } = await supabase
    .from("climbers")
    .select("id")
    .eq("competition_id", competitionId)
    .in("climber_number", climberNumbers);

  if (error) {
    throw new Error(error.message);
  }

  const climberIds = (existingClimbers ?? []).map((climber) => climber.id as string);
  if (!climberIds.length) {
    return;
  }

  const qualifierDelete = await supabase.from("qualifier_attempts").delete().in("climber_id", climberIds);
  if (qualifierDelete.error) {
    throw new Error(qualifierDelete.error.message);
  }

  const finalDelete = await supabase.from("final_attempts").delete().in("climber_id", climberIds);
  if (finalDelete.error) {
    throw new Error(finalDelete.error.message);
  }

  const finalistDelete = await supabase.from("competition_finalists").delete().in("climber_id", climberIds);
  if (finalistDelete.error) {
    throw new Error(finalistDelete.error.message);
  }

  const climberDelete = await supabase.from("climbers").delete().in("id", climberIds);
  if (climberDelete.error) {
    throw new Error(climberDelete.error.message);
  }
}

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  let body: DemoSeedRequest;

  try {
    body = (await request.json()) as DemoSeedRequest;
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Invalid request body." }, { status: 400 });
  }

  if (!body.competitionId && !body.slug) {
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "competitionId or slug is required." }, { status: 400 });
  }

  try {
    const supabase = createServiceRoleSupabaseClient();
    const competition = await getCompetition(supabase, body);

    if (!competition) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Competition not found." }, { status: 404 });
    }

    if (competition.is_demo !== true) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, error: "Refusing to seed sample data into a non-demo competition." },
        { status: 403 }
      );
    }

    const allCategories = await getCompetitionCategories(supabase, competition);
    const rounds = await getCompetitionRounds(supabase, competition);
    const scheduleBlocks = await getCompetitionScheduleBlocks(supabase, competition);
    const setupCompetition = buildSetupCompetition(competition, allCategories, rounds, scheduleBlocks);
    const setupValidation = getDemoSetupValidation(setupCompetition, {
      requirePreset: false,
      saved: true,
    });

    if (!setupValidation.canContinueToJudge) {
      throw new Response(setupValidation.firstBlockingMessage ?? "Complete the demo setup before seeding.", {
        status: 409,
      });
    }

    const selectedCategoryIds = new Set(getDemoSelectedQualifierCategories(setupCompetition).map((category) => category.id));
    const categories = allCategories.filter((category) => selectedCategoryIds.has(category.id));
    const categoryIds = categories.map((category) => category.id);
    const targetFieldSize = getDemoFieldSize(categories.length);
    const qualifierStyleRounds = getDemoQualifierStyleRounds(setupCompetition);
    const advancementSourceRound = getDemoAdvancementSourceRound(setupCompetition);
    const preparedQualifierRounds = await prepareQualifierRounds(supabase, competition, qualifierStyleRounds);
    const qualifierSessionId = await prepareQualifierSessions(
      supabase,
      competition.id,
      setupCompetition,
      qualifierStyleRounds,
      categoryIds,
      targetFieldSize
    );
    const activeQualifierRound = preparedQualifierRounds[0];

    await resetDemoProgress(supabase, competition.id, activeQualifierRound.id, qualifierSessionId);

    const athleteSeeds = createDemoAthleteSeeds({
      competitionId: competition.id,
      categories,
      fieldSize: targetFieldSize,
    });
    await clearPreviousSeed(
      supabase,
      competition.id,
      athleteSeeds.map((athlete) => athlete.climberNumber)
    );

    const climberRows = athleteSeeds.map((athlete) => {
      const category = athlete.category;
      return {
        id: createId(),
        competition_id: competition.id,
        name: athlete.name,
        climber_number: athlete.climberNumber,
        province: athlete.province,
        category_id: category.id,
        gender_division: category.gender_division,
        age_group: category.age_group,
        display_category: category.display_name,
        time_slot_id: qualifierSessionId,
        access_token: `summit-demo-${competition.id}-${athlete.climberNumber}`,
      };
    });

    const { data: insertedClimbers, error: climberError } = await supabase
      .from("climbers")
      .insert(climberRows)
      .select("id, climber_number");

    if (climberError) {
      throw new Error(climberError.message);
    }

    const insertedRows = (insertedClimbers ?? []) as InsertedClimberRow[];
    const seedByNumber = new Map(athleteSeeds.map((athlete) => [athlete.climberNumber, athlete]));
    const fallbackSeed = athleteSeeds[0];
    if (!fallbackSeed) {
      throw new Response("You must add at least one category", { status: 409 });
    }
    const attempts = preparedQualifierRounds.flatMap((round) =>
      insertedRows.flatMap((climber) => {
        const seed = seedByNumber.get(climber.climber_number) ?? fallbackSeed;
        return Array.from({ length: round.problemCount }, (_, index) => {
          const climbNumber = index + 1;
          return {
            competition_id: competition.id,
            round_id: round.id,
            climber_id: climber.id,
            climb_number: climbNumber,
            entered_by: "staff",
            ...buildDemoQualifierScore({
              competitionId: competition.id,
              roundId: round.id,
              roundIndex: round.roundIndex,
              roundType: round.roundType,
              climber: seed,
              climbNumber,
              problemCount: round.problemCount,
            }),
          };
        });
      })
    );

    const { error: attemptError } = await supabase.from("qualifier_attempts").insert(attempts);
    if (attemptError) {
      throw new Error(attemptError.message);
    }

    const target = insertedRows.find((climber) => climber.climber_number === DEMO_TARGET_CLIMBER_NUMBER);
    const targetClimberId = target?.id ?? null;
    const targetSeed = athleteSeeds.find((athlete) => athlete.climberNumber === DEMO_TARGET_CLIMBER_NUMBER);

    return NextResponse.json({
      ok: true,
      competitionId: competition.id,
      slug: competition.slug,
      activeRoundId: activeQualifierRound.id,
      judgeUrl: buildDemoJudgeUrl(competition.slug, targetClimberId),
      organizerUrl: buildDemoOrganizerUrl(competition.slug),
      publicUrl: buildDemoPublicUrl(competition.slug),
      target: {
        climberId: targetClimberId,
        climberNumber: DEMO_TARGET_CLIMBER_NUMBER,
        name: targetSeed?.name ?? "Demo athlete",
        climbNumber: DEMO_TARGET_CLIMB_NUMBER,
        roundName: activeQualifierRound.name,
        before: DEMO_TARGET_BEFORE_LABEL,
        after: DEMO_TARGET_AFTER_LABEL,
      },
      inserted: {
        climbers: insertedRows.length,
        attempts: attempts.length,
        qualifierRounds: preparedQualifierRounds.length,
        semifinalsSeeded: preparedQualifierRounds.some((round) => round.roundType === "semifinal"),
        advancementSourceRoundId: advancementSourceRound?.id ?? null,
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof Response) {
      const message = await error.text();
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: message }, { status: error.status });
    }

    console.error("DEMO SEED ERROR:", error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { ok: false, error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unable to seed demo data." },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

class SupabaseQueryMock {
  private filters: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  private selectOptions: { count?: string; head?: boolean } | undefined;

  constructor(private readonly table: string) {}

  select(_columns?: string, options?: { count?: string; head?: boolean }) {
    this.selectOptions = options;
    return this;
  }

  eq(column: string, value: unknown) {
    this.filters[column] = value;
    return this;
  }

  order() {
    return this;
  }

  limit() {
    return this;
  }

  async maybeSingle(): Promise<QueryResult> {
    if (this.table === "competitions") {
      return { data: mockState.competition, error: null };
    }

    if (this.table === "climbers" && this.filters.climber_number === DEMO_TARGET_CLIMBER_NUMBER) {
      return { data: mockState.targetClimber, error: null };
    }

    if (this.table === "competition_rounds") {
      return { data: mockState.qualifierRound, error: null };
    }

    if (
      this.table === "qualifier_attempts" &&
      this.filters.round_id === mockState.qualifierRound.id &&
      this.filters.climber_id === mockState.targetClimber.id &&
      this.filters.climb_number === DEMO_TARGET_CLIMB_NUMBER
    ) {
      return { data: mockState.targetAttempt, error: null };
    }

    return { data: null, error: null };
  }

  then<TResult1 = QueryResult, TResult2 = never>(
    onfulfilled?: ((value: QueryResult) => TResult1 | PromiseLike<TResult1>) | null,
    onrejected?: ((reason: unknown) => TResult2 | PromiseLike<TResult2>) | null
  ) {
    return this.resolve().then(onfulfilled, onrejected);
  }

  private async resolve(): Promise<QueryResult> {
    if (this.selectOptions?.head && this.table === "climbers") {
      return { count: mockState.climberCount, error: null };
    }

    if (this.selectOptions?.head && this.table === "qualifier_attempts") {
      return { count: mockState.attemptCount, error: null };
    }

    if (this.selectOptions?.head && this.table === "competition_finalists") {
      return { count: mockState.finalistCount, error: null };
    }

    if (this.selectOptions?.head && this.table === "final_attempts") {
      return { count: mockState.finalAttemptCount, error: null };
    }

    return { data: null, error: null };
  }
}

--- src\app\api\demo\state\route.ts ---

import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { createServiceRoleSupabaseClient } from "@/lib/server-supabase";
import {
  DEMO_TARGET_AFTER_LABEL,
  DEMO_TARGET_BEFORE_LABEL,
  DEMO_TARGET_CLIMB_NUMBER,
  DEMO_TARGET_CLIMBER_NUMBER,
  isDemoTargetCorrected,
  isDemoTargetSeeded,
  type DemoTargetAttemptState,
} from "@/lib/demo-scenario";

type CompetitionRow = {
  id: string;
  slug: string;
  is_demo: boolean;
  current_phase: string | null;
  qualifier_locked_at: string | null;
  finals_started_at: string | null;
};

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

function getSingleCount(result: { count?: number | null }) {
  return result.count ?? 0;
}

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  const competitionId = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get("competitionId")?.trim() ?? "";
  const slug = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get("slug")?.trim() ?? "";

  if (!competitionId && !slug) {
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "competitionId or slug is required." }, { status: 400 });
  }

  try {
    const supabase = createServiceRoleSupabaseClient();
    const competitionQuery = supabase
      .from("competitions")
      .select("id, slug, is_demo, current_phase, qualifier_locked_at, finals_started_at")
      .limit(1);
    const { data: competition, error: competitionError } = competitionId
      ? await competitionQuery.eq("id", competitionId).maybeSingle()
      : await competitionQuery.eq("slug", slug).maybeSingle();

    if (competitionError) {
      throw new Error(competitionError.message);
    }

    const competitionRow = competition as CompetitionRow | null;
    if (!competitionRow) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Demo competition not found." }, { status: 404 });
    }

    if (competitionRow.is_demo !== true) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Refusing to read demo state for a non-demo competition." }, { status: 403 });
    }

    const [
      climberCountResult,
      attemptCountResult,
      finalistCountResult,
      finalAttemptCountResult,
      qualifierRoundResult,
      targetClimberResult,
    ] = await Promise.all([
      supabase.from("climbers").select("id", { count: "exact", head: true }).eq("competition_id", competitionRow.id),
      supabase.from("qualifier_attempts").select("id", { count: "exact", head: true }).eq("competition_id", competitionRow.id),
      supabase.from("competition_finalists").select("climber_id", { count: "exact", head: true }).eq("competition_id", competitionRow.id),
      supabase.from("final_attempts").select("id", { count: "exact", head: true }).eq("competition_id", competitionRow.id),
      supabase
        .from("competition_rounds")
        .select("id, name")
        .eq("competition_id", competitionRow.id)
        .eq("scoring_bucket", "qualifier")
        .order("sort_order", { ascending: true })
        .limit(1)
        .maybeSingle(),
      supabase
        .from("climbers")
        .select("id, name, climber_number")
        .eq("competition_id", competitionRow.id)
        .eq("climber_number", DEMO_TARGET_CLIMBER_NUMBER)
        .maybeSingle(),
    ]);

    for (const result of [
      climberCountResult,
      attemptCountResult,
      finalistCountResult,
      finalAttemptCountResult,
      qualifierRoundResult,
      targetClimberResult,
    ]) {
      if (result.error) {
        throw new Error(result.error.message);
      }
    }

    const targetClimber = targetClimberResult.data as { id: string; name: string; climber_number: string } | null;
    const qualifierRound = qualifierRoundResult.data as { id: string; name: string | null } | null;
    const { data: targetAttempt, error: targetAttemptError } = targetClimber
      ? await supabase
          .from("qualifier_attempts")
          .select("attempt_count, topped, zone, attempts_to_top, attempts_to_zone")
          .eq("competition_id", competitionRow.id)
          .eq("round_id", qualifierRound?.id ?? "")
          .eq("climber_id", targetClimber.id)
          .eq("climb_number", DEMO_TARGET_CLIMB_NUMBER)
          .maybeSingle()
      : { data: null, error: null };

    if (targetAttemptError) {
      throw new Error(targetAttemptError.message);
    }

    const attempt = targetAttempt as DemoTargetAttemptState;
    const climberCount = getSingleCount(climberCountResult);
    const attemptCount = getSingleCount(attemptCountResult);
    const finalistCount = getSingleCount(finalistCountResult);
    const finalAttemptCount = getSingleCount(finalAttemptCountResult);
    const dataPopulated = climberCount > 0 && attemptCount > 0 && Boolean(targetClimber && targetAttempt);
    const finalsStarted = Boolean(competitionRow.finals_started_at) || ["finals_open", "finals_closed", "results"].includes(competitionRow.current_phase ?? "");
    const publicReady = finalistCount > 0 && finalAttemptCount >= finalistCount && finalsStarted;

    return NextResponse.json({
      ok: true,
      competition: {
        id: competitionRow.id,
        slug: competitionRow.slug,
      },
      target: {
        climberId: targetClimber?.id ?? null,
        climberNumber: DEMO_TARGET_CLIMBER_NUMBER,
        name: targetClimber?.name ?? null,
        climbNumber: DEMO_TARGET_CLIMB_NUMBER,
        roundName: qualifierRound?.name ?? "Qualifier",
        before: DEMO_TARGET_BEFORE_LABEL,
        after: DEMO_TARGET_AFTER_LABEL,
        attempt,
        seeded: isDemoTargetSeeded(attempt),
        corrected: isDemoTargetCorrected(attempt),
      },
      counts: {
        climbers: climberCount,
        attempts: attemptCount,
        finalists: finalistCount,
        finalAttempts: finalAttemptCount,
      },
      progress: {
        eventReady: true,
        dataPopulated,
        keyScoreCorrected: isDemoTargetCorrected(attempt),
        organizerAdvanced: dataPopulated && finalistCount > 0 && finalsStarted,
        publicReady,
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("DEMO STATE ERROR:", error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { ok: false, error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unable to load demo state." },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

--- src\app\api\qr\route.ts ---

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";

const DEFAULT_SIZE = 180;
const MIN_SIZE = 120;
const MAX_SIZE = 1024;

function normalizeSize(value: string | null) {
  const parsed = Number.parseInt(value ?? "", 10);
  if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) {
    return DEFAULT_SIZE;
  }

  return Math.min(MAX_SIZE, Math.max(MIN_SIZE, parsed));
}

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  const data = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get("data")?.trim() ?? "";
  const size = normalizeSize(request.nextUrl.searchParams.get("size"));

  if (!data) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Missing QR data." }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const upstreamUrl = `https://api.qrserver.com/v1/create-qr-code/?size=${size}x${size}&data=${encodeURIComponent(data)}`;
  const response = await fetch(upstreamUrl, {
    headers: {
      Accept: "image/png",
    },
    next: {
      revalidate: 3600,
    },
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unable to generate QR code." }, { status: 502 });
  }

  const imageBuffer = await response.arrayBuffer();

  return new NextResponse(imageBuffer, {
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": response.headers.get("Content-Type") ?? "image/png",
      "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=3600, s-maxage=3600",
    },
  });
}

import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";

import { POST } from "./route";

function jsonRequest(payload: unknown) {
  return new Request("http://localhost/api/staff/competitions/actions", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify(payload),
  }) as NextRequest;
}

beforeEach(() => {
  mockState.user = { id: "user-1" };
  mockState.role = "admin";
  mockState.updatePayload = null;
  mockState.getUser.mockReset();
  mockState.getUser.mockImplementation(async () => ({
    data: { user: mockState.user },
    error: null,
  }));
  mockState.routeFrom.mockReset();
  mockState.routeFrom.mockImplementation((table: string) => {
    if (table !== "profiles") {
      throw new Error(`Unexpected route table ${table}`);
    }

    const query = {
      select: vi.fn(() => query),
      eq: vi.fn(() => query),
      maybeSingle: vi.fn(async () => ({
        data: mockState.role ? { role: mockState.role } : null,
        error: null,
      })),
    };
    return query;
  });
  mockState.serviceFrom.mockReset();
  mockState.serviceFrom.mockImplementation((table: string) => {
    if (table !== "competitions") {
      throw new Error(`Unexpected service table ${table}`);
    }

    return {
      select: vi.fn(() => ({
        eq: vi.fn(() => ({
          maybeSingle: vi.fn(async () => ({
            data: { id: "competition-1", status: "active" },
            error: null,
          })),
        })),
      })),
      update: vi.fn((payload: unknown) => {
        mockState.updatePayload = payload;
        return {
          eq: vi.fn(async () => ({ error: null })),
        };
      }),
    };
  });
  mockState.serviceRpc.mockReset();
  mockState.serviceRpc.mockImplementation(async () => ({ data: null, error: null }));
});

describe("admin competition action route security boundaries", () => {
  it("returns 401 for unauthenticated admin actions", async () => {
    mockState.user = null;

    const response = await POST(jsonRequest({ action: "set_status", competitionId: "competition-1", status: "archived" }));

    expect(response.status).toBe(401);
    expect(mockState.serviceFrom).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("returns 403 for non-admin staff actions", async () => {
    mockState.role = "judge";

    const response = await POST(jsonRequest({ action: "set_status", competitionId: "competition-1", status: "archived" }));

    expect(response.status).toBe(403);
    expect(mockState.serviceFrom).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("runs admin actions through the service-role server path", async () => {
    const response = await POST(jsonRequest({ action: "set_status", competitionId: "competition-1", status: "archived" }));

    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    expect(mockState.serviceFrom).toHaveBeenCalledWith("competitions");
    expect(mockState.updatePayload).toEqual({ status: "archived" });
  });
});


--- src\app\api\staff\competitions\actions\route.ts ---

import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/server-auth";
import {
  getAdminCompetitionActionErrorStatus,
  handleAdminCompetitionAction,
  type AdminCompetitionActionRequest,
} from "@/lib/server-admin-competition-actions";

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  let payload: AdminCompetitionActionRequest;

  try {
    payload = (await request.json()) as AdminCompetitionActionRequest;
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid request body." }, { status: 400 });
  }

  try {
    const auth = await requireAdmin();
    if (!auth.ok) {
      return auth.response;
    }

    const result = await handleAdminCompetitionAction(payload);
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, ...result });
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unable to complete admin action.";
    return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status: getAdminCompetitionActionErrorStatus(message) });
  }
}


--- src\app\api\staff\competitions\snapshot\route.ts ---

import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { getCompetitionSnapshot } from "@/lib/db";
import { requireStaff } from "@/lib/server-auth";
import { createServiceRoleSupabaseClient } from "@/lib/server-supabase";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

function getErrorMessage(error: unknown) {
  return error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unable to load competition snapshot.";
}

function getErrorStatus(message: string) {
  if (/not found/i.test(message)) {
    return 404;
  }

  return 500;
}

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  const auth = await requireStaff();
  if (!auth.ok) {
    return auth.response;
  }

  const identifier =
    request.nextUrl.searchParams.get("identifier") ??
    request.nextUrl.searchParams.get("slug") ??
    "";

  if (!identifier.trim()) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Competition identifier is required." }, { status: 400 });
  }

  try {
    const adminSupabase = createServiceRoleSupabaseClient();
    const snapshot = await getCompetitionSnapshot(identifier, { readClient: adminSupabase });

    return NextResponse.json(
      { snapshot },
      {
        headers: {
          "Cache-Control": "no-store",
        },
      }
    );
  } catch (error) {
    const message = getErrorMessage(error);
    console.error("STAFF SNAPSHOT ERROR:", error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status: getErrorStatus(message) });
  }
}


--- src\app\api\staff\scores\final\route.ts ---

import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { normalizeFinalAttemptInput } from "@/lib/attempts";
import { getStaffScoreErrorStatus, normalizeStaffScoreRpcResult } from "@/lib/staff-score-api";
import { isPositiveInteger, readJsonBody, requireStaffScoreClient, trimOrNull } from "../_shared";

type FinalScoreRequest = {
  competitionId?: string;
  climberId?: string;
  climbNumber?: number;
  top?: boolean;
  zone?: boolean;
  attemptsToTop?: number | null;
  attemptsToZone?: number | null;
  clientEventId?: string;
  scoredAt?: string;
  judgeDeviceId?: string | null;
  judgeSessionId?: string | null;
  replayedFromOffline?: boolean;
};

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  const { payload, response: bodyError } = await readJsonBody<FinalScoreRequest>(request);
  if (bodyError) {
    return bodyError;
  }

  if (!payload?.competitionId || !payload.climberId || !isPositiveInteger(payload.climbNumber)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Missing competition, climber, or boulder details." }, { status: 400 });
  }
  const clientEventId = trimOrNull(payload.clientEventId);
  if (!clientEventId) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "clientEventId is required for idempotent staff scoring." }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const normalized = normalizeFinalAttemptInput({
    top: payload.top ?? false,
    zone: payload.zone ?? false,
    attemptsToTop: payload.attemptsToTop,
    attemptsToZone: payload.attemptsToZone,
  });

  try {
    const { supabase, response: authError } = await requireStaffScoreClient();
    if (authError) {
      return authError;
    }

    const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc("submit_staff_final_score_event", {
      p_competition_id: payload.competitionId,
      p_climber_id: payload.climberId,
      p_climb_number: payload.climbNumber,
      p_top: normalized.top,
      p_zone: normalized.zone,
      p_attempts_to_top: normalized.attemptsToTop,
      p_attempts_to_zone: normalized.attemptsToZone,
      p_client_event_id: clientEventId,
      p_scored_at: payload.scoredAt ?? null,
      p_judge_device_id: trimOrNull(payload.judgeDeviceId),
      p_judge_session_id: trimOrNull(payload.judgeSessionId),
      p_replayed_from_offline: payload.replayedFromOffline ?? false,
    });

    if (error) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: getStaffScoreErrorStatus(error.message) });
    }

    return NextResponse.json(
      normalizeStaffScoreRpcResult(data, {
        clientEventId,
        scoredAt: payload.scoredAt ?? null,
      })
    );
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unable to save the finals attempt.";
    return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status: getStaffScoreErrorStatus(message) });
  }
}

    expect(response.status).toBe(401);
    expect(mockState.rpc).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("returns 403 for authenticated non-staff score writes", async () => {
    mockState.role = "climber";

    expect(response.status).toBe(403);
    expect(mockState.rpc).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

    setRpcError("Climber not found.");

    expect(response.status).toBe(404);
  });

  it("returns 409 for non-finalist finals scoring", async () => {
    setRpcError("Only finalists can receive finals scores.");

    const response = await postFinalScore(jsonRequest(finalPayload));

    expect(response.status).toBe(409);
  });

  it("returns 400 when clientEventId is missing", async () => {
