--- src\app\staff\c\[slug]\preflight\page.tsx ---

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useParams } from "next/navigation";
import SiteHeader from "@/components/site-header";
import StaffCompetitionSubnav from "@/components/staff-competition-subnav";
import { getCompetitionSnapshot, type CompetitionSnapshot } from "@/lib/db";

function buildChecks(snapshot: CompetitionSnapshot) {
  const checks = [
    {
      label: "Schedule blocks configured",
      ok: snapshot.competition.schedule_blocks.length > 0,
      detail: snapshot.competition.schedule_blocks.length
        ? `${snapshot.competition.schedule_blocks.length} blocks configured`
        : "Add schedule blocks for public timing and capacity context.",
    },
    {
      label: "Categories configured",
      ok: snapshot.competition.categories.length > 0,
      detail: `${snapshot.competition.categories.length} categories available`,
    },
    {
      label: "Registration window set",
      ok: Boolean(snapshot.competition.registration_opens_at || snapshot.competition.registration_closes_at),
      detail: snapshot.competition.registration_closes_at
        ? `Closes ${new Date(snapshot.competition.registration_closes_at).toLocaleString()}`
        : "Set open/close times to help staff and climbers.",
    },
    {
      label: "Finalists and finals order ready",
      ok: snapshot.finalists.length === 0 || snapshot.finalists.every((entry) => (entry.climbing_order ?? 0) > 0),
      detail: snapshot.finalists.length ? `${snapshot.finalists.length} finalists loaded` : "No finalists selected yet.",
    },
    {
      label: "Registration still in the future",
      ok: !snapshot.competition.registration_closes_at || new Date(snapshot.competition.registration_closes_at).getTime() > Date.now(),
      detail: snapshot.competition.registration_closes_at
        ? `Closes ${new Date(snapshot.competition.registration_closes_at).toLocaleString()}`
        : "No close time configured.",
    },
  ];

  return checks;
}

export default function StaffPreflightPage() {
  const params = useParams<{ slug: string }>();
  const slug = typeof params?.slug === "string" ? params.slug : "";
  const [snapshot, setSnapshot] = useState<CompetitionSnapshot | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    void getCompetitionSnapshot(slug)
      .then((nextSnapshot) => setSnapshot(nextSnapshot))
      .catch((nextError) => setError(nextError instanceof Error ? nextError.message : "Unable to load preflight checks."));
  }, [slug]);

  const checks = snapshot ? buildChecks(snapshot) : [];

  return (
    <main className="results-page">
      <div className="content-frame space-y-6">
        <SiteHeader light status={<div className="results-chip">Preflight</div>} />
        <StaffCompetitionSubnav competitionSlug={slug} />

        {error ? <div className="results-alert results-alert-error">{error}</div> : null}

        <section className="results-card">
          <div className="results-kicker">Event-day preflight</div>
          <h1 className="results-editorial-title mt-2 text-4xl font-semibold text-slate-950 sm:text-5xl">
            {snapshot?.competition.name ?? "Checking competition..."}
          </h1>
          <div className="results-hero-subline">
            Run a quick operational pass before opening doors, switching phases, or putting judges onto live scoring.
          </div>
          <div className="mt-6 space-y-3">
            {checks.map((check) => (
              <div key={check.label} className={`results-workspace-card ${check.ok ? "" : "border-amber-200 bg-amber-50"}`}>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <div>
                    <div className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-950">{check.label}</div>
                    <div className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600">{check.detail}</div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="results-chip">{check.ok ? "Ready" : "Needs attention"}</div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </section>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}


--- src\app\staff\dashboard\page.tsx ---

import StaffDashboard from "@/components/staff-dashboard";
import { fetchOfficialBoulderingEvents } from "@/lib/official-events";
import { sanitizeExternalUrl } from "@/lib/security";

function readSingleValue(value: string | string[] | undefined) {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    return value[0] ?? "";
  }

  return value ?? "";
}

function sanitizeDraftText(value: string) {
  const trimmed = value.trim();
  if (!trimmed || trimmed === "undefined" || trimmed === "null") {
    return "";
  }

  return trimmed;
}

function sanitizeDraftNullable(value: string) {
  const trimmed = sanitizeDraftText(value);
  return trimmed || null;
}

export default async function StaffDashboardPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams?: Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>;
}) {
  const importedOfficialEventId = readSingleValue(searchParams?.importOfficialEvent).trim();
  const officialEvents = importedOfficialEventId ? await fetchOfficialBoulderingEvents().catch(() => []) : [];
  const importedOfficialEvent = officialEvents.find((event) => event.id === importedOfficialEventId);
  const directName = sanitizeDraftText(readSingleValue(searchParams?.createName));
  const directLocation = sanitizeDraftText(readSingleValue(searchParams?.createLocation));
  const directStartDate = sanitizeDraftText(readSingleValue(searchParams?.createStartDate));
  const directEndDate = sanitizeDraftText(readSingleValue(searchParams?.createEndDate));
  const directDescription = sanitizeDraftText(readSingleValue(searchParams?.createDescription));
  const directRegistrationOpensAt = sanitizeDraftNullable(readSingleValue(searchParams?.createRegistrationOpensAt));
  const directRegistrationClosesAt = sanitizeDraftNullable(readSingleValue(searchParams?.createRegistrationClosesAt));
  const directOfficialEventUrl = sanitizeExternalUrl(readSingleValue(searchParams?.createOfficialEventUrl));
  const directOfficialRegistrationUrl = sanitizeExternalUrl(readSingleValue(searchParams?.createOfficialRegistrationUrl));
  const directOfficialScheduleUrl = sanitizeExternalUrl(readSingleValue(searchParams?.createOfficialScheduleUrl));
  const directHeroImageUrl = sanitizeExternalUrl(readSingleValue(searchParams?.createHeroImageUrl));
  const directDisciplineLabel = sanitizeDraftText(readSingleValue(searchParams?.createDisciplineLabel));
  const directFormat = sanitizeDraftText(readSingleValue(searchParams?.createFormat));

  return (
    <StaffDashboard
      initialCreateDraft={{
        name: directName || importedOfficialEvent?.title || "",
        location: directLocation || importedOfficialEvent?.location || "",
        startDate: directStartDate || importedOfficialEvent?.start_date || "",
        endDate: directEndDate || importedOfficialEvent?.end_date || "",
        description: directDescription || importedOfficialEvent?.description || "",
        registrationOpensAt:
          directRegistrationOpensAt || importedOfficialEvent?.registration_opens_at || null,
        registrationClosesAt:
          directRegistrationClosesAt || importedOfficialEvent?.registration_closes_at || null,
        officialEventUrl: directOfficialEventUrl || importedOfficialEvent?.official_event_url || "",
        officialRegistrationUrl:
          directOfficialRegistrationUrl || importedOfficialEvent?.official_registration_url || "",
        officialScheduleUrl:
          directOfficialScheduleUrl || importedOfficialEvent?.official_schedule_url || "",
        heroImageUrl: directHeroImageUrl || importedOfficialEvent?.hero_image_url || "",
        disciplineLabel: directDisciplineLabel || importedOfficialEvent?.disciplines || "",
        format: directFormat || (importedOfficialEvent ? "flash_format" : ""),
      }}
    />
  );
}


--- src\app\staff\login\page.tsx ---

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import SiteHeader from "@/components/site-header";
import { getAuthState, isStaffRole, signInWithRole } from "@/lib/auth";
import { sanitizeInternalRedirectPath } from "@/lib/security";

export default function StaffLoginPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [redirectTarget, setRedirectTarget] = useState("/staff/dashboard");
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    setRedirectTarget(sanitizeInternalRedirectPath(params.get("redirect")));
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void getAuthState().then((state) => {
      if (isStaffRole(state.profile?.role)) {
        router.replace(sanitizeInternalRedirectPath(redirectTarget));
      }
    });
  }, [redirectTarget, router]);

  return (
    <main className="results-page">
      <div className="content-frame space-y-6">
        <SiteHeader light />

        <section className="mx-auto max-w-xl results-card">
          <div className="results-kicker">Staff access</div>
          <h1 className="mt-2 text-4xl font-semibold text-slate-950">Judge and admin sign-in</h1>
          <p className="mt-4 text-slate-600">
            Staff sessions live on dedicated routes now, so public competition pages stay focused on climbers, judges, and displays.
          </p>

          {error ? <div className="results-alert results-alert-error mt-4">{error}</div> : null}

          <form
            onSubmit={(event) => {
              event.preventDefault();
              setLoading(true);
              setError("");
              const safeRedirectTarget = sanitizeInternalRedirectPath(redirectTarget);
              void signInWithRole(email, password)
                .then(() => router.replace(safeRedirectTarget))
                .catch((nextError) => {
                  setError(nextError instanceof Error ? nextError.message : "Unable to sign in.");
                })
                .finally(() => setLoading(false));
            }}
            className="mt-6 space-y-4"
          >
            <input type="email" value={email} onChange={(event) => setEmail(event.target.value)} placeholder="judge@gym.com" className="results-input" />
            <input type="password" value={password} onChange={(event) => setPassword(event.target.value)} placeholder="Password" className="results-input" />
            <button type="submit" disabled={loading} className="results-primary-button">
              {loading ? "Signing in..." : "Sign in"}
            </button>
          </form>
        </section>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

--- src\components\competition-hero.tsx ---

"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import {
  buildCompetitionPath,
  buildHeroAccent,
  formatDateRange,
  formatDateTimeLabel,
  getCompetitionLifecycleLabel,
  getFormatTemplate,
  isCompetitionLiveNow,
  type Competition,
} from "@/lib/scoring";
import { sanitizeExternalUrl } from "@/lib/security";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { buttonStyles } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Surface } from "@/components/ui/surface";

function sanitizeDisplayText(value: string | null | undefined) {
  const trimmed = value?.trim() ?? "";
  if (!trimmed || trimmed === "undefined" || trimmed === "null") {
    return "";
  }

  return trimmed;
}

function isGenericRegistrationUrl(value: string) {
  return (
    value.includes("/compete/#register") ||
    value.includes("/compete/") ||
    value.includes("memberships")
  );
}

export default function CompetitionHero({
  competition,
}: {
  competition: Competition;
}) {
  const summary = getFormatTemplate(competition.format);
  const liveNow = isCompetitionLiveNow(competition);
  const lifecycleLabel = getCompetitionLifecycleLabel(competition);
  const description = sanitizeDisplayText(competition.description);
  const heroImageUrl = sanitizeExternalUrl(competition.hero_image_url, { allowDataImage: true });
  const officialEventUrl = sanitizeExternalUrl(sanitizeDisplayText(competition.official_event_url));
  const officialRegistrationUrl = sanitizeExternalUrl(sanitizeDisplayText(competition.official_registration_url));
  const officialScheduleUrl = sanitizeExternalUrl(sanitizeDisplayText(competition.official_schedule_url));
  const usableRegistrationUrl =
    officialRegistrationUrl && !isGenericRegistrationUrl(officialRegistrationUrl)
      ? officialRegistrationUrl
      : "";
  const registrationOpensLabel = competition.registration_opens_at
    ? formatDateTimeLabel(competition.registration_opens_at)
    : "";
  const registrationDeadlineLabel = competition.registration_closes_at
    ? formatDateTimeLabel(competition.registration_closes_at)
    : "";
  const registrationFallbackUrl = usableRegistrationUrl || officialEventUrl;

  return (
    <section className="results-card overflow-hidden">
      <div
        className="results-hero"
        style={{
          backgroundImage: heroImageUrl
            ? `${buildHeroAccent(competition)}, url(${heroImageUrl})`
            : `${buildHeroAccent(competition)}, linear-gradient(135deg, #dbe7f8, #f4f7fb)`,
        }}
      >
        <div className="results-hero__overlay">
          <div className="results-kicker">Competition</div>
          <h1 className="results-editorial-title mt-3 max-w-4xl break-words text-4xl font-semibold text-slate-950 sm:text-6xl">
            {competition.name}
          </h1>
          <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            <Badge>{competition.discipline_label}</Badge>
            <Badge>{summary.label}</Badge>
            <Badge variant={liveNow ? "live" : "default"}>
              {liveNow ? <span className="results-live-dot" aria-hidden="true" /> : null}
              {lifecycleLabel}
            </Badge>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-5 max-w-3xl text-sm font-medium leading-relaxed text-slate-700">
            Venue, dates, registration details, and official links in one place.
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-8 lg:grid-cols-[1.1fr_0.9fr]">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <div className="results-kicker">About</div>
          <p className="results-soft-text mt-3 max-w-3xl break-words text-[1.02rem] leading-relaxed sm:text-lg sm:leading-8">
            {description || "Competition details will appear here once staff adds the event description."}
          </p>

          <div className="results-button-row mt-6">
            <Link href={buildCompetitionPath(competition.slug, "register")} className={buttonStyles({ variant: "primary" })}>
              Register for competition
            </Link>
            <Link href={buildCompetitionPath(competition.slug, "leaderboard")} className={buttonStyles({ variant: "secondary" })}>
              View standings
            </Link>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                if (typeof navigator !== "undefined" && navigator.share) {
                  void navigator.share({
                    title: competition.name,
                    text: `Join ${competition.name}`,
                    url: window.location.href,
                  });
                  return;
                }

                void navigator.clipboard?.writeText(window.location.href);
              }}
              className={buttonStyles({ variant: "secondary" })}
            >
              Share competition
            </button>
            {officialEventUrl ? (
              <a
                href={officialEventUrl}
                target="_blank"
                rel="noopener noreferrer"
                className={buttonStyles({ variant: "secondary" })}
              >
                Official event page
              </a>
            ) : null}
            {officialScheduleUrl ? (
              <a
                href={officialScheduleUrl}
                target="_blank"
                rel="noopener noreferrer"
                className={buttonStyles({ variant: "secondary" })}
              >
                Official schedule
              </a>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid min-w-0 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <Surface variant="meta">
            <div className="results-kicker">Location</div>
            <div className="mt-2 break-words text-lg font-semibold text-slate-950">{competition.location_name || "Location TBD"}</div>
          </Surface>
          <Surface variant="meta">
            <div className="results-kicker">Date</div>
            <div className="mt-2 break-words text-lg font-semibold text-slate-950">{formatDateRange(competition.start_date, competition.end_date)}</div>
          </Surface>
          <Surface variant="meta">
            <div className="results-kicker">Registration opens</div>
            <div className="mt-2 break-words text-lg font-semibold text-slate-950">
              {registrationOpensLabel || registrationFallbackUrl ? (
                registrationOpensLabel ? (
                  registrationOpensLabel
                ) : (
                  <a
                    href={registrationFallbackUrl}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noopener noreferrer"
                    className="text-sky-700 underline-offset-4 hover:underline"
                  >
                    {usableRegistrationUrl ? "Official registration" : "Official event page"}
                  </a>
                )
              ) : (
                "Not scheduled"
              )}
            </div>
          </Surface>
          <Surface variant="meta">
            <div className="results-kicker">Registration deadline</div>
            <div className="mt-2 break-words text-lg font-semibold text-slate-950">
              {registrationDeadlineLabel || registrationFallbackUrl ? (
                registrationDeadlineLabel ? (
                  registrationDeadlineLabel
                ) : (
                  <a
                    href={registrationFallbackUrl}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noopener noreferrer"
                    className="text-sky-700 underline-offset-4 hover:underline"
                  >
                    {usableRegistrationUrl ? "See official registration" : "See official event page"}
                  </a>
                )
              ) : (
                "Not scheduled"
              )}
            </div>
          </Surface>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
