--- src\components\confirmation-modal.tsx ---

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export interface ConfirmationModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  confirmLabel: string;
  confirmTone?: "default" | "danger";
  expectedValue?: string;
  busy?: boolean;
  onCancel: () => void;
  onConfirm: () => void | Promise<void>;
}

export default function ConfirmationModal({
  open,
  title,
  description,
  confirmLabel,
  confirmTone = "default",
  expectedValue,
  busy = false,
  onCancel,
  onConfirm,
}: ConfirmationModalProps) {
  const [typedValue, setTypedValue] = useState("");
  const isAdvanceWorkflow = title.toLowerCase().includes("advance to finals");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) {
      setTypedValue("");
    }
  }, [open]);

  const requiresMatch = Boolean(expectedValue?.trim());
  const canConfirm = !requiresMatch || typedValue.trim() === expectedValue?.trim();

  return (
    open ? (
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[80] flex items-center justify-center px-4 py-8">
        <div aria-hidden="true" className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-950/45 backdrop-blur-sm" />
        <div className="relative max-h-[calc(100vh-4rem)] w-full max-w-xl overflow-y-auto rounded-[2rem] border border-white/70 bg-white/85 p-6 shadow-[0_12px_44px_rgba(15,23,42,0.14)] backdrop-blur-xl sm:p-7">
          <div className="results-kicker">Confirmation required</div>
          <h2 className="mt-2 break-words text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-950">{title}</h2>

          <div className={isAdvanceWorkflow ? "mt-4 rounded-[1.35rem] border border-sky-100 bg-[linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(240,249,255,0.98),rgba(255,255,255,0.96))] px-4 py-4 shadow-[0_16px_32px_rgba(14,116,215,0.08)]" : "mt-4"}>
            <p className="break-words text-sm leading-relaxed text-slate-600">{description}</p>
            {isAdvanceWorkflow ? (
              <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                <span className="results-chip border-sky-200 bg-sky-50 text-sky-800">Seed finals field</span>
                <span className="results-chip border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 text-amber-800">Undo stays available</span>
                <span className="results-chip border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800">Public state updates live</span>
              </div>
            ) : null}
          </div>

          {requiresMatch ? (
            <label className="mt-5 block space-y-2">
              <span className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">
                Type <span className="font-semibold text-slate-950">{expectedValue}</span> to continue
              </span>
              <input
                value={typedValue}
                onChange={(event) => setTypedValue(event.target.value)}
                className="results-input"
                placeholder={expectedValue}
                aria-label="Confirmation text"
              />
            </label>
          ) : null}

          <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-3">
            <button type="button" onClick={onCancel} disabled={busy} className="results-secondary-button">
              Cancel
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => void onConfirm()}
              disabled={busy || !canConfirm}
              className={confirmTone === "danger" ? "results-danger-button" : "results-primary-button"}
            >
              {busy ? "Working..." : confirmLabel}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    ) : null
  );
}


--- src\components\demo-entry.tsx ---

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { DemoLoadingOverlay, useDemoNavigation } from "@/components/demo-loading-overlay";
import { buttonStyles } from "@/components/ui/button";

type DemoSummary = {
  id: string;
  slug: string;
  name: string;
  created_at: string | null;
  canSkipToJudge: boolean;
  canSkipToResults: boolean;
};

type DemoCompleteResponse = {
  ok?: boolean;
  error?: string;
};

function formatCreatedDate(value: string | null) {
  if (!value) return "Created recently";
  const date = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return "Created recently";

  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, {
    month: "short",
    day: "numeric",
    year: "numeric",
  }).format(date);
}

export function DemoEntry({ demos }: { demos: DemoSummary[] }) {
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [status, setStatus] = useState("");
  const [deletingDemoId, setDeletingDemoId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [deletedDemoIds, setDeletedDemoIds] = useState<Set<string>>(() => new Set());
  const router = useRouter();
  const { loadingCopy, navigateWithDemoLoading } = useDemoNavigation();
  const navigationPending = Boolean(loadingCopy);
  const actionPending = navigationPending || deletingDemoId !== null;
  const visibleDemos = demos.filter((demo) => !deletedDemoIds.has(demo.id));
  const latestDemo = visibleDemos[0] ?? null;

  function startFullDemo() {
    setError("");
    setStatus("");
    void navigateWithDemoLoading("/staff/new?demo=act1");
  }

  function skipToJudge() {
    if (!latestDemo?.canSkipToJudge) {
      setError("Finish setup and seed the demo before skipping to the judge panel.");
      return;
    }

    setError("");
    setStatus("");
    void navigateWithDemoLoading(`/staff/c/${latestDemo.slug}/judge?demo=act2`);
  }

  function skipToResults() {
    if (!latestDemo?.canSkipToResults) {
      setError("Advance finalists before skipping to the public results page.");
      return;
    }

    setError("");
    setStatus("");
    void navigateWithDemoLoading(`/c/${latestDemo.slug}?demo=act4`);
  }

  function openDemoJudge(demo: DemoSummary) {
    if (!demo.canSkipToJudge) {
      setError("Finish setup and add seeded scores before opening this judge panel.");
      return;
    }

    setError("");
    setStatus("");
    void navigateWithDemoLoading(`/staff/c/${demo.slug}/judge?demo=act2`);
  }

  function openDemoResults(demo: DemoSummary) {
    if (!demo.canSkipToResults) {
      setError("Advance finalists and add finals scores before opening these public results.");
      return;
    }

    setError("");
    setStatus("");
    void navigateWithDemoLoading(`/c/${demo.slug}?demo=act4`);
  }

  async function deleteDemo(demo: DemoSummary) {
    if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${demo.name}" and all of its demo climbers, scores, and results?`)) {
      return;
    }

    setError("");
    setStatus("");
    setDeletingDemoId(demo.id);

    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/demo/complete", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ competitionId: demo.id }),
      });
      const payload = (await response.json().catch(() => null)) as DemoCompleteResponse | null;

      if (!response.ok || payload?.ok === false) {
        throw new Error(payload?.error ?? "Unable to delete this demo.");
      }

      setDeletedDemoIds((current) => {
        const next = new Set(current);
        next.add(demo.id);
        return next;
      });
      setStatus(`Deleted ${demo.name}.`);
      router.refresh();
    } catch (deleteError) {
      setError(deleteError instanceof Error ? deleteError.message : "Unable to delete this demo.");
    } finally {
      setDeletingDemoId(null);
    }
  }

  return (
    <section className="results-card">
      <div className="max-w-3xl">
        <div className="results-kicker">Guided walkthrough</div>
        <h1 className="mt-2 break-words text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-950 sm:text-5xl">
          Summit Series Demo
        </h1>
        <div className="mt-5 text-base leading-7 text-slate-700">
          <div>Run a full climbing competition:</div>
          <ul className="mt-3 space-y-1">
            <li>Create an event</li>
            <li>Score athletes as a judge</li>
            <li>Advance finalists</li>
            <li>View public results</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>

      {latestDemo ? (
        <div className="mt-6 rounded-[1.1rem] border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-slate-600">
          Latest demo event: <span className="font-semibold text-slate-950">{latestDemo.name}</span>
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {error ? (
        <div className="mt-4 rounded-[1.1rem] border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium text-amber-900">
          {error}
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {status ? (
        <div className="mt-4 rounded-[1.1rem] border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium text-emerald-900">
          {status}
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={startFullDemo}
          disabled={actionPending}
          className={buttonStyles({ variant: "primary" })}
        >
          Start Full Demo
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={skipToJudge}
          disabled={actionPending || !latestDemo?.canSkipToJudge}
          className={buttonStyles({ variant: "secondary" })}
        >
          Skip to Judge
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={skipToResults}
          disabled={actionPending || !latestDemo?.canSkipToResults}
          className={buttonStyles({ variant: "secondary" })}
        >
          Skip to Results
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-8 border-t border-slate-200 pt-6">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:items-end sm:justify-between">
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-950">Saved demo events</h2>
            <p className="mt-1 max-w-2xl text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600">
              Clean up old walkthrough events here. Only demo events can be deleted from this page.
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-500">
            {visibleDemos.length} active {visibleDemos.length === 1 ? "demo" : "demos"}
          </div>
        </div>

        {visibleDemos.length > 0 ? (
          <div className="mt-4 overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white/70">
            {visibleDemos.map((demo) => (
              <div
                key={demo.id}
                className="flex flex-col gap-4 border-b border-slate-200 px-4 py-4 last:border-b-0 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between"
              >
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <div className="break-words text-base font-semibold text-slate-950">{demo.name}</div>
                    {demo.id === latestDemo?.id ? (
                      <span className="rounded-full bg-sky-50 px-2.5 py-1 text-[0.68rem] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-sky-700">
                        Latest
                      </span>
                    ) : null}
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
                    <span>{demo.slug}</span>
                    <span>{formatCreatedDate(demo.created_at)}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                    <span
                      className={
                        demo.canSkipToJudge
                          ? "rounded-full bg-emerald-50 px-2.5 py-1 text-[0.68rem] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-emerald-700"
                          : "rounded-full bg-slate-100 px-2.5 py-1 text-[0.68rem] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-slate-500"
                      }
                    >
                      {demo.canSkipToJudge ? "Judge ready" : "Setup needed"}
                    </span>
                    <span
                      className={
                        demo.canSkipToResults
                          ? "rounded-full bg-emerald-50 px-2.5 py-1 text-[0.68rem] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-emerald-700"
                          : "rounded-full bg-slate-100 px-2.5 py-1 text-[0.68rem] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-slate-500"
                      }
                    >
                      {demo.canSkipToResults ? "Results ready" : "Results pending"}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => openDemoJudge(demo)}
                    disabled={actionPending || !demo.canSkipToJudge}
                    className={buttonStyles({ variant: "ghost", size: "sm" })}
                  >
                    Open Judge
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => openDemoResults(demo)}
                    disabled={actionPending || !demo.canSkipToResults}
                    className={buttonStyles({ variant: "ghost", size: "sm" })}
                  >
                    View Results
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => void deleteDemo(demo)}
                    disabled={actionPending}
                    className={buttonStyles({ variant: "danger", size: "sm" })}
                  >
                    {deletingDemoId === demo.id ? "Deleting..." : "Delete"}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="mt-4 rounded-lg border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-slate-50 px-4 py-5 text-sm text-slate-600">
            No saved demo events yet.
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <DemoLoadingOverlay
        active={Boolean(loadingCopy)}
        title={loadingCopy?.title ?? "Opening next step..."}
        text={loadingCopy?.text ?? "Bringing the next demo screen into view."}
      />
    </section>
  );
}


--- src\components\demo-guide-banner.tsx ---

"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { buttonStyles } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Surface } from "@/components/ui/surface";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

type DemoGuideAction =
  | {
      label: string;
      href: string;
      primary?: boolean;
      disabled?: never;
      onClick?: never;
    }
  | {
      label: string;
      onClick: () => void;
      primary?: boolean;
      disabled?: boolean;
      href?: never;
    };

type DemoGuideBannerProps = {
  title: string;
  body: string;
  eyebrow?: string;
  actions?: DemoGuideAction[];
  tone?: "info" | "success";
  className?: string;
};

export function DemoGuideBanner({
  title,
  body,
  eyebrow = "Summit Series Demo",
  actions = [],
  tone = "info",
  className,
}: DemoGuideBannerProps) {
  return (
    <Surface
      variant="card"
      className={cn(
        "border-sky-200 bg-sky-50/80 p-5 sm:p-6",
        tone === "success" && "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50/90",
        className
      )}
    >
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
        <div className="min-w-0 space-y-2">
          <div className={cn("results-kicker text-sky-700", tone === "success" && "text-emerald-700")}>
            {eyebrow}
          </div>
          <h2 className="break-words text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-950">
            {title}
          </h2>
          <p className="max-w-3xl text-sm leading-6 text-slate-700">{body}</p>
        </div>
        {actions.length ? (
          <div className="flex shrink-0 flex-wrap gap-2">
            {actions.map((action) =>
              action.href ? (
                <Link
                  key={action.label}
                  href={action.href}
                  className={buttonStyles({
                    variant: action.primary ? "primary" : "secondary",
                    size: "compact",
                  })}
                >
                  {action.label}
                </Link>
              ) : (
                <button
                  key={action.label}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={action.onClick}
                  disabled={action.disabled}
                  className={buttonStyles({
                    variant: action.primary ? "primary" : "secondary",
                    size: "compact",
                  })}
                >
                  {action.label}
                </button>
              )
            )}
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </Surface>
  );
}


--- src\components\demo-judge-split-panel.tsx ---

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { CompetitionSnapshot } from "@/lib/db";
import {
  DEMO_TARGET_CLIMBER_NUMBER,
  isDemoTargetCorrected,
} from "@/lib/demo-scenario";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";
import { publicSupabase, supabaseConfigured } from "@/lib/supabase";
import { filterAttemptsForRound, getActiveQualifierStyleRound } from "@/lib/scoring";

type DemoJudgeSplitPanelProps = {
  competitionId: string;
  competitionSlug: string;
  initialSnapshot: CompetitionSnapshot;
};

type SnapshotResponse = {
  snapshot?: CompetitionSnapshot;
  error?: unknown;
};

async function fetchStaffSnapshot(identifier: string) {
  const response = await fetch(`/api/staff/competitions/snapshot?identifier=${encodeURIComponent(identifier)}`, {
    cache: "no-store",
  });
  const payload = (await response.json().catch(() => null)) as SnapshotResponse | null;

  if (!response.ok || !payload?.snapshot) {
    throw new Error(typeof payload?.error === "string" ? payload.error : "Unable to refresh demo leaderboard.");
  }

  return payload.snapshot;
}

function findDemoTarget(snapshot: CompetitionSnapshot) {
  return snapshot.climbers.find((climber) => climber.climber_number === DEMO_TARGET_CLIMBER_NUMBER);
}

export function DemoJudgeSplitPanel({
  competitionId,
  competitionSlug,
  initialSnapshot,
}: DemoJudgeSplitPanelProps) {
  const [snapshot, setSnapshot] = useState(initialSnapshot);
  const [flashingClimberIds, setFlashingClimberIds] = useState<Set<string>>(() => new Set());
  const previousTargetCorrectedRef = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setSnapshot(initialSnapshot);
  }, [initialSnapshot]);

  const flashClimber = useCallback((climberId: string | null | undefined) => {
    if (!climberId) {
      return;
    }

    setFlashingClimberIds((current) => {
      const next = new Set(current);
      next.add(climberId);
      return next;
    });
    window.setTimeout(() => {
      setFlashingClimberIds((current) => {
        const next = new Set(current);
        next.delete(climberId);
        return next;
      });
    }, 1800);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const target = findDemoTarget(initialSnapshot);
    const activeQualifierRoundId =
      initialSnapshot.activeQualifierRound?.id ??
      getActiveQualifierStyleRound(initialSnapshot.competition)?.id ??
      null;
    const targetAttempt =
      target && activeQualifierRoundId
        ? filterAttemptsForRound(target.qualifier_attempts, activeQualifierRoundId).find((attempt) => attempt.climb_number === 3) ?? null
        : null;
    const corrected = isDemoTargetCorrected(targetAttempt);

    if (corrected && !previousTargetCorrectedRef.current) {
      flashClimber(target?.id);
    }
    previousTargetCorrectedRef.current = corrected;
  }, [flashClimber, initialSnapshot]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!supabaseConfigured) {
      return;
    }

    const refreshLeaderboard = async (changedClimberId?: string | null) => {
      try {
        const refreshed = await fetchStaffSnapshot(competitionSlug);
        setSnapshot(refreshed);
        flashClimber(changedClimberId);
      } catch {
        // The parent judge page owns visible load/save errors; this panel stays non-blocking.
      }
    };

    const channel = publicSupabase
      .channel(`demo-judge-leaderboard-${competitionId}`)
      .on(
        "postgres_changes",
        { event: "*", schema: "public", table: "qualifier_attempts", filter: `competition_id=eq.${competitionId}` },
        (payload: { new: Record<string, unknown> | null; old: Record<string, unknown> | null }) => {
          const changedClimberId =
            (typeof payload.new?.climber_id === "string" ? payload.new.climber_id : null) ??
            (typeof payload.old?.climber_id === "string" ? payload.old.climber_id : null);
          void refreshLeaderboard(changedClimberId);
        }
      )
      .subscribe();

    return () => {
      publicSupabase.removeChannel(channel);
    };
  }, [competitionId, competitionSlug, flashClimber]);

  const targetClimber = findDemoTarget(snapshot);
  const targetEntry = snapshot.qualifierLeaderboard.find((row) => row.climber_id === targetClimber?.id);
  const targetCategory = targetEntry?.display_category ?? targetClimber?.display_category ?? "";
  const finalsCutoff = snapshot.competition.finals_cutoff ?? 6;
  const leaderboardRows = useMemo(() => {
    const categoryRows = targetCategory
      ? snapshot.qualifierLeaderboard.filter((row) => row.display_category === targetCategory)
      : snapshot.qualifierLeaderboard;
    return categoryRows.slice(0, Math.max(finalsCutoff + 2, 8));
  }, [finalsCutoff, snapshot.qualifierLeaderboard, targetCategory]);

  return (
    <aside
      className="rounded-[1.6rem] border border-sky-100 bg-white/92 p-4 shadow-[0_18px_44px_rgba(14,116,215,0.12)] xl:sticky xl:top-24"
      data-demo-anchor="judge-leaderboard-split"
    >
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <div className="results-kicker text-sky-700">Live leaderboard</div>
          <h2 className="mt-2 text-xl font-semibold text-slate-950">Correction impact</h2>
          <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600">
            Save the Boulder 3 correction and watch this ranking panel update without leaving the judge screen.
          </p>
        </div>
        <span className="results-chip">Top {finalsCutoff}</span>
      </div>

      {targetEntry ? (
        <div className="mt-4 rounded-[1rem] border border-sky-200 bg-sky-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-sky-950">
          <span className="font-semibold">Target now: </span>
          #{targetEntry.category_rank} in {targetEntry.display_category}
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <div className="mt-4 space-y-2">
        {leaderboardRows.map((row) => {
          const isTarget = row.climber_id === targetClimber?.id;
          const isFinalist = row.category_rank <= finalsCutoff;
          const flashing = flashingClimberIds.has(row.climber_id);

          return (
            <div
              key={row.climber_id}
              className={cn(
                "rounded-[1rem] border px-3 py-2 text-sm transition",
                flashing && "demo-leaderboard-row-update",
                isTarget
                  ? "border-sky-300 bg-sky-50 shadow-[0_14px_30px_rgba(14,116,215,0.12)]"
                  : isFinalist
                    ? "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50/80"
                    : "border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/80"
              )}
              data-demo-anchor={isTarget ? "judge-leaderboard-target-row" : undefined}
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div
                  className={cn(
                    "flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-sm font-bold",
                    isFinalist ? "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800" : "bg-slate-200 text-slate-600"
                  )}
                >
                  {row.category_rank}
                </div>
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <div className="truncate font-semibold text-slate-950">
                    {row.name} <span className="font-normal text-slate-500">#{row.climber_number}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="truncate text-xs text-slate-500">{row.display_category}</div>
                </div>
                <div className="shrink-0 text-right text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600">
                  <div>{row.topped_count}T / {row.zone_count}Z</div>
                  <div>{row.total_score.toFixed(1)}</div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      <div className="mt-4 border-t border-dashed border-slate-200 pt-3 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500">
        The cut line is Top {finalsCutoff}. Rows above the line stay green; the target row updates when the saved score changes.
      </div>
    </aside>
  );
}


--- src\components\demo-loading-overlay.tsx ---

"use client";

import { useCallback, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import {
  DEMO_LOADING_DELAY_MS,
  getDemoLoadingCopyForHref,
  type DemoLoadingCopy,
} from "@/lib/demo-loading";

export function DemoLoadingOverlay({
  active,
  title,
  text,
  complete = false,
}: {
  active: boolean;
  title: string;
  text: string;
  complete?: boolean;
}) {
  if (!active) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[70] flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-950/25 px-4 backdrop-blur-[2px]">
      <div
        role="status"
        aria-live="polite"
        className="w-[min(22.5rem,calc(100vw-2rem))] rounded-[1.5rem] border border-white/60 bg-white/70 px-6 py-7 text-center text-slate-950 shadow-[0_28px_90px_rgba(15,23,42,0.28)] backdrop-blur-xl"
      >
        <div className="mx-auto flex h-1.5 w-16 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-white/75 shadow-inner">
          <div
            className={`h-full rounded-full bg-sky-700 transition-all duration-500 ${
              complete ? "w-full" : "w-1/2 animate-pulse"
            }`}
          />
        </div>
        <div className="results-kicker mt-6 text-slate-500">Guided handoff</div>
        <h2 className="mt-3 text-2xl font-semibold leading-tight tracking-tight text-slate-950">
          {title}
        </h2>
        <p className="mt-4 text-sm font-medium leading-6 text-slate-600">{text}</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function useDemoNavigation() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [loadingCopy, setLoadingCopy] = useState<DemoLoadingCopy | null>(null);

  const navigateWithDemoLoading = useCallback(
    async (
      href: string,
      options: {
        title?: string;
        text?: string;
        delayMs?: number;
      } = {}
    ) => {
      const fallbackCopy = getDemoLoadingCopyForHref(href);
      setLoadingCopy({
        title: options.title ?? fallbackCopy.title,
        text: options.text ?? fallbackCopy.text,
      });
      const reducedMotion = window.matchMedia?.("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches ?? false;
      await new Promise((resolve) =>
        window.setTimeout(resolve, reducedMotion ? 120 : options.delayMs ?? DEMO_LOADING_DELAY_MS)
      );
      router.push(href);
    },
    [router]
  );

  const clearDemoLoading = useCallback(() => {
    setLoadingCopy(null);
  }, []);

  return {
    loadingCopy,
    navigateWithDemoLoading,
    clearDemoLoading,
  };
}


--- src\components\demo-wizard-sidebar.tsx ---

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { DemoLoadingOverlay, useDemoNavigation } from "@/components/demo-loading-overlay";
import { buttonStyles } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";
import { jumpToDemoAnchor } from "@/lib/demo-jump-target";
import {
  DEMO_WIZARD_STEPS,
  isDemoWizardStepComplete,
  normalizeDemoWizardProgress,
  type DemoWizardProgress,
  type DemoWizardStep,
} from "@/lib/demo-wizard";

export type DemoWizardAction = {
  label: string;
  href?: string;
  onClick?: () => void | Promise<void>;
  targetAnchor?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  loadingTitle?: string;
  loadingText?: string;
  loadingDelayMs?: number;
};

export type DemoWizardSidebarProps = {
  currentStep: DemoWizardStep;
  title: string;
  instruction: string;
  why: string;
  progress: Partial<DemoWizardProgress>;
  blockingMessage?: string | null;
  primaryAction?: DemoWizardAction;
  secondaryActions?: DemoWizardAction[];
};

function ActionButton({
  action,
  navigateWithDemoLoading,
  primary = false,
}: {
  action: DemoWizardAction;
  navigateWithDemoLoading: ReturnType<typeof useDemoNavigation>["navigateWithDemoLoading"];
  primary?: boolean;
}) {
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const disabled = action.disabled || pending;

  async function runAction() {
    if (disabled) {
      return;
    }

    if (!action.onClick && !action.targetAnchor && !action.href) {
      return;
    }

    setPending(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      if (action.onClick) {
        await action.onClick();
      }
      if (action.targetAnchor && !jumpToDemoAnchor(action.targetAnchor)) {
        throw new Error("I can't find that step on this screen yet.");
      }
      if (action.href) {
        await navigateWithDemoLoading(action.href, {
          title: action.loadingTitle,
          text: action.loadingText,
          delayMs: action.loadingDelayMs,
        });
      }
    } catch (nextError) {
      setError(nextError instanceof Error ? nextError.message : "That demo action did not work. Try again.");
    } finally {
      setPending(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <button
        type="button"
        disabled={disabled}
        onClick={runAction}
        className={cn(
          buttonStyles({ variant: primary ? "primary" : "secondary", size: "compact", fullWidth: true }),
          disabled && "opacity-60"
        )}
      >
        {pending ? (action.href ? "Opening..." : "Working...") : action.label}
      </button>
      {error ? (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-rose-700">
          {error}
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

export function DemoWizardSidebar({
  currentStep,
  title,
  instruction,
  why,
  progress,
  blockingMessage = null,
  primaryAction,
  secondaryActions = [],
}: DemoWizardSidebarProps) {
  const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState(false);
  const normalizedProgress = normalizeDemoWizardProgress(progress);
  const currentIndex = DEMO_WIZARD_STEPS.findIndex((step) => step.id === currentStep);
  const safeCurrentIndex = currentIndex >= 0 ? currentIndex : 0;
  const currentLabel = `Step ${safeCurrentIndex + 1} of ${DEMO_WIZARD_STEPS.length}`;
  const { loadingCopy, navigateWithDemoLoading } = useDemoNavigation();

  if (collapsed) {
    return (
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setCollapsed(false)}
        className="fixed bottom-4 right-4 z-50 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-sky-200 bg-white/95 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900 shadow-[0_20px_60px_rgba(15,23,42,0.18)] backdrop-blur"
      >
        <span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-sky-500 shadow-[0_0_0_6px_rgba(14,165,233,0.14)]" />
        Summit demo: {currentLabel}
      </button>
    );
  }

  return (
    <aside className="fixed bottom-4 right-4 z-50 w-[min(23rem,calc(100vw-2rem))] rounded-[1.5rem] border border-slate-200 bg-white/95 p-4 text-slate-900 shadow-[0_24px_70px_rgba(15,23,42,0.22)] backdrop-blur">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <div className="results-kicker text-sky-700">Summit Series wizard</div>
          <div className="mt-1 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-slate-500">
            {currentLabel}
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setCollapsed(true)}
          className="rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500"
        >
          Minimize
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-4 flex items-center gap-1.5">
        {DEMO_WIZARD_STEPS.map((step, index) => {
          const active = step.id === currentStep;
          const complete = isDemoWizardStepComplete(step, normalizedProgress);
          return (
            <div
              key={step.id}
              className={cn(
                "h-2 flex-1 rounded-full",
                complete ? "bg-emerald-400" : active ? "bg-sky-500" : index < safeCurrentIndex ? "bg-slate-300" : "bg-slate-200"
              )}
              title={`${step.label}${complete ? " complete" : active ? " current" : ""}`}
            />
          );
        })}
      </div>

      <h2 className="mt-4 text-xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-950">{title}</h2>
      <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600">{instruction}</p>
      <div className="mt-4 rounded-[1rem] border border-sky-100 bg-sky-50 px-3 py-3 text-sm leading-6 text-sky-950">
        <span className="font-semibold">Why it matters: </span>
        {why}
      </div>
      {blockingMessage ? (
        <div className="mt-3 rounded-[1rem] border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 px-3 py-3 text-sm font-medium leading-6 text-amber-900">
          {blockingMessage}
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <div className="mt-4 grid gap-2">
        {primaryAction ? (
          <ActionButton action={primaryAction} navigateWithDemoLoading={navigateWithDemoLoading} primary />
        ) : null}
        {secondaryActions.map((action) => (
          <ActionButton
            key={`${action.label}-${action.href ?? action.targetAnchor ?? "action"}`}
            action={action}
            navigateWithDemoLoading={navigateWithDemoLoading}
          />
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs text-slate-500">
        <div className={normalizedProgress.dataPopulated ? "text-emerald-700" : ""}>
          {normalizedProgress.dataPopulated ? "Sample field ready" : "Add sample field"}
        </div>
        <div className={normalizedProgress.keyScoreCorrected ? "text-emerald-700" : ""}>
          {normalizedProgress.keyScoreCorrected ? "Correction saved" : "Score fix needed"}
        </div>
        <div className={normalizedProgress.organizerAdvanced ? "text-emerald-700" : ""}>
          {normalizedProgress.organizerAdvanced ? "Finalists set" : "Organizer step next"}
        </div>
        <div className={normalizedProgress.publicReady ? "text-emerald-700" : ""}>
          {normalizedProgress.publicReady ? "Public page ready" : "Public page next"}
        </div>
      </div>
      <DemoLoadingOverlay
        active={Boolean(loadingCopy)}
        title={loadingCopy?.title ?? "Opening next step..."}
        text={loadingCopy?.text ?? "Bringing the next demo screen into view."}
      />
    </aside>
  );
}


--- src\components\demo-workspace.tsx ---

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Surface } from "@/components/ui/surface";
import {
  CASCADE_CUP_DEMO_NAME,
  CASCADE_CUP_DEMO_SCENARIO,
  buildCascadeCupScorecardUrl,
} from "@/lib/cascade-cup-demo";
import { clearOfflineQueueForCompetition } from "@/lib/staff-offline-queue";

type DemoCompetition = {
  id: string;
  slug: string;
  name: string;
  created_at: string | null;
};

type DemoSeedResponse = {
  ok?: boolean;
  judgeUrl?: string;
  publicUrl?: string;
  leaderboardUrl?: string;
  organizerUrl?: string;
  scorecardUrl?: string;
  error?: string;
  target?: {
    name: string;
    climberNumber: string;
    climbNumber: number;
    before: string;
    after: string;
  };
};

type DemoStateResponse = {
  ok?: boolean;
  progress?: {
    eventReady: boolean;
    dataPopulated: boolean;
    keyScoreCorrected: boolean;
    organizerAdvanced: boolean;
  };
  target?: {
    seeded: boolean;
    corrected: boolean;
  };
};

async function seedDemo(competitionId: string) {
  const response = await fetch("/api/demo/seed", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ competitionId, scenario: CASCADE_CUP_DEMO_SCENARIO }),
  });
  const payload = (await response.json().catch(() => null)) as DemoSeedResponse | null;
  if (!response.ok || !payload?.ok) {
    throw new Error(payload?.error ?? "Unable to prepare demo scenario.");
  }

  return payload;
}

async function completeDemo(competitionId: string) {
  const response = await fetch("/api/demo/complete", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ competitionId }),
  });
  const payload = (await response.json().catch(() => null)) as { error?: string } | null;
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(payload?.error ?? "Unable to delete demo.");
  }
}

export function DemoWorkspace({ demos }: { demos: DemoCompetition[] }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [demoStates, setDemoStates] = useState<Record<string, DemoStateResponse>>({});

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function loadStates() {
      const entries = await Promise.all(
        demos.map(async (demo) => {
          const response = await fetch(`/api/demo/state?competitionId=${encodeURIComponent(demo.id)}`, {
            cache: "no-store",
          });
          const payload = (await response.json().catch(() => null)) as DemoStateResponse | null;
          return [demo.id, payload?.ok ? payload : {}] as const;
        })
      );

      if (!cancelled) {
        setDemoStates(Object.fromEntries(entries));
      }
    }

    void loadStates();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [demos]);

  function runWithFeedback(action: () => Promise<void>) {
    setMessage("");
    setError("");
    startTransition(() => {
      void action().catch((nextError) => {
        setError(nextError instanceof Error ? nextError.message : "Unable to update the demo.");
      });
    });
  }

  const latestDemo = demos[0] ?? null;
  const latestDemoSeeded = latestDemo
    ? Boolean(demoStates[latestDemo.id]?.progress?.dataPopulated)
    : false;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <Surface variant="card" className="space-y-6">
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div className="results-kicker text-sky-700">Cascade Cup demo workspace</div>
          <h1 className="text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-950 sm:text-6xl">
            Run Cascade Cup through the real app.
          </h1>
          <p className="max-w-3xl text-base leading-7 text-slate-600">
            This workspace supports the sales demo from start to finish: create {CASCADE_CUP_DEMO_NAME}
            in the real staff flow, add a realistic youth field, fix one Boulder 3 score, advance
            finalists, publish results, then delete the demo when you are done.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-4">
          {[
            ["1. Create", "Use the real staff creation form with Cascade Cup defaults preloaded."],
            ["2. Judge", "Seed youth climbers, then fix the guided Boulder 3 score."],
            ["3. Organize", "Review standings, lock qualifiers, advance finalists, and publish results."],
            ["4. Clean up", "Delete the demo from this workspace when the walkthrough is finished."],
          ].map(([title, body]) => (
            <div key={title} className="rounded-[1.25rem] border border-slate-200 bg-white/75 p-4">
              <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-950">{title}</div>
              <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600">{body}</p>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="primary"
            onClick={() => router.push(`/staff/new?demo=1&scenario=${CASCADE_CUP_DEMO_SCENARIO}`)}
          >
            Start Demo
          </Button>
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="secondary"
            disabled={!latestDemo || isPending}
            onClick={() =>
              latestDemo &&
              runWithFeedback(async () => {
                const payload = await seedDemo(latestDemo.id);
                router.push(payload.judgeUrl ?? `/staff/c/${latestDemo.slug}/judge?demo=1`);
              })
            }
          >
            Skip to Judge
          </Button>
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="secondary"
            disabled={!latestDemo || !latestDemoSeeded}
            onClick={() => latestDemo && router.push(`/c/${latestDemo.slug}?demo=1`)}
          >
            Skip to Public
          </Button>
        </div>

        {!latestDemo ? (
          <p className="text-sm leading-6 text-slate-500">
            Start Demo opens the real staff creation form. Skip links activate after a demo event exists.
          </p>
        ) : null}
        {message ? <div className="results-alert results-alert-success">{message}</div> : null}
        {error ? <div className="results-alert results-alert-error">{error}</div> : null}
      </Surface>

      <Surface variant="card" className="space-y-4">
        <div>
          <div className="results-kicker">Active demo events</div>
          <h2 className="mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold text-slate-950">Demo workspace only</h2>
          <p className="mt-2 max-w-3xl text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600">
            Demo competitions are hidden from the main homepage and normal staff lists. Finish a demo
            when you are done to delete the sample event and all seeded climbers/scores.
          </p>
        </div>

        {demos.length ? (
          <div className="grid gap-3">
            {demos.map((demo) => {
              const seeded = Boolean(demoStates[demo.id]?.progress?.dataPopulated);
              return (
                <div key={demo.id} className="rounded-[1.25rem] border border-slate-200 bg-white/80 p-4">
                  <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
                    <div>
                      <div className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-950">{demo.name}</div>
                      <div className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">/{demo.slug}</div>
                      <div className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600">
                        Script path: homepage, staff setup, judge B3 correction, leaderboard cut line,
                        organizer operations, public results, cleanup.
                      </div>
                      <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                        <span className="results-chip">
                          {demoStates[demo.id]?.progress?.dataPopulated ? "Seeded" : "Needs seed"}
                        </span>
                        <span className="results-chip">
                          {demoStates[demo.id]?.progress?.keyScoreCorrected ? "Score corrected" : "Correction pending"}
                        </span>
                        <span className="results-chip">
                          {demoStates[demo.id]?.progress?.organizerAdvanced ? "Finals started" : "Organizer step next"}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                      <Button
                        type="button"
                        variant="secondary"
                        disabled={isPending}
                        onClick={() =>
                          runWithFeedback(async () => {
                            const payload = await seedDemo(demo.id);
                            setMessage(
                              payload.target
                                ? `Scenario reset: #${payload.target.climberNumber} ${payload.target.name} B${payload.target.climbNumber} is back to ${payload.target.before}.`
                                : "Scenario reset."
                            );
                            router.refresh();
                          })
                        }
                      >
                        Restart Scenario
                      </Button>
                      <Button
                        type="button"
                        variant="primary"
                        disabled={isPending}
                        onClick={() =>
                          runWithFeedback(async () => {
                            if (!seeded) {
                              const payload = await seedDemo(demo.id);
                              router.push(payload.judgeUrl ?? `/staff/c/${demo.slug}/judge?demo=1`);
                              return;
                            }
                            router.push(`/staff/c/${demo.slug}/judge?demo=1`);
                          })
                        }
                      >
                        {seeded ? "Open Judge Demo" : "Seed + Open Judge"}
                      </Button>
                      <Button
                        type="button"
                        variant="secondary"
                        disabled={!seeded}
                        onClick={() => router.push(`/c/${demo.slug}/leaderboard?demo=1`)}
                      >
                        Open Leaderboard
                      </Button>
                      <Button type="button" variant="secondary" onClick={() => router.push(`/staff/c/${demo.slug}?demo=1`)}>
                        Organizer Demo
                      </Button>
                      <Button type="button" variant="secondary" disabled={!seeded} onClick={() => router.push(`/c/${demo.slug}?demo=1`)}>
                        Public Demo
                      </Button>
                      <Button
                        type="button"
                        variant="secondary"
                        disabled={!seeded}
                        onClick={() => router.push(buildCascadeCupScorecardUrl(demo.slug, demo.id))}
                      >
                        {seeded ? "Athlete Scorecard" : "Seed first for scorecard"}
                      </Button>
                      <Button
                        type="button"
                        variant="danger"
                        disabled={isPending}
                        onClick={() =>
                          runWithFeedback(async () => {
                            await completeDemo(demo.id);
                            await clearOfflineQueueForCompetition(demo.id);
                            setMessage("Demo deleted.");
                            router.refresh();
                          })
                        }
                      >
                        Delete Demo
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="rounded-[1.25rem] border border-dashed border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 p-5 text-sm text-slate-600">
            No active demo events yet.
          </div>
        )}
      </Surface>
    </div>
  );
}


--- src\components\finals-results-table.tsx ---

"use client";

import type { CSSProperties } from "react";
import { formatFinalPoints, type FinalsLeaderboardEntry } from "@/lib/scoring";

function FinalsResultCell({
  top,
  zone,
  attemptsToTop,
  attemptsToZone,
}: {
  top: boolean;
  zone: boolean;
  attemptsToTop: number | null;
  attemptsToZone: number | null;
}) {
  if (!top && !zone) {
    return <div className="finals-problem-box finals-problem-box-empty">-</div>;
  }

  if (top) {
    return (
      <div className="finals-problem-box finals-problem-box-top">
        <div className="finals-problem-box__top-attempt">{attemptsToTop ?? 1}</div>
        <div className="finals-problem-box__zone-attempt">{attemptsToZone ?? attemptsToTop ?? 1}</div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="finals-problem-box finals-problem-box-zone-only">
      <div className="finals-problem-box__zone-band">
        <div className="finals-problem-box__zone-attempt">{attemptsToZone ?? 1}</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function metricClassName(value: number) {
  return value === 0 ? "finals-metric finals-metric-dim" : "finals-metric finals-metric-strong";
}

export default function FinalsResultsTable({
  title,
  rows,
}: {
  title: string;
  rows: FinalsLeaderboardEntry[];
}) {
  const problemCount = Math.max(1, ...rows.map((entry) => entry.problem_results.length), 4);
  const mobileProblemGridStyle: CSSProperties = {
    gridTemplateColumns: `repeat(${problemCount}, minmax(0, 1fr))`,
  };
  const desktopGridStyle: CSSProperties = {
    gridTemplateColumns: `0.7fr 2.3fr 1fr repeat(${problemCount}, 0.8fr) 1fr 0.7fr 0.7fr 0.8fr 0.8fr`,
  };
  const desktopTableMinWidth = `${760 + problemCount * 76}px`;

  return (
    <section className="results-card">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <div className="results-kicker">Finals rankings</div>
          <h2 className="results-editorial-title mt-2 break-words text-3xl font-semibold text-slate-950 sm:text-4xl">{title}</h2>
        </div>
        <div className="results-chip">2025 IFSC points</div>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-5 space-y-3 md:hidden">
        {rows.map((entry) => (
          <div key={entry.climber_id} className="results-meta-card min-w-0">
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <div className="results-kicker">Rank #{entry.category_rank}</div>
                <div className="mt-2 break-words text-xl font-semibold text-slate-950">{entry.name}</div>
                <div className="mt-1 break-words text-sm leading-relaxed text-slate-600">
                  {entry.province} | Qualifier #{entry.previous_round_rank}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="text-right">
                <div className="results-kicker">Points</div>
                <div className={metricClassName(entry.total_points)}>{formatFinalPoints(entry.total_points)}</div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-4 grid gap-2" style={mobileProblemGridStyle}>
              {entry.problem_results.map((problem) => (
                <div key={problem.climb_number} className="space-y-2">
                  <div className="text-center text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-slate-500">
                    B{problem.climb_number}
                  </div>
                  <FinalsResultCell
                    top={problem.top}
                    zone={problem.zone}
                    attemptsToTop={problem.attempts_to_top}
                    attemptsToZone={problem.attempts_to_zone}
                  />
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-sm text-slate-600">
              <div><span className="font-semibold text-slate-950">{entry.tops}</span> tops</div>
              <div><span className="font-semibold text-slate-950">{entry.zones}</span> zones</div>
              <div><span className="font-semibold text-slate-950">{entry.attempts_to_top}</span> attempts to top</div>
              <div><span className="font-semibold text-slate-950">{entry.attempts_to_zone}</span> attempts to zone</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="results-data-scroll mt-5 hidden md:block">
        <div className="results-table-scroll-hint">
          <span>Score column shows finals points.</span>
          <span>Scroll sideways for the full finals table.</span>
        </div>
        <div className="finals-table-shell" style={{ minWidth: desktopTableMinWidth }}>
          <div className="grid finals-table-header" style={desktopGridStyle}>
            <div>#</div>
            <div>Athlete</div>
            <div>Prov</div>
            {Array.from({ length: problemCount }, (_, index) => (
              <div key={`header-problem-${index + 1}`}>{index + 1}</div>
            ))}
            <div>Points</div>
            <div>T</div>
            <div>Z</div>
            <div>A.T</div>
            <div>A.Z</div>
          </div>

          <div className="divide-y divide-black/10">
            {rows.map((entry) => (
              <div key={entry.climber_id} className="grid finals-table-row items-center" style={desktopGridStyle}>
                <div className="finals-rank">{entry.category_rank}</div>
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <div className="finals-athlete-name break-words">{entry.name}</div>
                  <div className="finals-athlete-subline">
                    Qualifier #{entry.previous_round_rank}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="finals-province">{entry.province}</div>
                {entry.problem_results.map((problem) => (
                  <FinalsResultCell
                    key={problem.climb_number}
                    top={problem.top}
                    zone={problem.zone}
                    attemptsToTop={problem.attempts_to_top}
                    attemptsToZone={problem.attempts_to_zone}
                  />
                ))}
                <div className={metricClassName(entry.total_points)}>{formatFinalPoints(entry.total_points)}</div>
                <div className={metricClassName(entry.tops)}>{entry.tops}</div>
                <div className={metricClassName(entry.zones)}>{entry.zones}</div>
                <div className={metricClassName(entry.attempts_to_top)}>{entry.attempts_to_top}</div>
                <div className={metricClassName(entry.attempts_to_zone)}>{entry.attempts_to_zone}</div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}


--- src\components\judge\athlete-picker.tsx ---

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/ui/empty-state";
import { Surface } from "@/components/ui/surface";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

export type AthletePickerStatusTone = "pending" | "dirty" | "zone" | "top" | "saved";

export type AthletePickerEntry = {
  id: string;
  climberNumber: string;
  name: string;
  category: string;
  statusLabel: string;
  resultLabel: string;
  statusTone: AthletePickerStatusTone;
  demoTarget?: boolean;
};

type AthletePickerProps = {
  activeRoundName: string;
  athletes: AthletePickerEntry[];
  problemCount: number;
  query: string;
  savedCount: number;
  selectedAthleteId: string | null;
  selectedBoulder: number;
  totalCount: number;
  onQueryChange: (value: string) => void;
  onSelectAthlete: (athleteId: string) => void;
  onSelectBoulder: (boulder: number) => void;
};

const statusStyles: Record<AthletePickerStatusTone, string> = {
  pending: "border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 text-slate-600",
  dirty: "border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 text-amber-700",
  zone: "border-amber-300 bg-amber-100 text-amber-900",
  top: "border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-900",
  saved: "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700",
};

export function AthletePicker({
  activeRoundName,
  athletes,
  problemCount,
  query,
  savedCount,
  selectedAthleteId,
  selectedBoulder,
  totalCount,
  onQueryChange,
  onSelectAthlete,
  onSelectBoulder,
}: AthletePickerProps) {
  return (
    <Surface density="judge" variant="panel" className="space-y-4">
      <div>
        <div className="results-kicker">{activeRoundName} controls</div>
        <div className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold text-slate-950">
          Boulder {String(selectedBoulder).padStart(2, "0")}
        </div>
        <div className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600">
          {savedCount} of {totalCount} climbers have an entry here.
        </div>
      </div>

      <label className="block">
        <span className="sr-only">Search athletes</span>
        <input
          value={query}
          onChange={(event) => onQueryChange(event.target.value)}
          className="results-input min-h-14 text-base"
          placeholder="Search number, name, category"
          inputMode="search"
        />
      </label>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-4" aria-label="Select boulder">
        {Array.from({ length: problemCount }, (_, index) => index + 1).map((climbNumber) => (
          <Button
            key={climbNumber}
            size="touch"
            variant={selectedBoulder === climbNumber ? "primary" : "secondary"}
            className="min-w-0 px-3 text-base"
            aria-pressed={selectedBoulder === climbNumber}
            onClick={() => onSelectBoulder(climbNumber)}
            data-demo-anchor={climbNumber === 3 ? "judge-b3-button" : undefined}
          >
            B{String(climbNumber).padStart(2, "0")}
          </Button>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-2">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="results-kicker">Athlete picker</div>
          <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500">{athletes.length} shown</div>
        </div>
        <div className="max-h-[36rem] space-y-2 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
          {athletes.map((athlete) => {
            const selected = athlete.id === selectedAthleteId;
            return (
              <button
                key={athlete.id}
                type="button"
                data-demo-target={athlete.demoTarget ? "true" : undefined}
                data-demo-anchor={athlete.demoTarget ? "judge-target-athlete" : undefined}
                onClick={() => onSelectAthlete(athlete.id)}
                className={cn(
                  "w-full rounded-[1.2rem] border px-4 py-3 text-left transition focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-sky-500/40 focus-visible:ring-offset-2",
                  selected
                    ? "border-sky-300 bg-sky-50 shadow-[0_12px_28px_rgba(14,116,215,0.12)]"
                    : "border-slate-200 bg-white/85 hover:border-slate-300 hover:bg-white"
                )}
                aria-pressed={selected}
              >
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <div className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-slate-500">
                      #{athlete.climberNumber}
                    </div>
                    <div className="mt-1 truncate text-lg font-bold text-slate-950">{athlete.name}</div>
                    <div className="mt-1 truncate text-sm text-slate-600">{athlete.category}</div>
                  </div>
                  <div className={cn("shrink-0 rounded-full border px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold", statusStyles[athlete.statusTone])}>
                    {athlete.statusLabel}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="mt-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-600">{athlete.resultLabel}</div>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
        {!athletes.length ? (
          <EmptyState
            eyebrow="No match"
            title="No athletes match that search"
            description="Try a climber number, first name, last name, or category."
            className="bg-white/80"
          />
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </Surface>
  );
}


--- src\components\judge\judge-status-strip.tsx ---

import { SaveStatus } from "@/components/ui/save-status";
import { StatCard } from "@/components/ui/stat-card";

type JudgeStatusStripProps = {
  profileLabel: string;
  saving: boolean;
  queuedCount: number;
  syncStatusLabel: string;
  syncHelperCopy: string;
  qualifierScoringOpen: boolean;
  finalsScoringOpen: boolean;
  liveRoundName: string;
  liveRoundModeLabel: string;
  climberCount: number;
  qualifierProblemCount: number;
};

export function JudgeStatusStrip({
  profileLabel,
  saving,
  queuedCount,
  syncStatusLabel,
  syncHelperCopy,
  qualifierScoringOpen,
  finalsScoringOpen,
  liveRoundName,
  liveRoundModeLabel,
  climberCount,
  qualifierProblemCount,
}: JudgeStatusStripProps) {
  const saveState = saving ? "saving" : queuedCount > 0 ? "queued" : "saved";

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <div className="results-workspace-callout" data-demo-anchor="judge-status">
        <div className="results-kicker">Desk status</div>
        <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <div className="results-chip">{profileLabel}</div>
          <SaveStatus state={saveState} detail={syncStatusLabel} />
          <div className={qualifierScoringOpen ? "results-chip results-chip-live" : "results-chip"}>
            {qualifierScoringOpen ? "Qualifier scoring open" : "Qualifier scoring closed"}
          </div>
          <div className={finalsScoringOpen ? "results-chip results-chip-live" : "results-chip"}>
            {finalsScoringOpen ? "Finals scoring open" : "Finals scoring closed"}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
        <StatCard label="Live round" value={liveRoundName} helper={liveRoundModeLabel} tone="live" />
        <StatCard
          label="Field"
          value={`${climberCount} ${climberCount === 1 ? "climber" : "climbers"}`}
          helper={`${qualifierProblemCount} qualifier ${qualifierProblemCount === 1 ? "boulder" : "boulders"}`}
        />
        <StatCard label="Sync state" value={syncStatusLabel} helper={syncHelperCopy} tone={queuedCount > 0 ? "warning" : "success"} />
        <StatCard
          label="Queue"
          value={queuedCount > 0 ? `${queuedCount} waiting` : "Clear"}
          helper={queuedCount > 0 ? "Device-saved scores will retry automatically." : "No pending judge saves on this device."}
          tone={queuedCount > 0 ? "warning" : "success"}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

type QueuedScorePreview = {

export function OfflineQueuePanel({ queuedCount, queuedItems }: OfflineQueuePanelProps) {

    return null;
  }

  return (
    <div className="rounded-[1.2rem] border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 px-4 py-4">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">

          </div>
          <div className="mt-1 text-sm text-amber-700">
            They will retry automatically as soon as saving is available again.
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="rounded-full border border-amber-300 bg-white/80 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-amber-800">
          Offline proof
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-3 grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
        {queuedItems.slice(0, 4).map((item) => (
          <div key={item.id} className="rounded-[1rem] border border-amber-200 bg-white/80 px-3 py-3 text-sm text-slate-700">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">

              <div className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-slate-500">{item.queuedAtLabel}</div>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-1">
              {item.climbLabel} | {item.resultLabel}
            </div>
            <div className="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-500">
              {item.retryCount > 0 ? `Retry attempts: ${item.retryCount}` : "Waiting for the next publish attempt."}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


--- src\components\judge\qualifier-score-editor.tsx ---

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/ui/empty-state";
import { SaveStatus, type SaveStatusState } from "@/components/ui/save-status";
import { Surface } from "@/components/ui/surface";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

type ConfirmationTone = "pending" | "confirmed" | "dirty";

type QualifierScoreEditorProps = {
  athlete: {
    climberNumber: string;
    name: string;
    category: string;
  } | null;
  attemptCount: number;
  blockedMessage: string;
  boulderNumber: number;
  confirmationLabel: string;
  confirmationTone: ConfirmationTone;
  dirty: boolean;
  liveDetail: string;
  liveLabel: string;
  normalizedPreview: string;
  roundName: string;
  savedSummary: string;
  saveState: SaveStatusState;
  saving: boolean;
  scoringOpen: boolean;
  topped: boolean;
  zone: boolean;
  onAddAttempt: () => void;
  onClear: () => void;
  onDecreaseAttempt: () => void;
  onSave: () => void;
  onToggleTop: () => void;
  onToggleZone: () => void;
};

const confirmationStyles: Record<ConfirmationTone, string> = {
  pending: "border-slate-200 bg-slate-50",
  confirmed: "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50",
  dirty: "border-amber-200 bg-amber-50",
};

export function QualifierScoreEditor({
  athlete,
  attemptCount,
  blockedMessage,
  boulderNumber,
  confirmationLabel,
  confirmationTone,
  dirty,
  liveDetail,
  liveLabel,
  normalizedPreview,
  roundName,
  savedSummary,
  saveState,
  saving,
  scoringOpen,
  topped,
  zone,
  onAddAttempt,
  onClear,
  onDecreaseAttempt,
  onSave,
  onToggleTop,
  onToggleZone,
}: QualifierScoreEditorProps) {
  if (!athlete) {
    return (
      <EmptyState
        eyebrow="Choose athlete"
        title="Pick an athlete to score"
        description="Search or tap a climber from the picker. Their boulder card will stay focused here."
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <Surface density="judge" variant="card" className="space-y-5" data-demo-anchor="judge-entry-cards">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <div className="results-kicker">{roundName} live card</div>
          <h2 className="mt-2 text-3xl font-black leading-tight text-slate-950">
            #{athlete.climberNumber} {athlete.name}
          </h2>
          <p className="mt-1 text-base font-medium text-slate-600">{athlete.category}</p>
        </div>
        <div className="rounded-[1.2rem] border border-sky-200 bg-sky-50 px-4 py-3 text-center">
          <div className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-sky-700">Problem</div>
          <div className="mt-1 text-3xl font-black text-sky-950">B{String(boulderNumber).padStart(2, "0")}</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className={cn("rounded-[1.35rem] border px-4 py-4", confirmationStyles[confirmationTone])}>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div>
            <div className="results-kicker">Cell status</div>
            <div className="mt-2 text-xl font-bold text-slate-950">{confirmationLabel}</div>
          </div>
          <SaveStatus state={saveState} detail={dirty ? "Unsaved changes" : null} />
        </div>
        <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-700">{dirty ? normalizedPreview : `Last saved: ${savedSummary}.`}</p>
      </div>

      {!scoringOpen ? (
        <div className="rounded-[1.2rem] border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium text-amber-800">
          {blockedMessage}
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <div className="grid gap-3 lg:grid-cols-[15rem_minmax(0,1fr)]">
        <Surface variant="meta" density="judge" className="space-y-3">
          <div className="results-kicker">Attempts</div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-[4rem_minmax(0,1fr)] gap-2">
            <Button
              size="touch"
              variant="secondary"
              onClick={onDecreaseAttempt}
              aria-label={`Decrease attempts for ${athlete.name}`}
            >
              -
            </Button>
            <div className="inline-flex min-h-14 items-center justify-center rounded-[1rem] border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 text-4xl font-black text-slate-950">
              {attemptCount}
            </div>
          </div>
          <Button size="touch" variant="primary" fullWidth onClick={onAddAttempt}>
            + Attempt
          </Button>
        </Surface>

        <Surface variant="meta" density="judge" className="space-y-3">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
            <div>
              <div className="results-kicker">Normalized result</div>
              <div className="mt-2 text-2xl font-black text-slate-950">{liveLabel}</div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              <span className={cn("rounded-full border px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold", zone ? "border-amber-300 bg-amber-100 text-amber-950" : "border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-500")}>
                Zone {zone ? "ON" : "OFF"}
              </span>
              <span className={cn("rounded-full border px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold", topped ? "border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-950" : "border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-500")}>
                Top {topped ? "ON" : "OFF"}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <p className="text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600">{liveDetail}</p>
          <p className="rounded-[1rem] border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">
            {normalizedPreview}
          </p>
        </Surface>
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <Button
          size="touch"
          variant="secondary"
          fullWidth
          onClick={onToggleZone}
          aria-pressed={zone && !topped}
          className={cn(
            "min-h-24 flex-col items-start rounded-[1.35rem] border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 text-left text-amber-900 hover:border-amber-300",
            zone && !topped && "border-amber-400 bg-amber-100 shadow-[0_16px_30px_rgba(245,158,11,0.18)]"
          )}
        >
          <span className="text-2xl font-black">Zone</span>
          <span className="mt-1 text-sm">{zone && !topped ? "Control marked" : "Mark control only"}</span>
        </Button>
        <Button
          size="touch"
          variant="secondary"
          fullWidth
          onClick={onToggleTop}
          aria-pressed={topped}
          className={cn(
            "min-h-24 flex-col items-start rounded-[1.35rem] border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-left text-emerald-900 hover:border-emerald-300",
            topped && "border-emerald-400 bg-emerald-100 shadow-[0_16px_30px_rgba(34,197,94,0.18)]"
          )}
        >
          <span className="text-2xl font-black">Top</span>
          <span className="mt-1 text-sm">{topped ? "Finish marked; zone implied" : "Mark finish + zone"}</span>
        </Button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-[12rem_minmax(0,1fr)]">
        <Button size="touch" variant="danger" fullWidth onClick={onClear}>
          Clear
        </Button>
        <Button
          size="touch"
          variant="primary"
          fullWidth
          onClick={onSave}
          disabled={saving || !scoringOpen}
          data-demo-anchor="judge-save-score"
        >
          {saving ? "Saving..." : dirty ? "Save official score" : "Save again"}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </Surface>
  );
}
