                                    return (
                                      <button
                                        key={`${block.id}-${category.id}`}
                                        type="button"
                                        onClick={() => toggleScheduleBlockCategory(block.id, category.id)}
                                        className={active ? "finals-category-pill finals-category-pill-active" : "finals-category-pill"}
                                      >
                                        {category.display_name}
                                      </button>
                                    );
                                  })}
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            ) : null}
                            <div className="results-inline-insert pt-4">
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => {
                                  updateOrganizerDemoState({ scheduleViewed: true });
                                  insertScheduleBlockFromTemplate(insertTemplate, blockIndex, "below");
                                }}
                                className="results-secondary-button"
                              >
                                Add block below
                              </button>
                            </div>
                            </>
                            ) : null}
                          </div>
                        );
                      })
                    ) : (
                      <div className="rounded-[1.4rem] border border-dashed border-slate-300 px-4 py-5 text-sm text-slate-600">
                        No schedule blocks yet. Start with a template above, then adjust the details for your event.
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
                ) : null}

                </fieldset>
                <div className="results-workspace-card">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <div>
                      <div className="results-kicker">{isGuidedStoryAct1 ? "Wizard navigation" : demoMode ? "Move through the spine" : "Wizard navigation"}</div>
                      <div className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-600">
                        {isGuidedStoryAct1 && activeDemoSetupStepStatus?.blockingMessage
                          ? activeDemoSetupStepStatus.blockingMessage
                          : demoMode
                            ? "Stay focused on one setup area at a time, or jump from the progress cards above."
                            : "Move one step at a time, or jump directly from the progress cards above."}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    {!isGuidedStoryAct1 || !isFirstSetupStep ? (
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => goToSetupStep(Math.max(0, currentSetupStep - 1))}
                        disabled={isFirstSetupStep}
                        className="results-secondary-button"
                      >
                        Previous step
                      </button>
                      {!isGuidedStoryAct1 ? (
                      <>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => goToSetupStep(Math.min(SETUP_WIZARD_STEPS.length - 1, currentSetupStep + 1))}
                        disabled={isLastSetupStep}
                        className="results-primary-button"
                      >
                        Next step
                      </button>
                      <button type="button" onClick={persistDraft} disabled={isPending || !canEditSetup} className="results-secondary-button">
                        {isPending ? "Saving..." : "Save competition"}
                      </button>
                      </>
                      ) : null}
                    </div>
                    ) : null}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {currentSetupStep === 5 ? (
                <fieldset disabled={!demoMode && !canEditSetup} className={!demoMode && !canEditSetup ? "space-y-6 opacity-70" : "space-y-6"}>
                <div
                  id="setup-review"
                  className={`results-workspace-card ${demoSeedOnCreate ? "border border-emerald-200/80 bg-[linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(240,253,244,0.94),rgba(255,255,255,0.98))] shadow-[0_18px_40px_rgba(16,185,129,0.08)]" : ""}`}
                >
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
                    <div>
                      <div className="results-kicker text-emerald-700">Step 6 - Review and save</div>
                      <h3 className="mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-950">
                        Save the event before the judge handoff.
                      </h3>
                      <div className="mt-2 max-w-3xl text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600">
                        This last check makes sure the event basics, categories, schedule, and scoring structure all match the persisted competition.
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="results-chip">
                      {readyToSaveChecklist.filter((item) => item.ok).length} / {readyToSaveChecklist.length} ready
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="results-check-grid mt-4">
                    {readyToSaveChecklist.map((item) => (
                      <div
                        key={`review-check-${item.label}`}
                        className={`results-check-card ${item.ok ? "results-check-card-ok" : "results-check-card-warn"}`}
                      >
                        <div className="font-semibold">{item.label}</div>
                        <div className="mt-1">{item.ok ? "Looks good." : "Still needs attention."}</div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={persistDraft}
                      disabled={isPending || !canEditSetup}
                      className="results-primary-button"
                      data-demo-anchor="organizer-save-event"
                    >
                      {isPending ? "Saving..." : "Save competition"}
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="results-secondary-button"
                      disabled={demoSeedPending || !demoSetupValidation.canContinueToJudge}
                      onClick={() => void seedDemoAndOpenJudge()}
                    >
                      {demoSeedPending ? "Adding sample climbers..." : "Continue to Judge Panel"}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  {activeDemoSetupStepStatus?.blockingMessage ? (
                    <div className="mt-4 rounded-[1rem] border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium text-amber-800">
                      {activeDemoSetupStepStatus.blockingMessage}
                    </div>
                  ) : null}
                </div>
                </fieldset>
                ) : null}

                {(!isGuidedStoryAct1 || currentSetupStep === 5) ? (
                <div className={`results-workspace-card ${demoMode ? "border-dashed border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/70" : ""}`}>
                  <div className="results-kicker">After setup - Share links</div>
                  <div className="mt-4 space-y-2 text-sm text-slate-600">
                    <div><span className="font-semibold text-slate-950">Overview:</span> {publicUrl || publicPath}</div>
                    <div><span className="font-semibold text-slate-950">Register:</span> {registerUrl || registerPath}</div>
                  <div><span className="font-semibold text-slate-950">Public display:</span> {displayUrl || displayPath}</div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
                    <button type="button" onClick={() => void navigator.clipboard.writeText(publicUrl)} className="results-secondary-button">Copy overview</button>
                    <button type="button" onClick={() => void navigator.clipboard.writeText(registerUrl)} className="results-secondary-button">Copy register</button>
                    <button type="button" onClick={() => void downloadRegistrationQr()} className="results-secondary-button">Download QR</button>
                    <button type="button" onClick={printRegistrationQr} className="results-secondary-button">Print QR</button>
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-start gap-4">
                    <Image src={registrationQrUrl} alt="Competition registration QR code" width={160} height={160} unoptimized className="rounded-[1.2rem] border border-slate-200 bg-white p-2" />
                    <div className="max-w-xs text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600">
                      Scan this QR code to open the competition registration page directly.
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
                ) : null}

                {currentSetupStep === 4 ? (
                <fieldset disabled={!demoMode && !canEditSetup} className={!demoMode && !canEditSetup ? "space-y-6 opacity-70" : "space-y-6"}>
                {draft.rounds?.length ? (
                  <div
                    id="setup-stages"
                    className={`results-workspace-card ${organizerDemoSectionClass("stages")} ${demoMode ? "border border-sky-200/80 bg-[linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(240,249,255,0.92),rgba(255,255,255,0.98))] shadow-[0_18px_40px_rgba(14,116,215,0.08)]" : ""}`}
                    data-demo-anchor="organizer-stages"
                  >
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                      <div>
                        <div className="results-kicker">Step 5 - Competition stages</div>
                        <div className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-600">
                          Confirm the scored stages, boulder counts, and advancement rules before going live.
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => {
                            updateOrganizerDemoState({ stagesViewed: true });
                            setShowAdvancedStageSettings((current) => !current);
                          }}
                          className="results-secondary-button"
                        >
                          {showAdvancedStageSettings ? "Hide advanced" : "Show advanced"}
                        </button>
                        <button type="button" onClick={() => {
                          updateOrganizerDemoState({ stagesViewed: true });
                          addRound("qualifier");
                        }} className="results-secondary-button">Add qualifier</button>
                        <button type="button" onClick={() => {
                          updateOrganizerDemoState({ stagesViewed: true });
                          addRound("semifinal");
                        }} className="results-secondary-button">Add semifinal</button>
                        <button type="button" onClick={() => {
                          updateOrganizerDemoState({ stagesViewed: true });
                          addRound("finals");
                        }} className="results-secondary-button">Add finals</button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="results-step-summary">
                      {setupStepSummaries[4]}
                    </div>
                    <div className="results-stage-flow mt-4">
                      {currentCompetitionStages.map((round, index) => (
                        <div key={`flow-${round.id}`} className="contents">
                          <span className="results-chip">{round.name}</span>
                          {index < currentCompetitionStages.length - 1 ? <span className="results-stage-flow__connector">{"->"}</span> : null}
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                    <div className="mt-4 space-y-4">
                          {draft.rounds.map((round, index) => {
                            const planningOnly = round.scoring_bucket === "none";
                            const isExpanded = expandedRoundId === round.id;
                            const scoreBearingLabel =
                              round.scoring_bucket === "qualifier"
                                ? "This stage creates rankings"
                                : round.scoring_bucket === "finals"
                                  ? "This stage creates finals rankings"
                                  : "Planning only";
                            return (
                              <div
                                key={round.id}
                                className="results-storyboard-card"
                              >
                                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                                  <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={() => {
                                      updateOrganizerDemoState({ stagesViewed: true });
                                      setExpandedRoundId((current) => (current === round.id ? null : round.id));
                                    }}
                                    className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col items-start text-left"
                                  >
                                    <div className="flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-3">
                                      <div className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-950">{round.name}</div>
                                      <span className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-slate-400">
                                        {isExpanded ? "Collapse" : "Expand"}
                                      </span>
                                    </div>
                                    <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                                      <span className={planningOnly ? "results-chip" : "results-chip border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800"}>
                                        {scoreBearingLabel}
                                      </span>
                                      <span className="results-chip">{round.status}</span>
                                      {round.is_active ? <span className="results-chip border-sky-200 bg-sky-50 text-sky-800">Live stage</span> : null}
                                    </div>
                                  </button>
                                  <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={() => removeRound(round.id)}
                                    disabled={(draft.rounds?.length ?? 0) <= 1}
                                    className="results-danger-button"
                                  >
                                    Remove
                                  </button>
                                </div>
                                <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
                                  <div className="rounded-[1rem] border border-slate-200/80 bg-slate-50/80 px-4 py-3">
                                    <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-slate-500">Stage type</div>
                                    <div className="mt-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-950">{round.round_type}</div>
                                  </div>
                                  <div className="rounded-[1rem] border border-slate-200/80 bg-slate-50/80 px-4 py-3">
                                    <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-slate-500">Scoring mode</div>
                                    <div className="mt-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-950">{planningOnly ? "Planning only" : round.scoring_bucket === "finals" ? "Finals rankings" : "Qualifier rankings"}</div>
                                  </div>
                                  <div className="rounded-[1rem] border border-slate-200/80 bg-slate-50/80 px-4 py-3">
                                    <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-slate-500">Boulder count</div>
                                    <div className="mt-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-950">{round.problem_count}</div>
                                  </div>
                                  <div className="rounded-[1rem] border border-slate-200/80 bg-slate-50/80 px-4 py-3">
                                    <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-slate-500">Advancement</div>
                                    <div className="mt-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-950">
                                      {round.round_type === "semifinal"
                                        ? "Feeds the next stage"
                                        : round.round_type === "finals"
                                          ? "Final scoring stage"
                                          : `Top ${round.finals_cutoff ?? draft.finals_cutoff} move on`}
                                    </div>
                                  </div>
                                </div>
                                <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500">
                                  <span className="results-chip border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 text-slate-600 shadow-none">
                                    {planningOnly ? "Used for planning only" : "Scores saved for this stage"}
                                  </span>
                                  {round.round_type !== "finals" ? (
                                    <span>
                                      Best {round.counting_climbs ?? draft.qualifier_counting_climbs} climbs count toward ranking.
                                    </span>
                                  ) : null}
                                  {round.round_type !== "semifinal" ? (
                                    <span>
                                      Top {round.finals_cutoff ?? draft.finals_cutoff} advance into the next stage.
                                    </span>
                                  ) : null}
                                </div>
                                {index < (draft.rounds?.length ?? 0) - 1 ? <div className="mt-3 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-slate-400">Climbers who advance move into the next stage below</div> : null}
                                {isExpanded ? (
                                    <div className="mt-4">
                                      <div className="mt-4 grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-2 2xl:grid-cols-4">
                                        <label className="space-y-2">
                                          <span className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">Name</span>
                                          <input value={round.name} onChange={(event) => updateRound(round.id, (current) => ({ ...current, name: event.target.value }))} className="results-input" />
                                        </label>
                                        <label className="space-y-2">
                                          <span className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">Round type</span>
                                          <select
                                            value={round.round_type}
                                            onChange={(event) =>
                                              updateRound(round.id, (current) => {
                                                const roundType = event.target.value as CompetitionRoundType;
                                                const scoringBucket =
                                                  current.scoring_bucket === "none"
                                                      ? getRoundDefaultScoringBucket(roundType)
                                                      : current.scoring_bucket;
                                                return {
                                                  ...current,
                                                  round_type: roundType,
                                                  runtime_phase: getRoundRuntimePhase(roundType),
                                                  scoring_bucket: scoringBucket,
                                                  format: roundType === "finals" ? "ifsc_finals_format" : draft.format,
                                                  counting_climbs: roundType === "finals" ? null : current.counting_climbs ?? draft.qualifier_counting_climbs,
                                                  finals_cutoff: roundType === "semifinal" ? null : current.finals_cutoff ?? draft.finals_cutoff,
                                                };
                                              })
                                            }
                                            className="results-input"
                                          >
                                            <option value="qualifier">Qualifier</option>
                                            <option value="semifinal">Semifinal</option>
                                            <option value="finals">Finals</option>
                                          </select>
                                        </label>
                                        <label className="space-y-2">
                                          <span className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">How this stage is used</span>
                                          <select
                                            value={round.scoring_bucket}
                                            onChange={(event) =>
                                              updateRound(round.id, (current) => {
                                                const nextBucket = event.target.value as CompetitionRoundScoringBucket;
                                                if (nextBucket === "finals" && finalsScoreRoundCount >= 1 && current.scoring_bucket !== "finals") {
                                                  return current;
                                                }
                                                if (current.round_type === "finals" && nextBucket === "qualifier") {
                                                  return current;
                                                }
                                                if (current.round_type !== "finals" && nextBucket === "finals") {
                                                  return current;
                                                }
                                                return { ...current, scoring_bucket: nextBucket };
                                              })
                                            }
                                            className="results-input"
                                          >
                                            <option value="none">Planning only</option>
                                            {round.round_type !== "finals" ? <option value="qualifier">Creates rankings for this stage</option> : null}
                                            {round.round_type === "finals" ? <option value="finals">Creates finals rankings</option> : null}
                                          </select>
                                        </label>
                                        <label className="space-y-2">
                                          <span className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">Boulders in this stage</span>
                                          <input
                                            type="number"
                                            min={1}
                                            max={round.round_type === "finals" ? 8 : 200}
                                            value={round.problem_count}
                                            onChange={(event) =>
                                              updateRound(round.id, (current) => ({
                                                ...current,
                                                problem_count: Math.max(1, Number(event.target.value) || current.problem_count),
                                              }))
                                            }
                                            className="results-input"
                                          />
                                        </label>
                                      </div>
                                      <div className="mt-4 grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-2 2xl:grid-cols-3">
                                        {round.round_type !== "finals" ? (
                                          <label className="space-y-2">
                                            <span className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">Top climbs counted</span>
                                            <input
                                              type="number"
                                              min={1}
                                              value={round.counting_climbs ?? draft.qualifier_counting_climbs}
                                              onChange={(event) =>
                                                updateRound(round.id, (current) => ({
                                                  ...current,
                                                  counting_climbs: Math.max(1, Number(event.target.value) || draft.qualifier_counting_climbs),
                                                }))
                                              }
                                              className="results-input"
                                            />
                                          </label>
                                        ) : null}
                                        {round.round_type !== "semifinal" ? (
                                          <label className="space-y-2">
                                            <span className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">Athletes who move on</span>
                                            <select
                                              value={round.finals_cutoff ?? draft.finals_cutoff}
                                              onChange={(event) =>
                                                updateRound(round.id, (current) => ({
                                                  ...current,
                                                  finals_cutoff: Number(event.target.value) === 8 ? 8 : DEFAULT_FINALS_CUTOFF,
                                                  advancement_cutoff: Number(event.target.value) === 8 ? 8 : DEFAULT_FINALS_CUTOFF,
                                                }))
                                              }
                                              className="results-input"
                                            >
                                              <option value={6}>Top 6</option>
                                              <option value={8}>Top 8</option>
                                            </select>
                                          </label>
                                        ) : null}
                                        {showAdvancedStageSettings ? (
                                            <label className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                                              <span className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">Enabled</span>
                                              <button
                                                type="button"
                                                onClick={() => updateRound(round.id, (current) => ({ ...current, is_enabled: !current.is_enabled }))}
                                                className={`${round.is_enabled ? "results-primary-button" : "results-secondary-button"} min-w-0 w-full px-4`}
                                              >
                                                {round.is_enabled ? "Enabled" : "Disabled"}
                                              </button>
                                            </label>
                                          ) : null}
                                      </div>
                                    </div>
                                  ) : null}
                              </div>
                            );
                          })}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ) : null}

                {draftHasFinals && finalsOrder.length && (snapshot?.finalistsPersisted || canEditFinalsOrder) ? (
                  <div className="results-workspace-card">
                    <div className="results-kicker">Finals order</div>
                    <div className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-600">
                      {canEditFinalsOrder
                        ? snapshot?.finalistsPersisted
                          ? "Finals preview is live, so you can set finals order now."
                          : "Finals preview is live. The first change will create the finals field from the projected finalists."
                        : "Finals order is locked outside finals preview."}
                    </div>
                    <div className="mt-4 space-y-3">
                      {finalsOrder.map((finalist, index) => (
                        <div key={finalist.climber_id} className="results-admin-list-item">
                          <div>
                            <div className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-950">{finalist.name}</div>
                            <div className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600">{finalist.display_category} | Qualifying #{finalist.qualifier_rank}</div>
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex gap-2">
                            <button type="button" onClick={() => void moveFinalist(index, -1)} disabled={!canEditFinalsOrder || index === 0} className="results-secondary-button">Up</button>
                            <button type="button" onClick={() => void moveFinalist(index, 1)} disabled={!canEditFinalsOrder || index === finalsOrder.length - 1} className="results-secondary-button">Down</button>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ) : draftHasFinals && finalsOrder.length ? (
                  <div className="results-workspace-card">
                    <div className="results-kicker">Finals order</div>
                    <div className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-600">
                      Projected finalists are visible, but the climbing order can only be edited during finals preview.
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ) : null}

                <div className="results-workspace-card">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <div>
                      <div className="results-kicker">Ready to save</div>
                      <div className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-600">
                        This last check makes sure the event basics, categories, schedule, and scoring structure all tell the same story.
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="results-chip">
                      {readyToSaveChecklist.filter((item) => item.ok).length} / {readyToSaveChecklist.length} ready
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="results-check-grid mt-4">
                    {readyToSaveChecklist.map((item) => (
                      <div
                        key={`save-check-${item.label}`}
                        className={`results-check-card ${item.ok ? "results-check-card-ok" : "results-check-card-warn"}`}
                      >
                        <div className="font-semibold">{item.label}</div>
                        <div className="mt-1">{item.ok ? "Looks good." : "Still needs attention."}</div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
                  <button type="button" onClick={persistDraft} disabled={isPending || !canEditSetup} className="results-primary-button" data-demo-anchor="organizer-save-event">
                    {isPending ? "Saving..." : "Save competition"}
                  </button>
                  {snapshot ? (
                    <>
                      <button type="button" onClick={() => window.open(buildDisplayPath(draft.slug), "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer")} className="results-secondary-button">
                        Open big-screen display
                      </button>
                    </>
                  ) : null}
                </div>
                <div className="results-workspace-card">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <div>
                      <div className="results-kicker">Admin controls</div>
                      <div className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-600">
                        Keep destructive actions here so setup and live event running stay focused.
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="results-chip">{stageFlowSummary}</div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
                    {canRestoreDemo ? (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() =>
                          setConfirming({
                            title: "Restore demo",
                            description:
                              "This rebuilds the seeded demo competition and clears any temporary changes from prior walkthroughs or test scoring.",
                            confirmLabel: "Restore",
                            expectedValue: draft.name,
                            action: async () => {
                              await resetDemoSessionCompetition();
                            },
                          })
                        }
                        className="results-secondary-button"
                      >
                        Restore demo
                      </button>
                    ) : null}
                    <button type="button" onClick={() => setConfirming({
                      title: "Delete event",
                      description: "This permanently deletes the event and all of its registrations, scores, finalists, and schedule data. This cannot be undone.",
                      confirmLabel: "Delete",
                      confirmTone: "danger",
                      expectedValue: draft.name,
                      action: async () => {
                        await deleteCompetition(draft.id);
                        setDraft(null);
                        setSnapshot(null);
                        setSelectedCompetitionId("");
                        await refreshAfterChange();
                        setMessage("Competition deleted.");
                      },
                    })} disabled={!canEditSetup} className="results-danger-button">Delete event</button>
                  </div>
                </div>
                </fieldset>
                ) : null}

                {snapshot && (!demoMode || demoDataExportAllowed) ? (
                  <div className="results-workspace-card">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                      <div>
                        <div className="results-kicker">Exports</div>
                        <div className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-600">
                          {demoMode
                            ? "Demo export uses sample event data only."
                            : "Download standings to share, review, or import elsewhere."}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
                        <button type="button" onClick={() => downloadCsv(`${draft.slug}-qualifiers.csv`, buildQualifierCsv(snapshot))} className="results-secondary-button">
                          Export qualifying CSV
                        </button>
                        <button type="button" onClick={() => downloadCsv(`${draft.slug}-finals.csv`, buildFinalsCsv(snapshot))} className="results-secondary-button" disabled={!snapshot.finalsLeaderboard.length}>
                          Export finals CSV
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ) : null}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="text-slate-600">Select a competition to edit it.</div>
            )}
          </section>
        </section>

        {organizerDemoCursor.visible ? (
          <div
            className={`demo-pointer ${organizerDemoCursor.clicking ? "demo-pointer-clicking" : ""}`}
            style={{
              left: organizerDemoCursor.x,
              top: organizerDemoCursor.y,
            }}
            aria-hidden="true"
          >
            <div className="demo-pointer-dot" />
            {organizerDemoCursor.label ? <div className="demo-pointer-label">{organizerDemoCursor.label}</div> : null}
          </div>
        ) : null}

        <ConfirmationModal
          open={Boolean(confirming)}
          title={confirming?.title ?? ""}
          description={confirming?.description ?? ""}
          confirmLabel={confirming?.confirmLabel ?? "Confirm"}
          confirmTone={confirming?.confirmTone ?? "default"}
          expectedValue={confirming?.expectedValue}
          busy={isPending || isPhasePending}
          onCancel={() => setConfirming(null)}
          onConfirm={async () => {
            if (!confirming) {
              return;
            }

            startTransition(() => {
              void confirming.action().catch((nextError) => {
                setError(nextError instanceof Error ? nextError.message : "Unable to complete the action.");
              });
            });
            setConfirming(null);
          }}
        />
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

  format: EventFormat;
  location: string;
  startDate: string;
  endDate: string;
  registrationOpensAt: string | null;
  registrationClosesAt: string | null;
  description: string;
  maxClimbers?: number;
};

type FormatOption = {
  value: EventFormat;
  label: string;
};

type StaffEventCreationFormProps = {
  values: StaffEventCreationFormValues;
  formatOptions: readonly FormatOption[];
  disabled?: boolean;
  pending?: boolean;
  submitLabel: string;
  submittingLabel?: string;
  canSubmit?: boolean;
  showCapacity?: boolean;
  showRegistrationStory?: boolean;
  hideSubmit?: boolean;
  hideFormat?: boolean;
  formatLabel?: string;
  formatAriaLabel?: string;
  formatLockedNotice?: string | null;
  onChange: (values: StaffEventCreationFormValues) => void;
  onSubmit: () => void;
  importedLinksSummary?: string | null;
};

function formatDateTimeLocalInput(value: string | null | undefined) {
  const trimmed = value?.trim() ?? "";
  if (!trimmed) {
    return "";
  }

  const date = new Date(trimmed);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) {
    return "";
  }

  const localDate = new Date(date.getTime() - date.getTimezoneOffset() * 60_000);
  return localDate.toISOString().slice(0, 16);
}

function parseDateTimeLocalInput(value: string) {
  const trimmed = value.trim();
  if (!trimmed) {
    return null;
  }

  const date = new Date(trimmed);
  return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? null : date.toISOString();
}

export function StaffEventCreationForm({

          className="results-input"
          placeholder="Spring Send"
          data-demo-anchor="organizer-create-name"
        />
      </label>

      <label className="results-field-group" htmlFor="create-event-slug-preview">
        <span className="results-field-label">Link preview</span>
        <input

          aria-label="Event link preview"

          className="results-input bg-slate-50 text-slate-500"

            className="results-input"
            placeholder="North Summit Climbing"
          />

            value={values.endDate}
            onChange={(event) => onChange({ ...values, endDate: event.target.value })}
            className="results-input"
          />
        </label>
      </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-3" data-demo-anchor="organizer-create-registration">

          id="create-event-description"
          aria-label="Event notes"
          value={values.description}
          onChange={(event) => onChange({ ...values, description: event.target.value })}
          className="results-input min-h-[120px] resize-y"

--- src\components\ui\alert.tsx ---

import type { HTMLAttributes, PropsWithChildren } from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

type AlertVariant = "info" | "success" | "warning" | "error";

export function alertStyles(variant: AlertVariant = "info") {
  return cn(
    "rounded-[1.2rem] border px-4 py-3 text-sm shadow-[0_12px_24px_rgba(15,23,42,0.04)]",
    variant === "info" && "border-slate-200 bg-white/75 text-slate-700",
    variant === "success" && "border-green-200 bg-green-50 text-green-700",
    variant === "warning" && "border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 text-amber-700",
    variant === "error" && "border-red-200 bg-red-50 text-red-700"
  );
}

type AlertProps = PropsWithChildren<
  HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> & { variant?: AlertVariant }
>;

export function Alert({ children, className, variant = "info", ...props }: AlertProps) {
  return (
    <div className={cn(alertStyles(variant), className)} {...props}>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}


--- src\components\ui\badge.tsx ---

import type { HTMLAttributes, PropsWithChildren } from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

type BadgeVariant = "default" | "live" | "contrast" | "linear" | "linearMuted";

export function badgeStyles(variant: BadgeVariant = "default") {
  return cn(
    "inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] sm:px-3 sm:py-1.5 sm:text-xs sm:tracking-[0.2em]",
    variant === "default" &&
      "border border-white bg-white/80 text-slate-600 shadow-[0_8px_18px_rgba(15,23,42,0.05)]",
    variant === "live" &&
      "border border-red-200 bg-red-50 text-red-700 shadow-[0_10px_22px_rgba(239,68,68,0.08)]",
    variant === "contrast" &&
      "border border-white/30 bg-white/15 text-white shadow-none",
    variant === "linear" &&
      "border border-[rgba(94,106,210,0.3)] bg-[rgba(94,106,210,0.14)] text-[#cfd5ff] shadow-[0_0_0_1px_rgba(94,106,210,0.14),0_10px_24px_rgba(26,33,82,0.18)]",
    variant === "linearMuted" &&
      "border border-white/[0.08] bg-white/[0.05] text-[#a0a5af] shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.05)]"
  );
}

type BadgeProps = PropsWithChildren<
  HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement> & { variant?: BadgeVariant }
>;

--- src\lib\attempts.test.ts ---

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { normalizeFinalAttemptInput, normalizeQualifierAttemptInput } from "./attempts";

describe("normalizeQualifierAttemptInput", () => {
  it("bumps topped qualifier saves to at least one attempt", () => {
    expect(
      normalizeQualifierAttemptInput({
        attemptCount: 0,
        topped: true,
      })
    ).toEqual({
      attemptCount: 1,
      topped: true,
      zone: true,
      attemptsToTop: 1,
      attemptsToZone: 1,
    });
  });

  it("keeps untopped qualifier saves at zero attempts when no score exists", () => {
    expect(
      normalizeQualifierAttemptInput({
        attemptCount: 0,
        topped: false,
      })
    ).toEqual({
      attemptCount: 0,
      topped: false,
      zone: false,
      attemptsToTop: null,
      attemptsToZone: null,
    });
  });
});

describe("normalizeFinalAttemptInput", () => {
  it("forces positive attempts for zone-only saves", () => {
    expect(
      normalizeFinalAttemptInput({
        top: false,
        zone: true,
        attemptsToZone: 0,
      })
    ).toEqual({
      top: false,
      zone: true,
      attemptsToTop: null,
      attemptsToZone: 1,
    });
  });

  it("keeps top and zone aligned for top saves", () => {
    expect(
      normalizeFinalAttemptInput({
        top: true,
        zone: false,
        attemptsToTop: 0,
        attemptsToZone: 0,
      })
    ).toEqual({
      top: true,
      zone: true,
      attemptsToTop: 1,
      attemptsToZone: 1,
    });
  });
});


--- src\lib\attempts.ts ---

function toWholeAttempts(value: number | null | undefined, fallback = 0) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) {
    return fallback;
  }

  return Math.max(0, Math.trunc(value ?? fallback));
}

function toPositiveAttempts(value: number | null | undefined, fallback = 1) {
  return Math.max(1, toWholeAttempts(value, fallback));
}

export function normalizeQualifierAttemptInput(input: {
  attemptCount: number;
  topped: boolean;
  zone?: boolean;
  attemptsToTop?: number | null;
  attemptsToZone?: number | null;
}) {
  const topped = Boolean(input.topped);
  const zone = Boolean(input.zone ?? topped);
  const attemptCount = topped || zone ? toPositiveAttempts(input.attemptCount, 1) : toWholeAttempts(input.attemptCount, 0);
  const attemptsToTop = topped ? toPositiveAttempts(input.attemptsToTop, attemptCount) : null;
  const attemptsToZone = zone ? toPositiveAttempts(input.attemptsToZone, attemptsToTop ?? attemptCount ?? 1) : null;

  return {
    attemptCount,
    topped,
    zone,
    attemptsToTop,
    attemptsToZone,
  };
}

export function normalizeFinalAttemptInput(input: {
  top: boolean;
  zone: boolean;
  attemptsToTop?: number | null;
  attemptsToZone?: number | null;
}) {
  const top = Boolean(input.top);
  const zone = Boolean(input.zone || top);
  const attemptsToTop = top ? toPositiveAttempts(input.attemptsToTop, 1) : null;
  const attemptsToZone = zone ? toPositiveAttempts(input.attemptsToZone, attemptsToTop ?? 1) : null;

  return {
    top,
    zone,
    attemptsToTop,
    attemptsToZone,
  };
}


--- src\lib\auth.ts ---

import type { Session } from "@supabase/supabase-js";
import { assertSupabaseConfigured, supabase } from "./supabase";

export type AppRole = "admin" | "judge" | "climber";
const AUTH_TIMEOUT_MS = 10000;

export interface Profile {
  id: string;
  role: AppRole;
  display_name?: string | null;
}

export interface AuthState {
  session: Session | null;
  profile: Profile | null;
}

export function isStaffRole(role: AppRole | null | undefined) {
  return role === "admin" || role === "judge";
}

function withTimeout<T>(promise: PromiseLike<T>, label: string): Promise<T> {
  return Promise.race<T>([
    promise,
    new Promise<never>((_, reject) => {
      window.setTimeout(() => {
        reject(
          new Error(
            `${label} timed out. Check your Supabase URL/key, confirm the schema is applied, and make sure your user has a row in public.profiles.`
          )
        );
      }, AUTH_TIMEOUT_MS);
    }),
  ]);
}

async function getProfile(userId: string): Promise<Profile | null> {
  const { data, error } = await withTimeout<any>(
    supabase.from("profiles").select("id, role, display_name").eq("id", userId).maybeSingle(),
    "Profile lookup"
  );

  if (error || !data) {
    return null;
  }

  return data as Profile;
}

export async function getAuthState(): Promise<AuthState> {
  assertSupabaseConfigured();

  const {
    data: { session },
    error,
  } = await withTimeout<any>(supabase.auth.getSession(), "Session lookup");

  if (error) {
    throw new Error(error.message);
  }

  if (!session) {
    return {
      session: null,
      profile: null,
    };
  }

  return {
    session,
    profile: await getProfile(session.user.id),
  };
}

export async function signInWithRole(email: string, password: string): Promise<AuthState> {
  assertSupabaseConfigured();

  const { data, error } = await withTimeout<any>(
    supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({
      email: email.trim(),
      password,
    }),
    "Sign-in"
  );

  if (error) {
    throw new Error(error.message);
  }

  if (!data.session) {
    throw new Error("Supabase did not return a session for this login.");
  }

  const profile = await getProfile(data.session.user.id);

  if (!isStaffRole(profile?.role)) {
    await supabase.auth.signOut();
    throw new Error(
      "This account can sign in, but it is not assigned the judge or admin role in public.profiles."
    );
  }

  return {
    session: data.session,
    profile,
  };
}

export async function signOutUser() {
  assertSupabaseConfigured();

  const { error } = await supabase.auth.signOut();
  if (error) {
    throw new Error(error.message);
  }
}

import {

    expect(rounds[0]).toMatchObject({
      round_type: "qualifier",
      scoring_bucket: "qualifier",
      problem_count: CASCADE_CUP_DEMO_QUALIFIER_PROBLEMS,
      counting_climbs: CASCADE_CUP_DEMO_COUNTING_CLIMBS,
      advancement_cutoff: CASCADE_CUP_DEMO_FINALS_CUTOFF,
      is_active: true,
    });
    expect(rounds[1]).toMatchObject({
      round_type: "finals",
      scoring_bucket: "finals",
      problem_count: CASCADE_CUP_DEMO_FINALS_PROBLEM_COUNT,
      advancement_source_round_id: rounds[0].id,
      is_active: false,
    });
  });

  it("creates the Cascade Cup schedule blocks that line up with the rounds", () => {
    const categories = getCascadeCupCategoryRows("competition-1");
    const rounds = buildCascadeCupRounds({
      id: "competition-1",
      format: "five_on_five_off",
      current_phase: "qualifier_open",
    });
    const blocks = buildCascadeCupScheduleBlocks(
      "competition-1",
      rounds,
      categories.map((category) => category.id)
    );

    expect(blocks.map((block) => block.label)).toEqual([
      "Check-in",
      "Rules briefing",
      "Cascade Cup qualifier",
      "Finals",
      "Results / Awards",
    ]);
    expect(blocks.find((block) => block.phase_type === "qualifier_round")).toMatchObject({
      round_id: rounds[0].id,
      is_active: true,
    });
    expect(blocks.find((block) => block.phase_type === "finals_round")).toMatchObject({
      round_id: rounds[1].id,
      is_active: false,
    });
  });

  it("seeds 48 climbers with Maya Chen as #104", () => {
    const climbers = getCascadeCupSeedClimbers();

    expect(climbers).toHaveLength(48);
    expect(new Set(climbers.map((climber) => climber.number)).size).toBe(48);
    expect(climbers.find((climber) => climber.number === "104")).toMatchObject({
      name: "Maya Chen",
      target: true,
      genderDivision: "Men",
      ageGroup: "Youth B",
    });
  });
});

export function getCascadeCupCategoryRows(competitionId: string): CompetitionCategory[] {
  return CASCADE_CUP_GENDER_DIVISIONS.flatMap((genderDivision) =>
    CASCADE_CUP_AGE_GROUPS.map((ageGroup) => {
      const id = createCategoryKey(genderDivision, ageGroup);
      return {
        id,
        competition_id: competitionId,
        gender_division: genderDivision,
        age_group: ageGroup,
        display_name: buildDisplayCategory(genderDivision, ageGroup),
        sort_order: CATEGORY_SORT_ORDER.get(id) ?? 0,
      };
    })
  );
}

export function getCascadeCupCategoryIds() {
  return CASCADE_CUP_GENDER_DIVISIONS.flatMap((genderDivision) =>
    CASCADE_CUP_AGE_GROUPS.map((ageGroup) => createCategoryKey(genderDivision, ageGroup))
  );
}

export function getCascadeCupSeedClimbers(): CascadeCupClimberSeed[] {
  let number = 101;
  let nameIndex = 0;

  return CASCADE_CUP_GENDER_DIVISIONS.flatMap((genderDivision) =>
    CASCADE_CUP_AGE_GROUPS.flatMap((ageGroup) =>
      Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, seedIndex) => {
        const isTarget = genderDivision === "Men" && ageGroup === "Youth B" && seedIndex === 6;
        const climberNumber = isTarget ? "104" : String(number === 104 ? ++number : number);
        number += 1;

        return {
          name: isTarget ? "Maya Chen" : CASCADE_CUP_NAMES[nameIndex++ % CASCADE_CUP_NAMES.length],
          number: climberNumber,
          province: PROVINCES[(number + seedIndex) % PROVINCES.length],
          genderDivision,
          ageGroup,
          categoryId: createCategoryKey(genderDivision, ageGroup),
          seedIndex,
          target: isTarget,
        };
      })
    )
  );
}

export function sampleCascadeCupScorecardToken(competitionId: string, climberNumber: string) {
  return `scorecard-demo-seed-${competitionId}-${climberNumber}`;
}

export function buildCascadeCupScorecardUrl(slug: string, competitionId: string, climberNumber = "104") {
  const params = new URLSearchParams({
    token: sampleCascadeCupScorecardToken(competitionId, climberNumber),
    demo: "1",
  });
  return `${buildCompetitionPath(slug, "scorecard")}?${params.toString()}`;
}

      round_id: null,
      sort_order: 2,
      label: "Rules briefing",
      phase_type: "technical_meeting",
      audience_label: "Athletes, coaches, and judges",
      is_active: false,
      start_time: "9:00 AM",
      end_time: "9:20 AM",
      capacity: CASCADE_CUP_DEMO_MAX_CLIMBERS,
      eligible_category_ids: [],
    },

      round_id: qualifierRoundId,
      sort_order: 3,
      label: "Cascade Cup qualifier",
      phase_type: "qualifier_round",

      end_time: "12:30 PM",

      sort_order: 4,
      label: "Finals",

      capacity: CASCADE_CUP_DEMO_FINALS_CUTOFF * CASCADE_CUP_AGE_GROUPS.length * CASCADE_CUP_GENDER_DIVISIONS.length,

    },

}

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  constrainFinalsEligibleAgeGroupsToSelectedCategories,
  finalsEligibilityUsesSelectedCategories,
  getFinalsEligibilityOptions,
} from "./competition-category-eligibility";
import { DEFAULT_COMPETITION, getDefaultCompetitionCategories, normalizeCompetition } from "./scoring";

describe("competition category eligibility", () => {
  it("derives finals options from selected category rows with ids and display names", () => {
    const competition = normalizeCompetition(
      {
        ...DEFAULT_COMPETITION,
        id: "category-options",
        qualifier_eligible_age_groups: ["Youth B", "Open"],
        finals_eligible_age_groups: ["Open"],
      },
      getDefaultCompetitionCategories("category-options"),
      [],
      []
    );

    const options = getFinalsEligibilityOptions(competition);

    expect(options.map((option) => option.ageGroup)).toEqual(["Youth B", "Open"]);
    expect(options.find((option) => option.ageGroup === "Open")?.categoryIds).toEqual([
      "Men::Open",
      "Women::Open",
      "X::Open",
    ]);
    expect(options.find((option) => option.ageGroup === "Open")?.displayCategories).toEqual([
      "Men / Open",
      "Women / Open",
      "X / Open",
    ]);
  });

  it("constrains finals age groups to categories selected for qualifiers", () => {
    const competition = normalizeCompetition(
      {
        ...DEFAULT_COMPETITION,
        id: "category-constraint",
        qualifier_eligible_age_groups: ["Rec"],
        finals_eligible_age_groups: ["Rec", "Open"],
      },
      getDefaultCompetitionCategories("category-constraint"),
      [],
      []
    );

    expect(finalsEligibilityUsesSelectedCategories(competition)).toBe(false);
    expect(constrainFinalsEligibleAgeGroupsToSelectedCategories(competition)).toEqual(["Rec"]);
  });
});


--- src\lib\competition-category-eligibility.ts ---

import {
  isQualifierEligibleCategory,
  type Competition,
  type CompetitionCategory,
} from "./scoring";

export type FinalsEligibilityOption = {
  ageGroup: string;
  categoryIds: string[];
  displayCategories: string[];
};

export function getSelectedQualifierCategories(competition: Competition) {
  return competition.categories.filter((category) =>
    isQualifierEligibleCategory(competition, category.age_group)
  );
}

export function getFinalsEligibilityOptionsFromCategories(categories: CompetitionCategory[]) {
  const grouped = new Map<string, FinalsEligibilityOption>();

  for (const category of categories) {
    const current =
      grouped.get(category.age_group) ??
      {
        ageGroup: category.age_group,
        categoryIds: [],
        displayCategories: [],
      };

    current.categoryIds.push(category.id);
    current.displayCategories.push(category.display_name);
    grouped.set(category.age_group, current);
  }

  return Array.from(grouped.values());
}

export function getFinalsEligibilityOptions(competition: Competition) {
  return getFinalsEligibilityOptionsFromCategories(getSelectedQualifierCategories(competition));
}

export function getAllowedFinalsAgeGroupsFromSelectedCategories(competition: Competition) {
  return new Set(getFinalsEligibilityOptions(competition).map((option) => option.ageGroup));
}

export function constrainFinalsEligibleAgeGroupsToSelectedCategories(competition: Competition) {
  const allowedAgeGroups = getAllowedFinalsAgeGroupsFromSelectedCategories(competition);
  return competition.finals_eligible_age_groups.filter((ageGroup) => allowedAgeGroups.has(ageGroup));
}

export function finalsEligibilityUsesSelectedCategories(competition: Competition) {
  const allowedAgeGroups = getAllowedFinalsAgeGroupsFromSelectedCategories(competition);
  return competition.finals_eligible_age_groups.every((ageGroup) => allowedAgeGroups.has(ageGroup));
}


--- src\lib\competition-presets.test.ts ---

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  COMPETITION_PRESETS,
  detectCompetitionPreset,
  getCompetitionPreset,
  getGuidedDemoPreset,
  getPresetFinalsEligibleCategories,
} from "./competition-presets";
import { DEFAULT_COMPETITION, normalizeCompetition } from "./scoring";

describe("competition presets", () => {
  it("provides the recommended preset set plus Custom", () => {
    expect(COMPETITION_PRESETS.map((preset) => preset.name)).toEqual([
      "Community Scramble",
      "Recreational Scramble + Awards",
      "Youth Qualifier Day",
      "Youth Championship with Finals",
      "Open Boulder Championship",
      "IFSC-Style Finals Event",
      "Flash Format Competition",
      "Finals-Only Showcase",
      "Training / Mock Event",
      "Custom",
    ]);
  });

  it("keeps existing generic competitions custom unless they exactly match a preset", () => {
    const existingCompetition = normalizeCompetition(
      {
        ...DEFAULT_COMPETITION,
        id: "existing-comp",
        name: "Existing Saved Competition",
        slug: "existing-saved-competition",
      },
      [],
      [],
      []
    );

    expect(detectCompetitionPreset(existingCompetition).id).toBe("custom");
  });

  it("uses a finals-capable preset for the guided demo story", () => {
    const preset = getGuidedDemoPreset();

    expect(preset.id).toBe("youth_championship_finals");
    expect(preset.finalsEnabled).toBe(true);
    expect(preset.finalsCutoff).toBe(6);
    expect(preset.finalsProblemCount).toBe(4);
    expect(preset.finalsEligibleCategories).toEqual(["Youth B", "Youth A", "Junior"]);
    expect(preset.defaultScheduleBlocks.some((block) => block.phase_type === "isolation")).toBe(true);
    expect(preset.defaultScheduleBlocks.some((block) => block.phase_type === "observation")).toBe(true);
    expect(preset.defaultScheduleBlocks.some((block) => block.phase_type === "finals_round")).toBe(true);
  });

  it("does not use qualifier-only presets for the guided demo story", () => {
    const guidedPreset = getGuidedDemoPreset();
    const qualifierOnlyPresetIds = COMPETITION_PRESETS.filter((preset) => !preset.finalsEnabled).map(
      (preset) => preset.id
    );

    expect(qualifierOnlyPresetIds).toEqual([
      "community_scramble",
      "recreational_scramble_awards",
      "youth_qualifier_day",
    ]);
    expect(qualifierOnlyPresetIds).not.toContain(guidedPreset.id);
  });

  it("keeps existing demo competitions custom so presets do not regenerate demo data", () => {
    const preset = getCompetitionPreset("training_mock_event");
    const demoCompetition = normalizeCompetition(
      {
        ...DEFAULT_COMPETITION,
        id: "canonical-demo",
        name: "Canonical Demo",
        slug: "spring-open-2026-demo",
        is_demo: true,
        format: preset.format,
        has_finals: preset.finalsEnabled,
        finals_cutoff: preset.finalsCutoff,
        finals_tie_advances: preset.tiesAdvanceDefault,
        total_climbs: preset.qualifierProblemCount,
        qualifier_counting_climbs: preset.countingClimbs,
        finals_problem_count: preset.finalsProblemCount,
        qualifier_eligible_age_groups: [...preset.defaultCategories],
        finals_eligible_age_groups: getPresetFinalsEligibleCategories(preset),
      },
      [],
      [],
      []
    );

    expect(detectCompetitionPreset(demoCompetition).id).toBe("custom");
  });

  it("confidently detects a competition that matches a preset contract", () => {
    const preset = getCompetitionPreset("open_boulder_championship");
    const competition = normalizeCompetition(
      {
        ...DEFAULT_COMPETITION,
        id: "open-championship",
        name: "Open Championship",
        slug: "open-championship",
        format: preset.format,
        has_finals: preset.finalsEnabled,
        finals_cutoff: preset.finalsCutoff,
        finals_tie_advances: preset.tiesAdvanceDefault,
        total_climbs: preset.qualifierProblemCount,
        qualifier_counting_climbs: preset.countingClimbs,
        finals_problem_count: preset.finalsProblemCount,
        qualifier_eligible_age_groups: [...preset.defaultCategories],
        finals_eligible_age_groups: getPresetFinalsEligibleCategories(preset),
      },
      [],
      [],
      []
    );

    expect(detectCompetitionPreset(competition).id).toBe("open_boulder_championship");
  });

  it("never exposes finals-eligible categories outside the preset qualifier field", () => {
    for (const preset of COMPETITION_PRESETS) {
      expect(
        getPresetFinalsEligibleCategories(preset).every((ageGroup) =>
          preset.defaultCategories.includes(ageGroup)
        )
      ).toBe(true);
    }
  });
});

import {

    audience_label: "Finalists",
  },
  {

    audience_label: "Finalists",
  },
  {

    audience_label: "Finalists",
  },
];

function qualifierBlock(label: string, audienceLabel: string, eligibleAgeGroups?: string[]): CompetitionPresetScheduleBlock {
  return {
    label,
    phase_type: "qualifier_round",
    round_type: "qualifier",
    audience_label: audienceLabel,
    eligible_age_groups: eligibleAgeGroups,
  };
}

export function getCompetitionPreset(presetId: CompetitionPresetId) {
  return COMPETITION_PRESETS.find((preset) => preset.id === presetId) ?? COMPETITION_PRESETS[COMPETITION_PRESETS.length - 1];
}

export function getGuidedDemoPreset() {
  const preset = getCompetitionPreset(GUIDED_DEMO_PRESET_ID);

  if (!preset.finalsEnabled) {
    throw new Error("The guided demo preset must support finals.");
  }

  return preset;
}

export function getPresetFinalsEligibleCategories(preset: CompetitionPreset) {
  return preset.finalsEnabled
    ? preset.finalsEligibleCategories.filter((ageGroup) => preset.defaultCategories.includes(ageGroup))
    : [];
}

function sortPresetCategories(categories: readonly string[]) {
  return [...categories].sort((left, right) => {
    const leftIndex = CATEGORY_AGE_GROUPS.indexOf(left as (typeof CATEGORY_AGE_GROUPS)[number]);
    const rightIndex = CATEGORY_AGE_GROUPS.indexOf(right as (typeof CATEGORY_AGE_GROUPS)[number]);
    return (leftIndex === -1 ? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER : leftIndex) - (rightIndex === -1 ? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER : rightIndex);
  });
}

function categorySetsEqual(left: readonly string[], right: readonly string[]) {
  const sortedLeft = sortPresetCategories(left);
  const sortedRight = sortPresetCategories(right);
  return sortedLeft.length === sortedRight.length && sortedLeft.every((entry, index) => entry === sortedRight[index]);
}

export function detectCompetitionPreset(competition: Competition): CompetitionPreset {
  if (competition.is_demo) {
    return getCompetitionPreset("custom");
  }

  const matchedPreset = COMPETITION_PRESETS.find((preset) => {
    if (preset.id === "custom") {
      return false;
    }

    return (
      competition.format === preset.format &&
      competition.has_finals === preset.finalsEnabled &&
      competition.finals_cutoff === preset.finalsCutoff &&
      competition.finals_tie_advances === preset.tiesAdvanceDefault &&
      competition.total_climbs === preset.qualifierProblemCount &&
      competition.qualifier_counting_climbs === preset.countingClimbs &&
      competition.finals_problem_count === preset.finalsProblemCount &&
      categorySetsEqual(competition.qualifier_eligible_age_groups, preset.defaultCategories) &&
      categorySetsEqual(competition.finals_eligible_age_groups, getPresetFinalsEligibleCategories(preset))
    );
  });

  return matchedPreset ?? getCompetitionPreset("custom");
}

import {
  competitionHasFinals,
  createCompetitionRoundId,
  getRoundDefaultScoringBucket,
  getRoundLabel,
  getRoundRuntimePhase,
  type Competition,
  type CompetitionRound,
  type CompetitionRoundType,
  type CompetitionScheduleBlock,
} from "./scoring";

function createRoundTemplate(
  competition: Pick<Competition, "id" | "format" | "total_climbs" | "qualifier_counting_climbs" | "finals_cutoff" | "finals_problem_count">,
  roundType: CompetitionRoundType,
  sortOrder: number
): CompetitionRound {
  const scoringBucket = getRoundDefaultScoringBucket(roundType);
  return {
    id: createCompetitionRoundId(),
    competition_id: competition.id,
    round_number: sortOrder,
    sort_order: sortOrder,
    name: getRoundLabel(roundType, sortOrder - 1),
    round_type: roundType,
    format: roundType === "finals" ? "ifsc_finals_format" : competition.format,
    status: "pending",
    runtime_phase: getRoundRuntimePhase(roundType),
    is_enabled: true,
    is_active: scoringBucket === "qualifier",
    activated_at: null,
    problem_count: roundType === "finals" ? competition.finals_problem_count : competition.total_climbs,
    counting_climbs: roundType === "finals" ? null : competition.qualifier_counting_climbs,
    finals_cutoff: roundType === "semifinal" ? null : competition.finals_cutoff,
    eligible_category_ids: [],
    advancement_source_round_id: null,
    advancement_cutoff: roundType === "finals" ? competition.finals_cutoff : null,
    scoring_bucket: scoringBucket,
    scoring_config: {},
    started_at: null,
    closed_at: null,
  };
}

function normalizeRoundOrdering(rounds: CompetitionRound[], competitionId: string) {
  return rounds.map((round, index) => ({
    ...round,
    round_number: index + 1,
    sort_order: index + 1,
    competition_id: competitionId,
  }));
}

function normalizeFinalsScheduleLinks(
  scheduleBlocks: CompetitionScheduleBlock[],
  shouldHaveFinals: boolean,
  finalsRoundId: string | null
) {
  const finalsLinkedPhaseTypes = new Set<CompetitionScheduleBlock["phase_type"]>([
    "isolation",
    "observation",
    "finals_round",
  ]);

  let changed = false;
  const nextScheduleBlocks = scheduleBlocks.map((block) => {
    if (!finalsLinkedPhaseTypes.has(block.phase_type)) {
      return block;
    }

    const nextRoundId = shouldHaveFinals ? finalsRoundId : null;
    if ((block.round_id ?? null) === nextRoundId) {
      return block;
    }

    changed = true;
    return {
      ...block,
      round_id: nextRoundId,
    };
  });

  return { changed, scheduleBlocks: nextScheduleBlocks };
}

export function normalizeCompetitionFinalsSetup(competition: Competition) {
  const currentRounds = [...(competition.rounds ?? [])];
  const shouldHaveFinals = competitionHasFinals(competition);
  const qualifierStyleRounds = currentRounds.filter(
    (round) =>
      round.scoring_bucket === "qualifier" ||
      round.round_type === "qualifier" ||
      round.round_type === "semifinal"
  );
  const advancementSourceRound = qualifierStyleRounds[qualifierStyleRounds.length - 1] ?? currentRounds[0] ?? null;
  const finalsRoundIndex = currentRounds.findIndex((round) => round.scoring_bucket === "finals");
  const standbyFinalsRoundIndex = currentRounds.findIndex(
    (round) => round.round_type === "finals" && round.scoring_bucket !== "finals"
  );

  let nextRounds = currentRounds;
  let roundsChanged = false;

  if (shouldHaveFinals && finalsRoundIndex < 0) {
    if (standbyFinalsRoundIndex >= 0) {
      nextRounds = currentRounds.map((round, index) =>
        index === standbyFinalsRoundIndex
          ? {
              ...round,
              scoring_bucket: "finals",
              format: "ifsc_finals_format",
              advancement_source_round_id: round.advancement_source_round_id ?? advancementSourceRound?.id ?? null,
            }
          : round
      );
    } else {
      const nextFinalsRound = createRoundTemplate(competition, "finals", currentRounds.length + 1);
      nextFinalsRound.advancement_source_round_id = advancementSourceRound?.id ?? null;
      nextRounds = [...currentRounds, nextFinalsRound];
    }
    roundsChanged = true;
  }

  if (!shouldHaveFinals && finalsRoundIndex >= 0) {
    nextRounds = currentRounds.filter((round) => round.scoring_bucket !== "finals");
    roundsChanged = true;
  }

  if (roundsChanged) {
    nextRounds = normalizeRoundOrdering(nextRounds, competition.id);
  }

  const finalsRound = nextRounds.find((round) => round.scoring_bucket === "finals") ?? null;
  const { changed: scheduleChanged, scheduleBlocks } = normalizeFinalsScheduleLinks(
    competition.schedule_blocks,
    shouldHaveFinals,
    finalsRound?.id ?? null
  );

  const nextHasFinals = shouldHaveFinals && Boolean(finalsRound);
  const changed = roundsChanged || scheduleChanged || competition.has_finals !== nextHasFinals;

  if (!changed) {
    return {
      changed: false,
      competition,
    };
  }

  return {
    changed: true,
    competition: {
      ...competition,
      rounds: nextRounds,
      schedule_blocks: scheduleBlocks,
      has_finals: nextHasFinals,
    },
  };
}

function dedupeFinalists<T extends FinalistSelection>(finalists: T[]) {
  const seen = new Set<string>();

  return finalists.filter((finalist) => {
    if (!finalist.climber_id || seen.has(finalist.climber_id)) {
      return false;
    }

    seen.add(finalist.climber_id);
    return true;
  });
}

function ensureConfigured() {
  assertSupabaseConfigured();
}

function getReadClient(options?: ReadOptions): SupabaseReadClient {
  return options?.readClient ?? (options?.authenticated ? supabase : publicSupabase);
}

async function postAdminCompetitionAction<TResponse extends Record<string, unknown> = Record<string, unknown>>(
  payload: Record<string, unknown>
) {
  const response = await fetch("/api/staff/competitions/actions", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify(payload),
  });
  const body = (await response.json().catch(() => null)) as { error?: unknown } | null;

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(typeof body?.error === "string" ? body.error : "Unable to complete admin action.");
  }

  return (body ?? {}) as TResponse;
}

function cleanString(value: string) {
  return value.trim();
}

function cleanOptionalString(value: string | null | undefined) {
  const normalized = value?.trim();
  return normalized ? normalized : null;
}

function createAccessToken() {
  const safeRandom =
    typeof crypto !== "undefined" && typeof crypto.randomUUID === "function"
      ? crypto.randomUUID().replace(/-/g, "")
      : `${Date.now().toString(36)}${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 12)}`;

  return safeRandom.slice(0, 32);
}

function createId() {
  if (typeof crypto !== "undefined" && typeof crypto.randomUUID === "function") {
    return crypto.randomUUID();
  }

  return `generated-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`;
}

function arrayifyIds(value: unknown) {
  if (!value) {
    return [] as string[];
  }

  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    return value.filter((entry): entry is string => typeof entry === "string");
  }

  return [] as string[];
}

function parseScoreWriteResult<TAttempt>(payload: unknown) {
  const normalizedPayload =
    Array.isArray(payload) ? payload[0] : payload;

  if (!normalizedPayload || typeof normalizedPayload !== "object") {
    throw new Error("Score save completed without a valid payload.");
  }

  const record = normalizedPayload as Record<string, unknown>;
  const attempt = record.attempt;
  if (!attempt || typeof attempt !== "object") {
    throw new Error("Score save completed without a projected attempt row.");
  }

  return {
    attempt: attempt as TAttempt,
    status: (record.status as ScoreWriteStatus | undefined) ?? "accepted",
    conflictReason:
      typeof record.conflict_reason === "string"
        ? record.conflict_reason
        : typeof record.conflictReason === "string"
          ? record.conflictReason
          : null,
    clientEventId:
      typeof record.client_event_id === "string"
        ? record.client_event_id
        : typeof record.clientEventId === "string"
          ? record.clientEventId
          : "",
    scoredAt:
      typeof record.scored_at === "string"
        ? record.scored_at
        : typeof record.scoredAt === "string"
          ? record.scoredAt
          : new Date().toISOString(),
  } satisfies ScoreWriteResult<TAttempt>;
}

async function postStaffScore<TAttempt>(path: string, payload: Record<string, unknown>) {
  const response = await fetch(path, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify(payload),
  });
  const data = (await response.json().catch(() => null)) as unknown;

  if (!response.ok) {
    const message =
      data && typeof data === "object" && typeof (data as { error?: unknown }).error === "string"
        ? (data as { error: string }).error
        : "Unable to save score.";
    throw new Error(message);
  }

  return parseScoreWriteResult<TAttempt>(data);
}

function assertQualifierOpen(competition: Competition, message: string) {
  if (!isQualifierStage(competition)) {
    throw new Error(message);
  }
}

function assertFinalsOpen(competition: Competition, message: string) {
  if (!isFinalsStage(competition)) {
    throw new Error(message);
  }
}

function assertRegistrationWindowOpen(competition: Competition) {
  assertQualifierOpen(competition, "Registration is closed because this competition has already advanced to finals.");

  if (!canRegisterDuringCompetition(competition)) {
    throw new Error("Registration is not open for this competition.");
  }
}

function assertStaffQualifierWindowOpen(competition: Competition) {
  assertQualifierOpen(competition, "Qualifier scoring is locked because this competition has advanced to finals.");

  if (!canStaffScoreQualifier(competition)) {
    throw new Error("Qualifier scoring is not open during the current competition phase.");
  }
}

function assertClimberQualifierWindowOpen(competition: Competition) {
  assertQualifierOpen(competition, "Qualifier scoring is locked because this competition has advanced to finals.");

  if (!canClimberSelfScoreQualifier(competition)) {
    throw new Error("Private qualifier scoring is only open while qualifier scoring is live.");
  }
}

function assertFinalsWindowOpen(competition: Competition) {
  assertFinalsOpen(competition, "Finals scoring is not available until this competition advances to finals.");

  if (!canStaffScoreFinals(competition)) {
    throw new Error("Finals scoring is not open during the current competition phase.");
  }
}

function requireActiveQualifierStyleRound(competition: Competition) {
  const round = getActiveQualifierStyleRound(competition);
  if (!round || !isRoundActiveForCompetitionPhase(competition, round)) {
    throw new Error("No active qualifier-style round is configured for scoring.");
  }

  return round;
}

function requireActiveFinalsRound(competition: Competition) {
  const round = getActiveFinalsRound(competition);
  if (!round) {
    throw new Error("No active finals round is configured for scoring.");
  }

  return round;
}

async function fetchCompetitionRows(includeArchived = false, readClient: SupabaseReadClient = publicSupabase) {
  let query = readClient.from("competitions").select("*").order("start_date", { ascending: false }).order("name");

  if (!includeArchived) {
    query = query.eq("status", "active");
  }

  const { data, error } = await query;
  if (error) {
    return [] as any[];
  }

  return data ?? [];
}

  const { data, error } = await readClient.from("competitions").select("*").eq("slug", slug).maybeSingle();
  if (error) {
    return null;
  }

  return data;
}

  const { data, error } = await readClient.from("competitions").select("*").eq("id", id).maybeSingle();
  if (error) {
    return null;
  }

  return data;
}

function hydrateCompetitions(
  rows: any[],
  categories: CompetitionCategory[],
  scheduleBlocks: CompetitionScheduleBlock[],
  rounds: CompetitionRound[]
) {
  return rows.map((row) => {
    const competitionId = row.id;
    return normalizeCompetition(
      row,
      categories.filter((category) => category.competition_id === competitionId),
      scheduleBlocks.filter((block) => block.competition_id === competitionId),
      rounds.filter((round) => round.competition_id === competitionId)
    );
  });
}
