    const missingPreset = getDemoSetupValidation(buildCompetition(), { saved: true });
    const customPreset = getDemoSetupValidation(buildCompetition(), { selectedPresetId: "custom", saved: true });

    expect(missingPreset.steps.find((step) => step.id === "presets")).toMatchObject({
      complete: false,
      blockingMessage: "Choose a preset or Custom setup before continuing.",
    });
    expect(customPreset.steps.find((step) => step.id === "presets")).toMatchObject({ complete: true });
  });

  it("requires at least one selected category", () => {
    const validation = getDemoSetupValidation(
      buildCompetition({ qualifier_eligible_age_groups: [], finals_eligible_age_groups: [] }),
      { selectedPresetId: "custom", saved: true }
    );

    expect(validation.firstBlockingMessage).toBe("You must add at least one category");
  });

  it("requires a finals scoring round", () => {
    const competition = buildCompetition({
      rounds: buildCompetition().rounds?.filter((round) => round.scoring_bucket !== "finals"),
    });
    const validation = getDemoSetupValidation(competition, { selectedPresetId: "custom", saved: true });

    expect(validation.steps.find((step) => step.id === "stages")).toMatchObject({
      complete: false,
      blockingMessage: "Add a Finals stage.",
    });
  });

  it("requires a finals schedule block linked to the finals round", () => {
    const competition = buildCompetition({
      schedule_blocks: buildCompetition().schedule_blocks.filter((block) => block.phase_type !== "finals_round"),
    });
    const validation = getDemoSetupValidation(competition, { selectedPresetId: "custom", saved: true });

    expect(validation.steps.find((step) => step.id === "schedule")).toMatchObject({
      complete: false,
      blockingMessage: "Add a Finals schedule block linked to the Finals stage.",
    });
  });

  it("requires finals to advance from a semifinal when a semifinal exists", () => {
    const base = buildCompetition();
    const semifinal = {
      ...(base.rounds?.[0] ?? base.rounds![0]),
      id: "round-semi",
      round_number: 2,
      sort_order: 2,
      name: "Semifinal",
      round_type: "semifinal" as const,
      problem_count: 4,
      counting_climbs: 4,
    };
    const finals = {
      ...(base.rounds?.[1] ?? base.rounds![1]),
      round_number: 3,
      sort_order: 3,
      advancement_source_round_id: "round-qualifier",
    };
    const competition = buildCompetition({
      rounds: [base.rounds![0], semifinal, finals],
      schedule_blocks: [
        base.schedule_blocks[0],
        {
          ...base.schedule_blocks[0],
          id: "schedule-semi",
          round_id: "round-semi",
          sort_order: 2,
          label: "Semifinal",
        },
        { ...base.schedule_blocks[1], sort_order: 3 },
      ],
    });

    const validation = getDemoSetupValidation(competition, { selectedPresetId: "custom", saved: true });

    expect(validation.steps.find((step) => step.id === "stages")).toMatchObject({
      complete: false,
      blockingMessage: "Link Finals advancement to the semifinal stage.",
    });
  });

  it("passes setup with qualifier, semifinal, finals, and linked schedule blocks", () => {
    const base = buildCompetition();
    const semifinal = {
      ...base.rounds![0],
      id: "round-semi",
      round_number: 2,
      sort_order: 2,
      name: "Semifinal",
      round_type: "semifinal" as const,
      problem_count: 4,
      counting_climbs: 4,
    };
    const finals = {
      ...base.rounds![1],
      round_number: 3,
      sort_order: 3,
      advancement_source_round_id: "round-semi",
    };
    const competition = buildCompetition({
      rounds: [base.rounds![0], semifinal, finals],
      schedule_blocks: [
        base.schedule_blocks[0],
        {
          ...base.schedule_blocks[0],
          id: "schedule-semi",
          round_id: "round-semi",
          sort_order: 2,
          label: "Semifinal",
        },
        { ...base.schedule_blocks[1], sort_order: 3 },
      ],
    });
    const validation = getDemoSetupValidation(competition, { selectedPresetId: "custom", saved: true });

    expect(getDemoAdvancementSourceRound(competition)?.id).toBe("round-semi");
    expect(validation.canContinueToJudge).toBe(true);
  });

  it("blocks judge continuation until the saved draft matches persisted event", () => {
    const validation = getDemoSetupValidation(buildCompetition(), {
      selectedPresetId: "custom",
      saved: false,
    });

    expect(validation.steps.find((step) => step.id === "review")).toMatchObject({
      complete: false,
      blockingMessage: "Save the competition before opening the judge panel.",
    });
    expect(validation.canContinueToJudge).toBe(false);
  });

  it("passes when every forced setup step is complete and saved", () => {
    const validation = getDemoSetupValidation(buildCompetition(), {
      selectedPresetId: "custom",
      saved: true,
    });

    expect(validation.firstIncompleteStep).toBeNull();
    expect(validation.canContinueToJudge).toBe(true);
  });
});


--- src\lib\demo-setup-validation.ts ---

import {
  competitionHasFinals,
  type Competition,
  type CompetitionCategory,
  type CompetitionRound,
  type CompetitionScheduleBlock,
} from "@/lib/scoring";

export const DEMO_SETUP_STEPS = [
  { id: "basics", label: "Basics" },
  { id: "presets", label: "Preset" },
  { id: "categories", label: "Categories" },
  { id: "schedule", label: "Schedule" },
  { id: "stages", label: "Stages" },
  { id: "review", label: "Review" },
] as const;

export type DemoSetupStepId = (typeof DEMO_SETUP_STEPS)[number]["id"];

export type DemoSetupStepStatus = {
  id: DemoSetupStepId;
  label: string;
  complete: boolean;
  blockingMessage: string | null;
};

export type DemoSetupValidation = {
  steps: DemoSetupStepStatus[];
  firstIncompleteStep: DemoSetupStepId | null;
  firstBlockingMessage: string | null;
  canContinueToJudge: boolean;
};

type DemoSetupValidationOptions = {
  selectedPresetId?: string | null;
  requirePreset?: boolean;
  saved?: boolean;
  requireSaved?: boolean;
};

type DemoSetupCompetition = Partial<
  Pick<
    Competition,
    | "name"
    | "slug"
    | "format"
    | "location_name"
    | "start_date"
    | "end_date"
    | "has_finals"
    | "finals_cutoff"
    | "qualifier_counting_climbs"
    | "qualifier_eligible_age_groups"
    | "finals_eligible_age_groups"
  >
> & {
  categories?: Array<Pick<CompetitionCategory, "id" | "age_group">>;
  schedule_blocks?: Array<Partial<CompetitionScheduleBlock> & Pick<CompetitionScheduleBlock, "id">>;
  rounds?: Array<Partial<CompetitionRound> & Pick<CompetitionRound, "id">>;
};

function asStringArray(value: unknown) {
  return Array.isArray(value) ? value.filter((entry): entry is string => typeof entry === "string") : [];
}

function hasText(value: string | null | undefined) {
  return Boolean(value?.trim());
}

function getScoringRounds(competition: DemoSetupCompetition | null | undefined) {
  return (competition?.rounds ?? [])
    .filter((round) => round.scoring_bucket !== "none" && round.is_enabled !== false)
    .sort((left, right) => {
      const sortDiff = (left.sort_order ?? 0) - (right.sort_order ?? 0);
      if (sortDiff !== 0) {
        return sortDiff;
      }
      return (left.round_number ?? 0) - (right.round_number ?? 0);
    });
}

export function getDemoQualifierStyleRounds(competition: DemoSetupCompetition | null | undefined) {
  return getScoringRounds(competition).filter(
    (round) =>
      round.scoring_bucket === "qualifier" ||
      round.round_type === "qualifier" ||
      round.round_type === "semifinal"
  );
}

export function getDemoQualifierRound(competition: DemoSetupCompetition | null | undefined) {
  return getDemoQualifierStyleRounds(competition)[0] ?? null;
}

export function getDemoFinalsRound(competition: DemoSetupCompetition | null | undefined) {
  return (
    getScoringRounds(competition).find(
      (round) => round.scoring_bucket === "finals" || round.round_type === "finals"
    ) ?? null
  );
}

export function getDemoAdvancementSourceRound(competition: DemoSetupCompetition | null | undefined) {
  const qualifierStyleRounds = getDemoQualifierStyleRounds(competition);
  const finalsRound = getDemoFinalsRound(competition);
  if (!qualifierStyleRounds.length || !finalsRound) {
    return null;
  }

  const linkedSource =
    qualifierStyleRounds.find((round) => round.id === finalsRound.advancement_source_round_id) ?? null;
  return linkedSource ?? qualifierStyleRounds[qualifierStyleRounds.length - 1] ?? null;
}

export function getDemoSelectedQualifierCategories(competition: DemoSetupCompetition | null | undefined) {
  const selectedAgeGroups = new Set(asStringArray(competition?.qualifier_eligible_age_groups));
  return (competition?.categories ?? []).filter((category) => selectedAgeGroups.has(category.age_group));
}

export function getDemoFinalsEligibleCategories(competition: DemoSetupCompetition | null | undefined) {
  const finalsAgeGroups = new Set(asStringArray(competition?.finals_eligible_age_groups));
  return getDemoSelectedQualifierCategories(competition).filter((category) => finalsAgeGroups.has(category.age_group));
}

export function getDemoScheduleBlockForRound(
  competition: DemoSetupCompetition | null | undefined,
  round: { id: string; round_type?: CompetitionRound["round_type"] | null } | null | undefined
) {
  if (!round?.id) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    (competition?.schedule_blocks ?? []).find(
      (block) => block.phase_type === "qualifier_round" && block.round_id === round.id
    ) ?? null
  );
}

export function getDemoQualifierScheduleBlock(competition: DemoSetupCompetition | null | undefined) {
  return getDemoScheduleBlockForRound(competition, getDemoQualifierRound(competition));
}

export function getDemoFinalsScheduleBlock(competition: DemoSetupCompetition | null | undefined) {
  const finalsRound = getDemoFinalsRound(competition);
  if (!finalsRound?.id) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    (competition?.schedule_blocks ?? []).find(
      (block) => block.phase_type === "finals_round" && block.round_id === finalsRound.id
    ) ?? null
  );
}

function demoFinalsEnabled(competition: DemoSetupCompetition | null | undefined) {
  if (!competition?.format) {
    return competition?.has_finals === true;
  }

  return competitionHasFinals({
    format: competition.format as Competition["format"],
    has_finals: competition.has_finals === true,
  });
}

function getCategoriesBlockingMessage(competition: DemoSetupCompetition | null | undefined) {
  const selectedCategories = getDemoSelectedQualifierCategories(competition);
  if (!selectedCategories.length) {
    return "You must add at least one category";
  }

  if (!demoFinalsEnabled(competition)) {
    return "This demo includes finals. Add a Finals stage before continuing.";
  }

  const finalsAgeGroups = asStringArray(competition?.finals_eligible_age_groups);
  const qualifierAgeGroups = new Set(asStringArray(competition?.qualifier_eligible_age_groups));
  const finalsEligibleCategories = getDemoFinalsEligibleCategories(competition);
  if (!finalsAgeGroups.length || !finalsEligibleCategories.length) {
    return "Choose at least one finals-eligible category.";
  }

  if (!finalsAgeGroups.every((ageGroup) => qualifierAgeGroups.has(ageGroup))) {
    return "Finals-eligible categories must also be selected qualifier categories.";
  }

  return null;
}

function getStagesBlockingMessage(competition: DemoSetupCompetition | null | undefined) {
  if (!demoFinalsEnabled(competition)) {
    return "This demo includes finals. Add a Finals stage before continuing.";
  }

  const qualifierRound = getDemoQualifierRound(competition);
  const qualifierStyleRounds = getDemoQualifierStyleRounds(competition);
  const finalsRound = getDemoFinalsRound(competition);
  if (!qualifierRound) {
    return "Add a qualifier scoring stage.";
  }
  if (!finalsRound) {
    return "Add a Finals stage.";
  }

  const qualifierProblemCount = Number(qualifierRound.problem_count ?? 0);
  const qualifierCountingClimbs = Number(qualifierRound.counting_climbs ?? competition?.qualifier_counting_climbs ?? 0);
  if (!Number.isFinite(qualifierProblemCount) || qualifierProblemCount <= 0) {
    return "Set a valid qualifier problem count.";
  }
  if (
    !Number.isFinite(qualifierCountingClimbs) ||
    qualifierCountingClimbs <= 0 ||
    qualifierCountingClimbs > qualifierProblemCount
  ) {
    return "Set qualifier counted climbs between 1 and the qualifier problem count.";
  }

  const semifinalRounds = qualifierStyleRounds.filter((round) => round.round_type === "semifinal");
  const invalidSemifinal = semifinalRounds.find((round) => {
    const problemCount = Number(round.problem_count ?? 0);
    const countingClimbs = Number(round.counting_climbs ?? 0);
    return (
      !Number.isFinite(problemCount) ||
      problemCount <= 0 ||
      !Number.isFinite(countingClimbs) ||
      countingClimbs <= 0 ||
      countingClimbs > problemCount
    );
  });
  if (invalidSemifinal) {
    return "Set valid semifinal problem counts and counted climbs.";
  }

  const finalsProblemCount = Number(finalsRound.problem_count ?? 0);
  if (!Number.isFinite(finalsProblemCount) || finalsProblemCount <= 0) {
    return "Set a valid Finals problem count.";
  }

  const expectedAdvancementSource = qualifierStyleRounds[qualifierStyleRounds.length - 1] ?? qualifierRound;
  const linkedSource = qualifierStyleRounds.find((round) => round.id === finalsRound.advancement_source_round_id);
  if (!finalsRound.advancement_source_round_id || !linkedSource) {
    return "Link Finals advancement to the qualifier or semifinal stage.";
  }
  if (linkedSource.id !== expectedAdvancementSource.id) {
    return expectedAdvancementSource.round_type === "semifinal"
      ? "Link Finals advancement to the semifinal stage."
      : "Link Finals advancement to the qualifier stage.";
  }

  const advancementCutoff = Number(finalsRound.advancement_cutoff ?? finalsRound.finals_cutoff ?? competition?.finals_cutoff ?? 0);
  if (!Number.isFinite(advancementCutoff) || advancementCutoff <= 0) {
    return "Choose how many athletes advance to Finals.";
  }

  return null;
}

function getScheduleBlockingMessage(competition: DemoSetupCompetition | null | undefined) {
  const stagesMessage = getStagesBlockingMessage(competition);
  if (stagesMessage) {
    return stagesMessage;
  }

  if (!getDemoQualifierScheduleBlock(competition)) {
    return "Add a qualifier schedule block linked to the qualifier stage.";
  }
  const semifinalWithoutSchedule = getDemoQualifierStyleRounds(competition).find(
    (round) => round.round_type === "semifinal" && !getDemoScheduleBlockForRound(competition, round)
  );
  if (semifinalWithoutSchedule) {
    return "Add a semifinal schedule block linked to the Semifinal stage.";
  }
  if (!getDemoFinalsScheduleBlock(competition)) {
    return "Add a Finals schedule block linked to the Finals stage.";
  }

  return null;
}

export function getDemoSetupValidation(
  competition: DemoSetupCompetition | null | undefined,
  options: DemoSetupValidationOptions = {}
): DemoSetupValidation {
  const requirePreset = options.requirePreset ?? true;
  const requireSaved = options.requireSaved ?? true;
  const basicsMessage =
    competition &&
    hasText(competition.name) &&
    hasText(competition.slug) &&
    hasText(competition.location_name) &&
    hasText(competition.start_date) &&
    hasText(competition.end_date)
      ? null
      : "Complete event name, link, location, start date, and end date.";
  const presetMessage =
    !requirePreset || options.selectedPresetId
      ? null
      : "Choose a preset or Custom setup before continuing.";
  const categoriesMessage = getCategoriesBlockingMessage(competition);
  const scheduleMessage = getScheduleBlockingMessage(competition);
  const stagesMessage = getStagesBlockingMessage(competition);
  const reviewMessage =
    !requireSaved || options.saved === true
      ? null
      : "Save the competition before opening the judge panel.";

  const byId: Record<DemoSetupStepId, string | null> = {
    basics: basicsMessage,
    presets: presetMessage,
    categories: categoriesMessage,
    schedule: scheduleMessage,
    stages: stagesMessage,
    review: reviewMessage,
  };
  const steps = DEMO_SETUP_STEPS.map((step) => ({
    ...step,
    complete: byId[step.id] === null,
    blockingMessage: byId[step.id],
  }));
  const firstIncomplete = steps.find((step) => !step.complete) ?? null;

  return {
    steps,
    firstIncompleteStep: firstIncomplete?.id ?? null,
    firstBlockingMessage: firstIncomplete?.blockingMessage ?? null,
    canContinueToJudge: steps.every((step) => step.complete),
  };
}


--- src\lib\demo-wizard.test.ts ---

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  DEMO_WIZARD_STEPS,
  formatDemoJudgeScoreLabel,
  getDemoSetupStepCardAnchor,
  getDemoCreateWizardGuidance,
  getDemoJudgeWizardGuidance,
  getDemoOrganizerWizardGuidance,
  getDemoPublicWizardGuidance,
  isDemoWizardStepComplete,
  normalizeDemoWizardProgress,
} from "@/lib/demo-wizard";
import { DEMO_SETUP_STEPS, type DemoSetupValidation } from "@/lib/demo-setup-validation";

function validation(overrides: Partial<DemoSetupValidation> = {}): DemoSetupValidation {
  return {
    steps: [
      { id: "basics", label: "Basics", complete: false, blockingMessage: "Complete basics." },
      { id: "presets", label: "Preset", complete: false, blockingMessage: "Choose a preset." },
      { id: "categories", label: "Categories", complete: false, blockingMessage: "Add categories." },
      { id: "schedule", label: "Schedule", complete: false, blockingMessage: "Add schedule." },
      { id: "stages", label: "Stages", complete: false, blockingMessage: "Add stages." },
      { id: "review", label: "Review", complete: false, blockingMessage: "Save first." },
    ],
    firstIncompleteStep: "basics",
    firstBlockingMessage: "Complete basics.",
    canContinueToJudge: false,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

describe("demo wizard helpers", () => {
  it("normalizes missing progress flags to false", () => {
    expect(normalizeDemoWizardProgress({ eventReady: true })).toEqual({
      eventReady: true,
      dataPopulated: false,
      keyScoreCorrected: false,
      organizerAdvanced: false,
      publicReady: false,
    });
  });

  it("derives step completion from progress keys", () => {
    const progress = normalizeDemoWizardProgress({
      eventReady: true,
      keyScoreCorrected: true,
    });

    expect(isDemoWizardStepComplete(DEMO_WIZARD_STEPS[0], progress)).toBe(true);
    expect(isDemoWizardStepComplete(DEMO_WIZARD_STEPS[1], progress)).toBe(true);
    expect(isDemoWizardStepComplete(DEMO_WIZARD_STEPS[2], progress)).toBe(false);
  });

  it("targets event creation before the shell exists", () => {
    const guidance = getDemoCreateWizardGuidance(validation(), false);

    expect(guidance).toMatchObject({
      title: "Start as the organizer",
      primaryActionLabel: "Start Event Basics",
      primaryTargetAnchor: "organizer-create-name",
    });
  });

  it("targets the first incomplete setup step after creation", () => {
    const guidance = getDemoCreateWizardGuidance(
      validation({
        firstIncompleteStep: "schedule",
        firstBlockingMessage: "Add schedule.",
      }),
      true
    );

    expect(guidance).toMatchObject({
      title: "Finish Schedule",
      blockingMessage: "Add schedule.",
      primaryTargetAnchor: "organizer-schedule",
    });
  });

  it("has a stable step-card highlight target for every Act 1 setup step", () => {
    expect(DEMO_SETUP_STEPS.map((step) => [step.id, getDemoSetupStepCardAnchor(step.id)])).toEqual([
      ["basics", "organizer-step-basics"],
      ["presets", "organizer-step-preset"],
      ["categories", "organizer-step-categories"],
      ["schedule", "organizer-step-schedule"],
      ["stages", "organizer-step-stages"],
      ["review", "organizer-step-review"],
    ]);
  });

  it("targets the judge handoff when setup is complete", () => {
    const completeValidation = validation({
      steps: validation().steps.map((step) => ({ ...step, complete: true, blockingMessage: null })),
      firstIncompleteStep: null,
      firstBlockingMessage: null,
      canContinueToJudge: true,
    });

    expect(getDemoCreateWizardGuidance(completeValidation, true)).toMatchObject({
      title: "Your event is ready.",
      blockingMessage: null,
      primaryTargetAnchor: "organizer-go-judge",
    });
  });

  it("normalizes raw score labels into friendly demo copy", () => {
    expect(formatDemoJudgeScoreLabel("Top in 3 attempts, Zone yes")).toBe("Top on try 3, zone reached");
    expect(formatDemoJudgeScoreLabel("Top in 1 attempt, Zone no")).toBe("Top on try 1, zone not reached");
  });

  it("gives friendly judge correction instructions before continuing", () => {
    const guidance = getDemoJudgeWizardGuidance(false, {
      athleteName: "Avery Chen",
      climberNumber: "103",
      roundName: "Qualifier",
      climbNumber: 3,
      currentScore: "Top in 3 attempts, Zone yes",
      correctedScore: "Top in 1 attempt, Zone yes",
    });

    expect(guidance).toMatchObject({
      primaryActionLabel: "Highlight Athlete",
      primaryTargetAnchor: "judge-entry-cards",
    });
    expect(guidance.instruction).toContain("Avery Chen (#103)");
    expect(guidance.instruction).toContain(
      'open Boulder 3 in Qualifier, and change the demo mistake from "Top on try 3, zone reached" to "Top on try 1, zone reached"'
    );
    expect(guidance.blockingMessage).toBe(
      'Save Boulder 3 for Avery Chen (#103) as "Top on try 1, zone reached" to continue.'
    );
    expect(`${guidance.title} ${guidance.instruction} ${guidance.blockingMessage}`).not.toMatch(
      /Zone yes|then Save|Demo - Judge|Correct Avery Chen/
    );
    expect(getDemoJudgeWizardGuidance(true)).toMatchObject({
      primaryActionLabel: "Go to Organizer Dashboard",
      blockingMessage: null,
    });
  });

  it("guides organizer actions from lock to advance to public", () => {
    expect(getDemoOrganizerWizardGuidance({ qualifierLocked: false, finalistsPersisted: false })).toMatchObject({
      primaryTargetAnchor: "organizer-lock-qualifiers",
    });
    expect(getDemoOrganizerWizardGuidance({ qualifierLocked: true, finalistsPersisted: false })).toMatchObject({
      primaryTargetAnchor: "organizer-advance-finals",
    });
    expect(getDemoOrganizerWizardGuidance({ qualifierLocked: true, finalistsPersisted: true, finalsScoresReady: false })).toMatchObject({
      primaryActionLabel: "Waiting for finals scores",
      blockingMessage: "Finals scores are still being prepared.",
    });
    expect(getDemoOrganizerWizardGuidance({ qualifierLocked: true, finalistsPersisted: true, finalsScoresReady: true })).toMatchObject({
      primaryActionLabel: "View Public Page",
      blockingMessage: null,
    });
  });

  it("uses semifinal organizer copy when finals advance from semifinals", () => {
    expect(
      getDemoOrganizerWizardGuidance({
        qualifierLocked: false,
        hasSemifinal: true,
        finalistsPersisted: false,
        advancementSourceLabel: "semifinal",
      })
    ).toMatchObject({
      instruction: "Lock qualifiers, then open semifinals.",
      blockingMessage: "Lock qualifiers before opening semifinals.",
      primaryTargetAnchor: "organizer-lock-qualifiers",
    });
    expect(
      getDemoOrganizerWizardGuidance({
        qualifierLocked: true,
        hasSemifinal: true,
        semifinalOpened: false,
        finalistsPersisted: false,
        advancementSourceLabel: "semifinal",
      })
    ).toMatchObject({
      instruction: "Open semifinals so judges can score the next round.",
      primaryTargetAnchor: "organizer-open-semifinals",
    });
    expect(
      getDemoOrganizerWizardGuidance({
        qualifierLocked: true,
        hasSemifinal: true,
        semifinalOpened: true,
        semifinalLocked: false,
        finalistsPersisted: false,
        advancementSourceLabel: "semifinal",
      })
    ).toMatchObject({
      instruction: "Lock semifinals, then advance finalists.",
      blockingMessage: "Lock semifinals before advancing finalists.",
      primaryTargetAnchor: "organizer-lock-semifinals",
    });
  });

  it("uses the finish copy once the public page is ready", () => {
    expect(getDemoPublicWizardGuidance(false)).toMatchObject({
      title: "Public view",
      primaryTargetAnchor: "public-leaderboard",
    });
    expect(getDemoPublicWizardGuidance(true)).toMatchObject({
      title: "Demo Complete",
      primaryTargetAnchor: "public-results",
    });
  });
});


--- src\lib\demo-wizard.ts ---

import type { DemoProgress } from "@/lib/demo-scenario";
import type { DemoSetupStepId, DemoSetupValidation } from "@/lib/demo-setup-validation";

export type DemoWizardStep = "create" | "judge" | "organize" | "public" | "finish";

export type DemoWizardProgress = DemoProgress & {
  publicReady: boolean;
};

export type DemoWizardStepDefinition = {
  id: DemoWizardStep;
  label: string;
  progressKey?: keyof DemoWizardProgress;
};

export type DemoWizardGuidance = {
  title: string;
  instruction: string;
  why: string;
  blockingMessage: string | null;
  primaryActionLabel: string;
  primaryTargetAnchor?: string;
};

export type DemoJudgeCorrectionTarget = {
  athleteName?: string | null;
  climberNumber?: string | null;
  roundName?: string | null;
  climbNumber: number;
  currentScore: string;
  correctedScore: string;
};

export const DEMO_WIZARD_STEPS: DemoWizardStepDefinition[] = [
  { id: "create", label: "Create", progressKey: "eventReady" },
  { id: "judge", label: "Judge", progressKey: "keyScoreCorrected" },
  { id: "organize", label: "Organize", progressKey: "organizerAdvanced" },
  { id: "public", label: "Public", progressKey: "publicReady" },
  { id: "finish", label: "Finish", progressKey: "publicReady" },
];

const SETUP_STEP_ANCHORS: Record<DemoSetupStepId, string> = {
  basics: "setup-basics",
  presets: "setup-presets",
  categories: "organizer-categories",
  schedule: "organizer-schedule",
  stages: "organizer-stages",
  review: "organizer-save-event",
};

export const DEMO_SETUP_STEP_CARD_ANCHORS: Record<DemoSetupStepId, string> = {
  basics: "organizer-step-basics",
  presets: "organizer-step-preset",
  categories: "organizer-step-categories",
  schedule: "organizer-step-schedule",
  stages: "organizer-step-stages",
  review: "organizer-step-review",
};

export function getDemoSetupStepCardAnchor(stepId: DemoSetupStepId) {
  return DEMO_SETUP_STEP_CARD_ANCHORS[stepId];
}

const SETUP_STEP_WHY: Record<DemoSetupStepId, string> = {
  basics: "This is the public event identity athletes and spectators will see.",
  presets: "The preset is only a starting point; choosing one or Custom makes the setup intentional.",
  categories: "Categories define the rankings and the finals field.",
  schedule: "Linked schedule blocks tell staff when each scoring round is active.",
  stages: "Qualifier and Finals stages make the judge and organizer handoff possible.",
  review: "Saving makes sure the judge panel opens against the persisted event, not an unsaved draft.",
};

export function normalizeDemoWizardProgress(progress: Partial<DemoWizardProgress> = {}): DemoWizardProgress {
  return {
    eventReady: progress.eventReady ?? false,
    dataPopulated: progress.dataPopulated ?? false,
    keyScoreCorrected: progress.keyScoreCorrected ?? false,
    organizerAdvanced: progress.organizerAdvanced ?? false,
    publicReady: progress.publicReady ?? false,
  };
}

export function isDemoWizardStepComplete(step: DemoWizardStepDefinition, progress: DemoWizardProgress) {
  return step.progressKey ? Boolean(progress[step.progressKey]) : false;
}

export function formatDemoJudgeScoreLabel(label: string) {
  return label
    .replace(/Top in (\d+) attempts?, Zone yes/gi, "Top on try $1, zone reached")
    .replace(/Top in (\d+) attempts?, Zone no/gi, "Top on try $1, zone not reached")
    .replace(/\bZone yes\b/gi, "zone reached")
    .replace(/\bZone no\b/gi, "zone not reached");
}

export function getDemoCreateWizardGuidance(
  validation: DemoSetupValidation,
  eventShellCreated: boolean
): DemoWizardGuidance {
  if (!eventShellCreated) {
    return {
      title: "Start as the organizer",
      instruction: "Create the demo event shell with the real staff event form.",
      why: "The demo starts from the same place a real organizer starts.",
      blockingMessage: "Create the event before the guided setup steps unlock.",
      primaryActionLabel: "Start Event Basics",
      primaryTargetAnchor: "organizer-create-name",
    };
  }

  if (validation.canContinueToJudge) {
    return {
      title: "Your event is ready.",
      instruction: "Next, add the sample field and open the real judge panel.",
      why: "The seed step happens only after your real setup is saved and complete.",
      blockingMessage: null,
      primaryActionLabel: "Continue to Judge Panel",
      primaryTargetAnchor: "organizer-go-judge",
    };
  }

  const stepId = validation.firstIncompleteStep ?? "basics";
  const step = validation.steps.find((status) => status.id === stepId);
  const label = step?.label ?? "Setup";

  return {
    title: `Finish ${label}`,
    instruction: step?.blockingMessage ?? "Complete the current setup step before moving forward.",
    why: SETUP_STEP_WHY[stepId],
    blockingMessage: step?.blockingMessage ?? null,
    primaryActionLabel: `Go to ${label}`,
    primaryTargetAnchor: SETUP_STEP_ANCHORS[stepId],
  };
}

export function getDemoJudgeWizardGuidance(
  corrected: boolean,
  target?: DemoJudgeCorrectionTarget | null
): DemoWizardGuidance {
  const athleteName = target?.athleteName?.trim() || "the highlighted athlete";
  const climberNumber = target?.climberNumber?.trim();
  const athleteLabel = climberNumber ? `${athleteName} (#${climberNumber})` : athleteName;
  const roundName = target?.roundName?.trim() || "Qualifier";
  const climbNumber = target?.climbNumber ?? 3;
  const currentScore = formatDemoJudgeScoreLabel(target?.currentScore ?? "Top on try 3, zone reached");
  const correctedScore = formatDemoJudgeScoreLabel(target?.correctedScore ?? "Top on try 1, zone reached");

  if (corrected) {
    return {
      title: "Nice work. The leaderboard is accurate.",
      instruction: "Next, go back to the organizer dashboard and advance finalists.",
      why: "Score corrections update the real leaderboard that determines the finals field.",
      blockingMessage: null,
      primaryActionLabel: "Go to Organizer Dashboard",
    };
  }

  return {
    title: "One score needs a quick fix",
    instruction: `Find ${athleteLabel}, open Boulder ${climbNumber} in ${roundName}, and change the demo mistake from "${currentScore}" to "${correctedScore}". Save the score when it looks right.`,
    why: "You are using the real score editor. The walkthrough just points you to the athlete and boulder that need attention.",
    blockingMessage: `Save Boulder ${climbNumber} for ${athleteLabel} as "${correctedScore}" to continue.`,
    primaryActionLabel: "Highlight Athlete",
    primaryTargetAnchor: "judge-entry-cards",
  };
}

export function getDemoOrganizerWizardGuidance({
  qualifierLocked,
  hasSemifinal = false,
  semifinalOpened = false,
  semifinalLocked = false,
  finalistsPersisted,
  finalsScoresReady = finalistsPersisted,
  advancementSourceLabel = "qualifier",
}: {
  qualifierLocked: boolean;
  hasSemifinal?: boolean;
  semifinalOpened?: boolean;
  semifinalLocked?: boolean;
  finalistsPersisted: boolean;
  finalsScoresReady?: boolean;
  advancementSourceLabel?: string;
}): DemoWizardGuidance {
  const sourceLabel = advancementSourceLabel.toLowerCase() === "semifinal" ? "semifinal" : "qualifier";
  if (finalistsPersisted && finalsScoresReady) {
    return {
      title: "Finalists are set.",
      instruction: "Next, view the public event page after the demo finals scores are ready.",
      why: "The public event page now reflects the real finalist field and finals attempts.",
      blockingMessage: null,
      primaryActionLabel: "View Public Page",
    };
  }

  if (finalistsPersisted) {
    return {
      title: "Finalists are set.",
      instruction: "Finals scores are being prepared before the public page unlocks.",
      why: "Public results should not be marked complete until finalists have real finals attempts.",
      blockingMessage: "Finals scores are still being prepared.",
      primaryActionLabel: "Waiting for finals scores",
      primaryTargetAnchor: "organizer-advance-finals",
    };
  }

  if (!qualifierLocked) {
    return {
      title: hasSemifinal ? "Prepare semifinals" : "Set the finals field",
      instruction: hasSemifinal
        ? "Lock qualifiers, then open semifinals."
        : "Lock qualifiers so the finals field is based on stable scores.",
      why: hasSemifinal
        ? "Semifinals should only open after qualifier scoring is frozen."
        : "Finalists should only be advanced after qualifier scoring is frozen.",
      blockingMessage: hasSemifinal
        ? "Lock qualifiers before opening semifinals."
        : "Lock qualifiers before advancing finalists.",
      primaryActionLabel: "Show lock button",
      primaryTargetAnchor: "organizer-lock-qualifiers",
    };
  }

  if (hasSemifinal && !semifinalOpened) {
    return {
      title: "Open semifinals",
      instruction: "Open semifinals so judges can score the next round.",
      why: "The semifinal round uses the same real judge workflow as qualifiers, but with its own active round.",
      blockingMessage: "Open semifinals before reviewing semifinal standings.",
      primaryActionLabel: "Show semifinals button",
      primaryTargetAnchor: "organizer-open-semifinals",
    };
  }

  if (hasSemifinal && !semifinalLocked) {
    return {
      title: "Set the finals field",
      instruction: "Lock semifinals, then advance finalists.",
      why: "The finals field should come from frozen semifinal standings.",
      blockingMessage: "Lock semifinals before advancing finalists.",
      primaryActionLabel: "Show semifinal lock",
      primaryTargetAnchor: "organizer-lock-semifinals",
    };
  }

  return {
    title: "Advance finalists",
    instruction: "Advance the finalist field and start finals.",
    why: `This creates the real finals field from the ${sourceLabel} rankings.`,
    blockingMessage: "Advance finalists before opening the public event.",
    primaryActionLabel: "Show advance button",
    primaryTargetAnchor: "organizer-advance-finals",
  };
}

export function getDemoPublicWizardGuidance(publicReady: boolean): DemoWizardGuidance {
  if (publicReady) {
    return {
      title: "Demo Complete",
      instruction: "You've run a full climbing competition.",
      why: "The event, judge scores, finalist field, finals attempts, and public page all came from the real app workflow.",
      blockingMessage: null,
      primaryActionLabel: "Review Public Results",
      primaryTargetAnchor: "public-results",
    };
  }

  return {
    title: "Public view",
    instruction: "This is what climbers and spectators see.",
    why: "Public standings, finalists, and finals results update from the live competition data.",
    blockingMessage: null,
    primaryActionLabel: "Review Leaderboard",
    primaryTargetAnchor: "public-leaderboard",
  };
}


--- src\lib\export.ts ---

import type { CompetitionSnapshot } from "./db";

function escapeCsv(value: string | number | null | undefined) {
  const text = value == null ? "" : String(value);
  if (text.includes(",") || text.includes('"') || text.includes("\n")) {
    return `"${text.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
  }
  return text;
}

export function buildQualifierCsv(snapshot: CompetitionSnapshot) {
  const rows = [
    ["Rank", "Name", "Number", "Province", "Category", "Score", "Tops", "Zones", "Attempts"],
    ...snapshot.qualifierLeaderboard.map((entry) => [
      entry.overall_rank,
      entry.name,
      entry.climber_number,
      entry.province,
      entry.display_category,
      entry.total_score,
      entry.topped_count,
      entry.zone_count,
      entry.counting_attempt_total,
    ]),
  ];

  return rows.map((row) => row.map(escapeCsv).join(",")).join("\n");
}

export function buildFinalsCsv(snapshot: CompetitionSnapshot) {
  const problemHeaders = Array.from({ length: snapshot.competition.finals_problem_count }, (_, index) => `B${index + 1}`);
  const rows = [
    ["Rank", "Name", "Number", "Province", "Category", ...problemHeaders, "Points", "Tops", "Zones", "Attempts To Top", "Attempts To Zone"],
    ...snapshot.finalsLeaderboard.map((entry) => [
      entry.overall_rank,
      entry.name,
      entry.climber_number,
      entry.province,
      entry.display_category,
      ...entry.problem_results.map((problem) => (problem.top ? `T${problem.attempts_to_top ?? 1}` : problem.zone ? `Z${problem.attempts_to_zone ?? 1}` : "")),
      entry.total_points,
      entry.tops,
      entry.zones,
      entry.attempts_to_top,
      entry.attempts_to_zone,
    ]),
  ];

  return rows.map((row) => row.map(escapeCsv).join(",")).join("\n");
}

export function downloadCsv(filename: string, csv: string) {
  const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8" });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const anchor = document.createElement("a");
  anchor.href = url;
  anchor.download = filename;
  anchor.click();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}


--- src\lib\guided-setup-preset-ux.test.ts ---

import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { getGuidedDemoPreset } from "@/lib/competition-presets";
import { getFormatTemplate } from "@/lib/scoring";

const rootDir = process.cwd();
const creationFormSource = readFileSync(
  join(rootDir, "src", "components", "staff-event-creation-form.tsx"),
  "utf8"
);
const staffDashboardSource = readFileSync(
  join(rootDir, "src", "components", "staff-dashboard.tsx"),
  "utf8"
);

describe("guided setup preset-first UX", () => {
  it("hides the creation-shell format dropdown in guided demo setup", () => {
    expect(creationFormSource).toContain("hideFormat?: boolean");
    expect(creationFormSource).toContain('{!hideFormat ? (');
    expect(staffDashboardSource).toContain("hideFormat={demoSeedOnCreate}");
  });

  it("defaults the guided demo creation shell to the guided preset scoring rules", () => {
    const guidedPreset = getGuidedDemoPreset();

    expect(guidedPreset.format).toBe("five_on_five_off");
    expect(getFormatTemplate(guidedPreset.format).label).toBe("Five on five off");
    expect(staffDashboardSource).toContain("demoSeedOnCreate ? GUIDED_DEMO_INITIAL_PRESET.format");
  });

  it("renders preset-selected scoring rules as read-only summary copy", () => {
    expect(staffDashboardSource).toContain("Scoring rules");
    expect(staffDashboardSource).toContain('selectedGuidedSetupPreset.id !== "custom"');
    expect(staffDashboardSource).toContain(
      "The preset controls this so scoring, schedule, and stages stay aligned."
    );
  });

  it("unlocks an editable scoring-rules dropdown only for Custom setup", () => {
    expect(staffDashboardSource).toContain('selectedGuidedSetupPreset.id === "custom"');
    expect(staffDashboardSource).toContain("custom-event-scoring-rules");
    expect(staffDashboardSource).toContain('aria-label="Scoring rules"');
  });
});

--- src\lib\mock-athlete-seeds.test.ts ---

import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

import {
  MOCK_ATHLETE_CURATED_FULL_NAMES,
  MOCK_ATHLETE_FIRST_NAMES,
  MOCK_ATHLETE_FULL_NAME_POOL,
  MOCK_ATHLETE_LAST_NAMES,
} from "./mock-athlete-name-pool";

const repoRoot = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..", "..");

describe("mock athlete name pool", () => {
  it("ships a large deterministic pool with low repetition risk", () => {
    expect(MOCK_ATHLETE_CURATED_FULL_NAMES.length).toBeGreaterThan(200);
    expect(MOCK_ATHLETE_FIRST_NAMES.length).toBeGreaterThan(200);
    expect(MOCK_ATHLETE_LAST_NAMES.length).toBeGreaterThan(200);
    expect(MOCK_ATHLETE_FULL_NAME_POOL.length).toBeGreaterThan(800);

    const normalized = new Set(MOCK_ATHLETE_FULL_NAME_POOL.map((name) => name.toLowerCase()));
    expect(normalized.size).toBe(MOCK_ATHLETE_FULL_NAME_POOL.length);
    expect(MOCK_ATHLETE_FULL_NAME_POOL.some((name) => name.includes("'"))).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe("mock seed sql", () => {
  it("uses the expanded name pool instead of the old tiny inline rotations", () => {
    const mockEventsSql = readFileSync(path.join(repoRoot, "sql", "mock-events-seed.sql"), "utf8");
    const springSendRegistrationSql = readFileSync(
      path.join(repoRoot, "sql", "spring-send", "02-seed-registrations.sql"),
      "utf8"
    );

    expect(mockEventsSql).not.toContain("'Avery','Jordan','Parker'");
    expect(mockEventsSql).toContain(`% ${MOCK_ATHLETE_FULL_NAME_POOL.length})] as name`);

    expect(springSendRegistrationSql).not.toContain("case ((series.n * 17) % 24)");
    expect(springSendRegistrationSql).toContain(`% ${MOCK_ATHLETE_FULL_NAME_POOL.length})] as athlete_name`);
  });

  it("keeps the richer multi-factor scoring model in both mock pipelines", () => {
    const mockEventsSql = readFileSync(path.join(repoRoot, "sql", "mock-events-seed.sql"), "utf8");
    const springSendAttemptsSql = readFileSync(
      path.join(repoRoot, "sql", "spring-send", "03-seed-qualifier-attempts.sql"),
      "utf8"
    );

    expect(mockEventsSql).toContain("athlete_profiles as");
    expect(mockEventsSql).toContain("base_strength");
    expect(mockEventsSql).toContain("consistency_band");
    expect(mockEventsSql).toContain("performance_rating");
    expect(mockEventsSql).toContain("finalist_profiles as");

    expect(springSendAttemptsSql).toContain("base_strength");
    expect(springSendAttemptsSql).toContain("consistency_band");
    expect(springSendAttemptsSql).toContain("performance_score");
    expect(springSendAttemptsSql).not.toContain("strength_band");
  });
});
