--- src\lib\official-events.ts ---

export interface OfficialEvent {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  series: string;
  location: string;
  disciplines: string;
  start_date: string;
  end_date: string;
  description: string;
  source_name: string;
  source_url: string;
  official_event_url: string;
  official_registration_url: string;
  official_schedule_url: string;
  registration_opens_at: string | null;
  registration_closes_at: string | null;
  hero_image_url: string;
}

const WORLD_CLIMBING_SOURCE_URL = "https://www.worldclimbing.com/calendar/index";
const USA_CLIMBING_NACS_URL = "https://usaclimbing.org/compete/north-american-cup-series/";

function decodeHtmlEntities(value: string) {
  return value
    .replace(/&#(\d+);/g, (_, code) => String.fromCodePoint(Number(code)))
    .replace(/&#x([0-9a-f]+);/gi, (_, code) => String.fromCodePoint(parseInt(code, 16)))
    .replace(/&nbsp;/g, " ")
    .replace(/&amp;/g, "&")
    .replace(/&quot;/g, '"')
    .replace(/&apos;/g, "'")
    .replace(/&#8211;|&#x2013;|&ndash;/gi, "\u2013")
    .replace(/&#8212;|&#x2014;|&mdash;/gi, "\u2014")
    .replace(/&lt;/g, "<")
    .replace(/&gt;/g, ">");
}

function repairMojibake(value: string) {
  if (!/Ã|Â|â/.test(value)) {
    return value;
  }

  try {
    return Buffer.from(value, "latin1").toString("utf8");
  } catch {
    return value;
  }
}

function stripTags(value: string) {
  return decodeHtmlEntities(value.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, " "));
}

function normalizeWhitespace(value: string) {
  return repairMojibake(value).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
}

function slugify(value: string) {
  return value
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "");
}

function monthNumber(month: string) {
  const months = [
    "january",
    "february",
    "march",
    "april",
    "may",
    "june",
    "july",
    "august",
    "september",
    "october",
    "november",
    "december",
  ];

  return months.indexOf(month.toLowerCase()) + 1;
}

function formatIsoDate(year: number, month: number, day: number) {
  return `${year.toString().padStart(4, "0")}-${month.toString().padStart(2, "0")}-${day
    .toString()
    .padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

function parseNamedDateRange(range: string) {
  const normalized = normalizeWhitespace(range.replace(/[\u2013\u2014-]/g, "\u2013"));
  const match = normalized.match(/^([A-Za-z]+) (\d{1,2})\u2013(\d{1,2}), (\d{4})$/);
  if (!match) {
    return null;
  }

  const [, monthRaw, startDayRaw, endDayRaw, yearRaw] = match;
  const month = monthNumber(monthRaw);
  if (!month) {
    return null;
  }

  const year = Number(yearRaw);
  return {
    start_date: formatIsoDate(year, month, Number(startDayRaw)),
    end_date: formatIsoDate(year, month, Number(endDayRaw)),
  };
}

function absolutizeUrl(baseUrl: string, href: string) {
  if (!href) {
    return "";
  }

  try {
    return new URL(decodeHtmlEntities(href), baseUrl).toString();
  } catch {
    return decodeHtmlEntities(href);
  }
}

async function fetchSourceHtml(url: string) {
  const response = await fetch(url, {
    headers: {
      "user-agent": "ScorecardOfficialEvents/1.0",
    },
    next: { revalidate: 21600 },
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Unable to load official events from ${url}.`);
  }

  return response.text();
}

function extractWorldClimbingSeasonYear(html: string) {
  const seasonMatch = html.match(/Season (\d{4})/i);
  if (seasonMatch) {
    return Number(seasonMatch[1]);
  }

  const datedMonthMatch = html.match(
    /<span class="d3-ty-caption[^"]*">([A-Za-z]+)\s+(\d{4})<\/span>/i
  );
  if (datedMonthMatch) {
    return Number(datedMonthMatch[2]);
  }

  return new Date().getFullYear();
}

function parseCalendarCardDateRange(dayLabel: string, monthLabel: string, fallbackYear: number) {
  const normalizedDay = normalizeWhitespace(dayLabel);
  const normalizedMonth = normalizeWhitespace(monthLabel);
  const monthMatch = normalizedMonth.match(/^([A-Za-z]+)(?:\s+(\d{4}))?$/);
  const dayMatch = normalizedDay.match(/^(\d{1,2})(?:-(\d{1,2}))?$/);
  if (!monthMatch || !dayMatch) {
    return null;
  }

  const [, monthRaw, yearRaw] = monthMatch;
  const [, startDayRaw, endDayRaw] = dayMatch;
  const month = monthNumber(monthRaw);
  if (!month) {
    return null;
  }

  const year = yearRaw ? Number(yearRaw) : fallbackYear;
  const startDay = Number(startDayRaw);
  const endDay = endDayRaw ? Number(endDayRaw) : startDay;

  return {
    start_date: formatIsoDate(year, month, startDay),
    end_date: formatIsoDate(year, month, endDay),
  };
}

export function parseWorldClimbingEvents(html: string): OfficialEvent[] {
  const fallbackYear = extractWorldClimbingSeasonYear(html);
  const cards = html.split('<div class="card__event-horizontal">').slice(1);

  const events: OfficialEvent[] = [];
  cards.forEach((card) => {
    const titleMatch = card.match(
      /<a aria-label="([^"]+)" href="([^"]+)">\s*<h4[^>]*>([^<]+)<\/h4>\s*<\/a>/i
    );
    const dateMatch = card.match(
      /<span class="d3-ty-caption-large[^>]*">([^<]+)<\/span>\s*<span class="d3-ty-caption[^>]*">([^<]+)<\/span>/i
    );
    const disciplineMatch = card.match(/<div class="uppercase[^>]*">([^<]+)<\/div>/i);
    const locationMatch = card.match(/<span class="d3-ty-body-small[^>]*">[\s\S]*?<\/svg>([^<]+)<\/span>/i);
    if (!titleMatch || !dateMatch || !disciplineMatch || !locationMatch) {
      return;
    }

    const [, , href, rawTitle] = titleMatch;
    const [, rawDayLabel, rawMonthLabel] = dateMatch;
    const [, rawDisciplines] = disciplineMatch;
    const [, rawLocation] = locationMatch;

    const title = normalizeWhitespace(stripTags(rawTitle));
    const disciplines = normalizeWhitespace(stripTags(rawDisciplines));
    const location = normalizeWhitespace(stripTags(rawLocation));
    if (!/^World Climbing Series\b/i.test(title) || !disciplines.toLowerCase().includes("boulder")) {
      return;
    }

    const parsedRange = parseCalendarCardDateRange(rawDayLabel, rawMonthLabel, fallbackYear);
    if (!parsedRange) {
      return;
    }

    const infoSheetUrl = absolutizeUrl(
      WORLD_CLIMBING_SOURCE_URL,
      card.match(/<a title="Info sheet"[^>]*href="([^"]+)"/i)?.[1] ?? ""
    );
    const registrationUrl = absolutizeUrl(
      WORLD_CLIMBING_SOURCE_URL,
      card.match(/<a title="Registrations"[^>]*href="([^"]+)"/i)?.[1] ?? ""
    );
    const officialEventUrl = absolutizeUrl(WORLD_CLIMBING_SOURCE_URL, href);

    events.push({
      id: `world-climbing-${slugify(location)}-${parsedRange.start_date}`,
      title,
      series: "World Climbing",
      location,
      disciplines,
      description: `${title} in ${location} featuring ${disciplines.toLowerCase()}, as listed on the live World Climbing calendar.`,
      source_name: "World Climbing live calendar",
      source_url: WORLD_CLIMBING_SOURCE_URL,
      official_event_url: officialEventUrl,
      official_registration_url: registrationUrl,
      official_schedule_url: infoSheetUrl || officialEventUrl,
      registration_opens_at: null,
      registration_closes_at: null,
      hero_image_url: "",
      ...parsedRange,
    });
  });

  return events;
}

function extractAnchorHrefs(segment: string) {
  const anchors = new Map<string, string>();
  const anchorPattern =
    /<a[^>]*class="[^"]*icon-tile[^"]*"[^>]*href="([^"]+)"[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<h4[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/h4>/gi;
  let match: RegExpExecArray | null;

  while ((match = anchorPattern.exec(segment)) !== null) {
    const [, href, labelHtml] = match;
    const label = normalizeWhitespace(stripTags(labelHtml));
    if (!label) {
      continue;
    }

    anchors.set(label, absolutizeUrl(USA_CLIMBING_NACS_URL, href));
  }

  return anchors;
}

function extractUsaClimbingHeroImage(segment: string) {
  const heroMatch =
    segment.match(/data-src="([^"]+\.(?:jpg|jpeg|png|webp))"/i) ??
    segment.match(/src="([^"]+\.(?:jpg|jpeg|png|webp))"/i);
  return heroMatch?.[1] ?? "";
}

function findUsaClimbingLocationUrl(anchors: Map<string, string>) {
  for (const [label, href] of Array.from(anchors.entries())) {
    if (label.toLowerCase().startsWith("location:")) {
      return href;
    }
  }

  return "";
}

export function parseUsaClimbingEvents(html: string): OfficialEvent[] {
  const sectionPattern = /<li>\s*<a class="uk-accordion-title uk-accordion-title--event"[\s\S]*?<\/li>/gi;

  const events: OfficialEvent[] = [];
  let match: RegExpExecArray | null;

  while ((match = sectionPattern.exec(html)) !== null) {
    const segment = match[0];
    const title = normalizeWhitespace(stripTags(segment.match(/<h3>([^<]+)<\/h3>/i)?.[1] ?? ""));
    const dateAndLocation = normalizeWhitespace(
      stripTags(segment.match(/<h3 class="uk-text-light">([^<]+)<\/h3>/i)?.[1] ?? "").replace(
        /[\u2013\u2014-]/g,
        "\u2013"
      )
    );
    const dateMatch = dateAndLocation.match(/^([A-Za-z]+ \d{1,2}\u2013\d{1,2}, \d{4}) in (.+)$/);
    const disciplineMatch = title.match(/\(([^)]+)\)/);
    const disciplines = disciplineMatch?.[1]?.trim() ?? "";
    if (!disciplines.toLowerCase().includes("boulder")) {
      continue;
    }

    if (!dateMatch) {
      continue;
    }

    const parsedRange = parseNamedDateRange(dateMatch[1]);
    if (!parsedRange) {
      continue;
    }

    const location = dateMatch[2].trim();
    const anchors = extractAnchorHrefs(segment);
    const heroImageUrl = extractUsaClimbingHeroImage(segment);
    const locationUrl = findUsaClimbingLocationUrl(anchors);
    const infoSheetUrl = anchors.get("Info Sheet") ?? "";
    const registrationUrl = anchors.get("Athlete Registration") ?? "";
    const scheduleUrl = anchors.get("Schedule") ?? "";
    const resultsUrl = anchors.get("Registered Athletes/Results") ?? "";
    const officialEventUrl = infoSheetUrl || locationUrl || resultsUrl || scheduleUrl || USA_CLIMBING_NACS_URL;

    events.push({
      id: `nacs-${slugify(location)}-${parsedRange.start_date}`,
      title,
      series: "North American Cup Series",
      location,
      disciplines,
      description:
        "Part of the official North American Cup Series calendar. This event is published by USA Climbing and may include separate registration and schedule resources on the official event page.",
      source_name: "USA Climbing North American Cup Series",
      source_url: USA_CLIMBING_NACS_URL,
      official_event_url: officialEventUrl,
      official_registration_url: registrationUrl,
      official_schedule_url: scheduleUrl || infoSheetUrl || officialEventUrl,
      registration_opens_at: null,
      registration_closes_at: null,
      hero_image_url: heroImageUrl,
      ...parsedRange,
    });
  }

  return events;
}

function mergeOfficialEvents(primary: OfficialEvent[], secondary: OfficialEvent[]) {
  const merged = new Map<string, OfficialEvent>();

  [...primary, ...secondary].forEach((event) => {
    const key = `${event.start_date}:${slugify(event.location)}:${slugify(event.disciplines)}`;
    const existing = merged.get(key);
    if (!existing) {
      merged.set(key, event);
      return;
    }

    merged.set(key, {
      ...existing,
      description: existing.description || event.description,
      source_name: existing.source_name || event.source_name,
      source_url: existing.source_url || event.source_url,
      official_event_url: existing.official_event_url || event.official_event_url,
      official_registration_url: existing.official_registration_url || event.official_registration_url,
      official_schedule_url: existing.official_schedule_url || event.official_schedule_url,
      registration_opens_at: existing.registration_opens_at ?? event.registration_opens_at,
      registration_closes_at: existing.registration_closes_at ?? event.registration_closes_at,
      hero_image_url: existing.hero_image_url || event.hero_image_url,
    });
  });

  return Array.from(merged.values());
}

export async function fetchOfficialBoulderingEvents() {
  const [worldClimbingHtml, usaClimbingHtml] = await Promise.all([
    fetchSourceHtml(WORLD_CLIMBING_SOURCE_URL),
    fetchSourceHtml(USA_CLIMBING_NACS_URL),
  ]);

  return mergeOfficialEvents(parseWorldClimbingEvents(worldClimbingHtml), parseUsaClimbingEvents(usaClimbingHtml)).sort(
    (left, right) => left.start_date.localeCompare(right.start_date)
  );
}


--- src\lib\organizer-operations.test.ts ---

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { getOrganizerOperationsModel } from "@/lib/organizer-operations";
import {
  DEFAULT_COMPETITION,
  getRoundRuntimePhase,
  type Competition,
  type CompetitionCategory,
  type CompetitionRound,
  type CompetitionScheduleBlock,
  type FinalistSelection,
  type QualifierLeaderboardEntry,
} from "@/lib/scoring";

function category(id: string, displayName: string, sortOrder: number): CompetitionCategory {
  const [genderDivision, ageGroup] = displayName.split(" / ");
  return {
    id,
    competition_id: "comp",
    gender_division: genderDivision,
    age_group: ageGroup,
    display_name: displayName,
    sort_order: sortOrder,
  };
}

function round(
  id: string,
  roundType: CompetitionRound["round_type"],
  sortOrder: number,
  overrides: Partial<CompetitionRound> = {}
): CompetitionRound {
  const scoringBucket = roundType === "finals" ? "finals" : "qualifier";
  return {
    id,
    competition_id: "comp",
    round_number: sortOrder,
    sort_order: sortOrder,
    name: roundType === "semifinal" ? "Semifinal" : roundType === "finals" ? "Finals" : "Qualifier",
    round_type: roundType,
    format: roundType === "finals" ? "ifsc_finals_format" : "flash_format",
    status: "pending",
    runtime_phase: getRoundRuntimePhase(roundType),
    is_enabled: true,
    is_active: roundType === "qualifier",
    activated_at: null,
    problem_count: roundType === "finals" ? 4 : 6,
    counting_climbs: roundType === "finals" ? null : 6,
    finals_cutoff: roundType === "semifinal" ? null : 8,
    eligible_category_ids: [],
    advancement_source_round_id: null,
    advancement_cutoff: roundType === "finals" ? 8 : null,
    scoring_bucket: scoringBucket,
    scoring_config: {},
    started_at: null,
    closed_at: null,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

function block(
  id: string,
  roundId: string,
  label: string,
  isActive = false
): CompetitionScheduleBlock {
  return {
    id,
    competition_id: "comp",
    round_id: roundId,
    label,
    phase_type: "qualifier_round",
    audience_label: label,
    is_active: isActive,
    start_time: "9:00 AM",
    end_time: "10:00 AM",
    capacity: 50,
    eligible_category_ids: [],
  };
}

function competition(overrides: Partial<Competition> = {}): Competition {
  const categories = [
    category("cat-men-junior", "Men / Junior", 1),
    category("cat-women-junior", "Women / Junior", 2),
  ];
  const qualifier = round("round-qualifier", "qualifier", 1, { status: "active" });
  const finals = round("round-finals", "finals", 2, {
    advancement_source_round_id: qualifier.id,
  });

  return {
    ...DEFAULT_COMPETITION,
    id: "comp",
    slug: "comp",
    name: "Organizer Ops",
    format: "flash_format",
    current_phase: "qualifier_open",
    has_finals: true,
    finals_cutoff: 8,
    finals_eligible_age_groups: ["Junior"],
    categories,
    rounds: [qualifier, finals],
    schedule_blocks: [block("block-qualifier", qualifier.id, "Qualifier wave", true)],
    ...overrides,
  };
}

function leaderboardEntry(
  climberId: string,
  name: string,
  categoryEntry: CompetitionCategory,
  rank: number
): QualifierLeaderboardEntry {
  return {
    climber_id: climberId,
    name,
    climber_number: String(100 + rank),
    province: "QC",
    category_id: categoryEntry.id,
    display_category: categoryEntry.display_name,
    gender_division: categoryEntry.gender_division,
    age_group: categoryEntry.age_group,
    time_slot_id: "block-qualifier",
    total_score: 100 - rank,
    counting_climbs: [],
    all_climbs: [],
    topped_count: 6,
    zone_count: 6,
    counting_attempt_total: rank,
    overall_rank: rank,
    category_rank: rank,
  };
}

function finalist(
  climberId: string,
  name: string,
  categoryEntry: CompetitionCategory,
  rank: number
): FinalistSelection {
  return {
    climber_id: climberId,
    name,
    category_id: categoryEntry.id,
    display_category: categoryEntry.display_name,
    gender_division: categoryEntry.gender_division,
    age_group: categoryEntry.age_group,
    qualifier_rank: rank,
    advanced_with_tie: false,
    climbing_order: rank,
  };
}

function categoryLeaderboard(categoryEntry: CompetitionCategory, count: number) {
  return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) =>
    leaderboardEntry(`${categoryEntry.id}-${index + 1}`, `Athlete ${index + 1}`, categoryEntry, index + 1)
  );
}

describe("organizer operations model", () => {
  it("builds a qualifier-to-finals operation flow when there is no semifinal", () => {
    const comp = competition();
    const [men] = comp.categories;
    const model = getOrganizerOperationsModel({
      competition: comp,
      qualifierLeaderboard: categoryLeaderboard(men, 10),
      projectedFinalists: categoryLeaderboard(men, 8).map((entry) =>
        finalist(entry.climber_id, entry.name, men, entry.category_rank)
      ),
      canEditPhase: true,
    });

    expect(model.steps.map((step) => step.label)).toEqual([
      "Review qualifiers",
      "Lock qualifiers",
      "Advance finals",
      "Publish results",
    ]);
    expect(model.steps.find((step) => step.id === "lock-qualifiers")).toMatchObject({
      state: "available",
      action: "lockQualifiers",
    });
    expect(model.steps.find((step) => step.id === "advance-finals")?.disabledReason).toBe(
      "Lock qualifiers before advancing finalists."
    );
    expect(model.advancementPreview).toMatchObject({
      title: "Qualifiers -> Finals",
      cutoffLabel: "Top 8 per category",
      sourceStatusLabel: "Qualifiers live",
    });
    expect(model.advancementPreview?.rows[0]).toMatchObject({
      categoryName: "Men / Junior",
      qualifyingSlot: 8,
      athleteName: "Athlete 8",
      sourceRank: 8,
    });
  });

  it("shows qualifier-to-semifinal preview before semifinals open", () => {
    const base = competition();
    const [men] = base.categories;
    const qualifier = base.rounds![0];
    const semifinal = round("round-semifinal", "semifinal", 2, {
      advancement_source_round_id: qualifier.id,
      advancement_cutoff: 8,
    });
    const finals = round("round-finals", "finals", 3, {
      advancement_source_round_id: semifinal.id,
      advancement_cutoff: 8,
    });
    const comp = competition({
      rounds: [qualifier, semifinal, finals],
      schedule_blocks: [
        block("block-qualifier", qualifier.id, "Qualifier wave", true),
        block("block-semifinal", semifinal.id, "Semifinal round"),
      ],
    });
    const model = getOrganizerOperationsModel({
      competition: comp,
      qualifierLeaderboard: categoryLeaderboard(men, 9),
      canEditPhase: true,
    });

    expect(model.hasSemifinal).toBe(true);
    expect(model.steps.map((step) => step.label)).toEqual([
      "Review qualifiers",
      "Lock qualifiers",
      "Open semifinals",
      "Review semifinals",
      "Lock semifinals",
      "Advance finals",
      "Publish results",
    ]);
    expect(model.steps.find((step) => step.id === "open-semifinals")?.disabledReason).toBe("Lock qualifiers first.");
    expect(model.advancementPreview).toMatchObject({
      title: "Qualifiers -> Semifinals",
      projectedCountLabel: "8 projected to advance",
      sourceStatusLabel: "Qualifiers live",
    });
  });

  it("enables opening semifinals after qualifiers are locked", () => {
    const base = competition();
    const qualifier = base.rounds![0];
    const semifinal = round("round-semifinal", "semifinal", 2, {
      advancement_source_round_id: qualifier.id,
      advancement_cutoff: 8,
    });
    const finals = round("round-finals", "finals", 3, {
      advancement_source_round_id: semifinal.id,
      advancement_cutoff: 8,
    });
    const comp = competition({
      current_phase: "qualifier_closed",
      rounds: [qualifier, semifinal, finals],
      schedule_blocks: [
        block("block-qualifier", qualifier.id, "Qualifier wave", true),
        block("block-semifinal", semifinal.id, "Semifinal round"),
      ],
    });
    const model = getOrganizerOperationsModel({ competition: comp, canEditPhase: true });

    expect(model.qualifierLocked).toBe(true);
    expect(model.semifinalOpened).toBe(false);
    expect(model.steps.find((step) => step.id === "open-semifinals")).toMatchObject({
      state: "available",
      disabledReason: "",
    });
    expect(model.steps.find((step) => step.id === "advance-finals")?.disabledReason).toBe(
      "Lock semifinals before advancing finalists."
    );
  });

  it("switches the preview to semifinal-to-finals once semifinals are live", () => {
    const base = competition();
    const [men] = base.categories;
    const qualifier = base.rounds![0];
    const semifinal = round("round-semifinal", "semifinal", 2, {
      advancement_source_round_id: qualifier.id,
      advancement_cutoff: 8,
      status: "active",
      is_active: true,
      activated_at: "2026-05-04T12:00:00.000Z",
    });
    const finals = round("round-finals", "finals", 3, {
      advancement_source_round_id: semifinal.id,
      advancement_cutoff: 8,
    });
    const comp = competition({
      current_phase: "wall_reset",
      rounds: [{ ...qualifier, is_active: false, status: "closed" }, semifinal, finals],
      schedule_blocks: [
        block("block-qualifier", qualifier.id, "Qualifier wave"),
        block("block-semifinal", semifinal.id, "Semifinal round", true),
      ],
    });
    const projected = categoryLeaderboard(men, 8).map((entry) =>
      finalist(entry.climber_id, entry.name, men, entry.category_rank)
    );
    const model = getOrganizerOperationsModel({
      competition: comp,
      qualifierLeaderboard: categoryLeaderboard(men, 8),
      projectedFinalists: projected,
      canEditPhase: true,
    });

    expect(model.semifinalOpened).toBe(true);
    expect(model.semifinalLocked).toBe(false);
    expect(model.steps.find((step) => step.id === "lock-semifinals")).toMatchObject({
      state: "available",
      disabledReason: "",
    });
    expect(model.advancementPreview).toMatchObject({
      title: "Semifinals -> Finals",
      sourceStatusLabel: "Semifinals live",
    });
  });

  it("enables finals advancement only after semifinals are locked", () => {
    const base = competition();
    const [men] = base.categories;
    const qualifier = base.rounds![0];
    const semifinal = round("round-semifinal", "semifinal", 2, {
      advancement_source_round_id: qualifier.id,
      advancement_cutoff: 8,
      status: "active",
      activated_at: "2026-05-04T12:00:00.000Z",
    });
    const finals = round("round-finals", "finals", 3, {
      advancement_source_round_id: semifinal.id,
      advancement_cutoff: 8,
    });
    const comp = competition({
      current_phase: "qualifier_closed",
      rounds: [qualifier, semifinal, finals],
      schedule_blocks: [
        block("block-qualifier", qualifier.id, "Qualifier wave"),
        block("block-semifinal", semifinal.id, "Semifinal round", true),
      ],
    });
    const projected = categoryLeaderboard(men, 8).map((entry) =>
      finalist(entry.climber_id, entry.name, men, entry.category_rank)
    );
    const model = getOrganizerOperationsModel({
      competition: comp,
      projectedFinalists: projected,
      canEditPhase: true,
    });

    expect(model.semifinalLocked).toBe(true);
    expect(model.steps.find((step) => step.id === "advance-finals")).toMatchObject({
      state: "available",
      disabledReason: "",
    });
  });
});


--- src\lib\organizer-operations.ts ---

import {
  DEFAULT_FINALS_CUTOFF,
  compareCompetitionPhases,
  getRoundLabel,
  isFinalsEligibleCategory,
  type Competition,
  type CompetitionCategory,
  type CompetitionPhase,
  type CompetitionRound,
  type FinalistSelection,
  type QualifierLeaderboardEntry,
} from "@/lib/scoring";

export type OrganizerOperationAction =
  | "openLeaderboard"
  | "lockQualifiers"
  | "openSemifinals"
  | "lockSemifinals"
  | "advanceFinals"
  | "publishResults"
  | "openPublicResults";

export type OrganizerOperationState = "complete" | "available" | "locked";

export interface OrganizerOperationStep {
  id:
    | "review-qualifiers"
    | "lock-qualifiers"
    | "open-semifinals"
    | "review-semifinals"
    | "lock-semifinals"
    | "advance-finals"
    | "publish-results";
  label: string;
  description: string;
  statusLabel: string;
  actionLabel: string;
  action: OrganizerOperationAction;
  anchor: string;
  complete: boolean;
  state: OrganizerOperationState;
  disabledReason: string;
}

export interface AdvancementPreviewRow {
  categoryId: string | null;
  categoryName: string;
  cutoff: number;
  qualifyingSlot: number;
  projectedAdvancing: number;
  categorySize: number;
  athleteName: string | null;
  sourceRank: number | null;
  explanation: string | null;
}

export interface AdvancementPreview {
  title: string;
  sourceLabel: string;
  targetLabel: string;
  cutoffLabel: string;
  projectedCountLabel: string;
  sourceStatusLabel: string;
  emptyMessage: string;
  rows: AdvancementPreviewRow[];
}

export interface OrganizerOperationsModel {
  hasFinals: boolean;
  hasSemifinal: boolean;
  qualifierRound: CompetitionRound | null;
  semifinalRound: CompetitionRound | null;
  finalsRound: CompetitionRound | null;
  finalsAdvancementSourceRound: CompetitionRound | null;
  semifinalScheduleBlockId: string | null;
  qualifierLocked: boolean;
  semifinalOpened: boolean;
  semifinalLocked: boolean;
  finalsStarted: boolean;
  finalsLive: boolean;
  resultsPublished: boolean;
  currentSourceRound: CompetitionRound | null;
  nextTargetRound: CompetitionRound | null;
  activeScheduleLabel: string | null;
  overallStatusLabel: string;
  summary: string;
  steps: OrganizerOperationStep[];
  advancementPreview: AdvancementPreview | null;
}

export interface OrganizerOperationsInput {
  competition: Competition | null;
  qualifierLeaderboard?: QualifierLeaderboardEntry[];
  projectedFinalists?: FinalistSelection[];
  finalistsPersisted?: boolean;
  finalsScoresReady?: boolean;
  canEditPhase?: boolean;
}

type SourcePreviewEntry = {
  climberId: string;
  name: string;
  categoryId: string | null;
  displayCategory: string;
  genderDivision: string;
  ageGroup: string;
  sourceRank: number;
  sortRank: number;
};

type CategoryPreviewDefinition = {
  id: string | null;
  name: string;
  genderDivision: string;
  ageGroup: string;
  sortOrder: number;
};

function roundSort(left: CompetitionRound, right: CompetitionRound) {
  return left.sort_order - right.sort_order || left.round_number - right.round_number || left.name.localeCompare(right.name);
}

function orderedRounds(competition: Competition) {
  return [...(competition.rounds ?? [])].filter((round) => round.is_enabled).sort(roundSort);
}

function getRoundName(round: CompetitionRound | null, fallback: string) {
  if (!round) {
    return fallback;
  }

  return round.name?.trim() || getRoundLabel(round.round_type, Math.max(0, round.sort_order - 1));
}

function getPluralRoundName(round: CompetitionRound | null, fallback: string) {
  const roundType = round?.round_type;
  if (roundType === "semifinal") {
    return "Semifinals";
  }
  if (roundType === "finals") {
    return "Finals";
  }
  if (roundType === "qualifier") {
    return "Qualifiers";
  }

  return fallback;
}

function getAdvancementCutoff(competition: Competition, targetRound: CompetitionRound | null) {
  return targetRound?.advancement_cutoff ?? targetRound?.finals_cutoff ?? competition.finals_cutoff ?? DEFAULT_FINALS_CUTOFF;
}

function isCategoryEligibleForTarget(
  competition: Competition,
  targetRound: CompetitionRound | null,
  category: Pick<CompetitionCategory, "id" | "gender_division" | "age_group">
) {
  if (targetRound?.eligible_category_ids.length) {
    return targetRound.eligible_category_ids.includes(category.id);
  }

  return isFinalsEligibleCategory(competition, category.gender_division, category.age_group);
}

function categoryKey(
  entry: Pick<SourcePreviewEntry, "categoryId" | "displayCategory" | "genderDivision" | "ageGroup">
) {
  return entry.categoryId ?? `${entry.genderDivision}::${entry.ageGroup}::${entry.displayCategory}`;
}

function categoryDefinitionKey(category: CategoryPreviewDefinition) {
  return category.id ?? `${category.genderDivision}::${category.ageGroup}::${category.name}`;
}

function buildSourceEntriesFromLeaderboard(entries: QualifierLeaderboardEntry[]): SourcePreviewEntry[] {
  return entries.map((entry) => ({
    climberId: entry.climber_id,
    name: entry.name,
    categoryId: entry.category_id,
    displayCategory: entry.display_category,
    genderDivision: entry.gender_division,
    ageGroup: entry.age_group,
    sourceRank: entry.category_rank,
    sortRank: entry.category_rank || entry.overall_rank,
  }));
}

function buildSourceEntriesFromFinalistProjection(entries: FinalistSelection[]): SourcePreviewEntry[] {
  return entries.map((entry) => ({
    climberId: entry.climber_id,
    name: entry.name,
    categoryId: entry.category_id,
    displayCategory: entry.display_category,
    genderDivision: entry.gender_division,
    ageGroup: entry.age_group,
    sourceRank: entry.qualifier_rank,
    sortRank: entry.qualifier_rank,
  }));
}

function deriveCategoryDefinitions(
  competition: Competition,
  targetRound: CompetitionRound | null,
  sourceEntries: SourcePreviewEntry[]
) {
  const fromSetup = competition.categories
    .filter((category) => isCategoryEligibleForTarget(competition, targetRound, category))
    .map<CategoryPreviewDefinition>((category) => ({
      id: category.id,
      name: category.display_name,
      genderDivision: category.gender_division,
      ageGroup: category.age_group,
      sortOrder: category.sort_order,
    }));

  if (fromSetup.length) {
    return fromSetup.sort((left, right) => left.sortOrder - right.sortOrder || left.name.localeCompare(right.name));
  }

  const seen = new Set<string>();
  return sourceEntries
    .flatMap<CategoryPreviewDefinition>((entry, index) => {
      const key = categoryKey(entry);
      if (seen.has(key)) {
        return [];
      }
      seen.add(key);
      return [
        {
          id: entry.categoryId,
          name: entry.displayCategory,
          genderDivision: entry.genderDivision,
          ageGroup: entry.ageGroup,
          sortOrder: index,
        },
      ];
    })
    .sort((left, right) => left.name.localeCompare(right.name));
}

function buildPreviewRows({
  competition,
  targetRound,
  cutoff,
  sourceEntries,
}: {
  competition: Competition;
  targetRound: CompetitionRound | null;
  cutoff: number;
  sourceEntries: SourcePreviewEntry[];
}) {
  const sourceByCategory = new Map<string, SourcePreviewEntry[]>();
  sourceEntries.forEach((entry) => {
    const category = competition.categories.find((candidate) => candidate.id === entry.categoryId) ?? null;
    if (category && !isCategoryEligibleForTarget(competition, targetRound, category)) {
      return;
    }
    if (!category && !isFinalsEligibleCategory(competition, entry.genderDivision, entry.ageGroup)) {
      return;
    }

    const key = categoryKey(entry);
    const rows = sourceByCategory.get(key) ?? [];
    rows.push(entry);
    sourceByCategory.set(key, rows);
  });

  const categories = deriveCategoryDefinitions(
    competition,
    targetRound,
    Array.from(sourceByCategory.values()).flat()
  );

  return categories.map<AdvancementPreviewRow>((category) => {
    const rows = [...(sourceByCategory.get(categoryDefinitionKey(category)) ?? [])].sort(
      (left, right) =>
        left.sortRank - right.sortRank ||
        left.sourceRank - right.sourceRank ||
        left.name.localeCompare(right.name) ||
        left.climberId.localeCompare(right.climberId)
    );
    const categorySize = rows.length;
    const projectedAdvancing = Math.min(cutoff, categorySize);
    const qualifyingSlot = projectedAdvancing || cutoff;
    const cutoffEntry = projectedAdvancing ? rows[projectedAdvancing - 1] ?? null : null;
    const explanation =
      categorySize === 0
        ? "No scored athletes in this category yet."
        : categorySize < cutoff
          ? `Only ${categorySize} eligible ${categorySize === 1 ? "athlete has" : "athletes have"} scores, so everyone listed would advance.`
          : null;

    return {
      categoryId: category.id,
      categoryName: category.name,
      cutoff,
      qualifyingSlot,
      projectedAdvancing,
      categorySize,
      athleteName: cutoffEntry?.name ?? null,
      sourceRank: cutoffEntry?.sourceRank ?? null,
      explanation,
    };
  });
}

function sourceStatusLabel({
  sourceRound,
  qualifierLocked,
  semifinalOpened,
  semifinalLocked,
  finalsStarted,
  resultsPublished,
}: {
  sourceRound: CompetitionRound | null;
  qualifierLocked: boolean;
  semifinalOpened: boolean;
  semifinalLocked: boolean;
  finalsStarted: boolean;
  resultsPublished: boolean;
}) {
  if (resultsPublished) {
    return "Results published";
  }
  if (finalsStarted) {
    return "Finals live";
  }
  if (sourceRound?.round_type === "semifinal") {
    if (semifinalLocked) {
      return "Semifinals locked";
    }
    if (semifinalOpened) {
      return "Semifinals live";
    }
    return "Semifinals not open";
  }

  return qualifierLocked ? "Qualifiers locked" : "Qualifiers live";
}

function buildAdvancementPreview({
  competition,
  sourceRound,
  targetRound,
  qualifierLeaderboard,
  projectedFinalists,
  qualifierLocked,
  semifinalOpened,
  semifinalLocked,
  finalsStarted,
  resultsPublished,
}: {
  competition: Competition;
  sourceRound: CompetitionRound | null;
  targetRound: CompetitionRound | null;
  qualifierLeaderboard: QualifierLeaderboardEntry[];
  projectedFinalists: FinalistSelection[];
  qualifierLocked: boolean;
  semifinalOpened: boolean;
  semifinalLocked: boolean;
  finalsStarted: boolean;
  resultsPublished: boolean;
}) {
  if (!targetRound) {
    return null;
  }

  const sourceLabel = getPluralRoundName(sourceRound, "Qualifiers");
  const targetLabel = getPluralRoundName(targetRound, "Finals");
  const cutoff = getAdvancementCutoff(competition, targetRound);
  const sourceEntries =
    targetRound.round_type === "semifinal"
      ? buildSourceEntriesFromLeaderboard(qualifierLeaderboard)
      : buildSourceEntriesFromFinalistProjection(projectedFinalists);
  const rows = buildPreviewRows({ competition, targetRound, cutoff, sourceEntries });
  const projectedCount = rows.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.projectedAdvancing, 0);

  return {
    title: `${sourceLabel} -> ${targetLabel}`,
    sourceLabel,
    targetLabel,
    cutoffLabel: `Top ${cutoff} per category`,
    projectedCountLabel: projectedCount
      ? `${projectedCount} projected to advance`
      : `No athletes projected for ${targetLabel.toLowerCase()} yet`,
    sourceStatusLabel: sourceStatusLabel({
      sourceRound,
      qualifierLocked,
      semifinalOpened,
      semifinalLocked,
      finalsStarted,
      resultsPublished,
    }),
    emptyMessage: `Add scores in ${sourceLabel.toLowerCase()} to preview who advances to ${targetLabel.toLowerCase()}.`,
    rows,
  } satisfies AdvancementPreview;
}

function buildStep({
  id,
  label,
  description,
  statusLabel,
  actionLabel,
  action,
  anchor,
  complete,
  disabledReason,
}: Omit<OrganizerOperationStep, "state">): OrganizerOperationStep {
  return {
    id,
    label,
    description,
    statusLabel,
    actionLabel,
    action,
    anchor,
    complete,
    disabledReason,
    state: complete ? "complete" : disabledReason ? "locked" : "available",
  };
}

function hasStartedFinals(phase: CompetitionPhase) {
  return compareCompetitionPhases(phase, "finals_open") >= 0;
}

export function getOrganizerOperationsModel({
  competition,
  qualifierLeaderboard = [],
  projectedFinalists = [],
  finalistsPersisted = false,
  finalsScoresReady = finalistsPersisted,
  canEditPhase = false,
}: OrganizerOperationsInput): OrganizerOperationsModel {
  if (!competition) {
    return {
      hasFinals: false,
      hasSemifinal: false,
      qualifierRound: null,
      semifinalRound: null,
      finalsRound: null,
      finalsAdvancementSourceRound: null,
      semifinalScheduleBlockId: null,
      qualifierLocked: false,
      semifinalOpened: false,
      semifinalLocked: false,
      finalsStarted: false,
      finalsLive: false,
      resultsPublished: false,
      currentSourceRound: null,
      nextTargetRound: null,
      activeScheduleLabel: null,
      overallStatusLabel: "No event selected",
      summary: "Select an event to run organizer operations.",
      steps: [],
      advancementPreview: null,
    };
  }

  const rounds = orderedRounds(competition);
  const qualifierRound =
    rounds.find((round) => round.round_type === "qualifier" && round.scoring_bucket === "qualifier") ??
    rounds.find((round) => round.scoring_bucket === "qualifier") ??
    null;
  const semifinalRound =
    rounds.find((round) => round.round_type === "semifinal" && round.scoring_bucket === "qualifier") ?? null;
  const finalsRound =
    rounds.find((round) => round.round_type === "finals" || round.scoring_bucket === "finals") ?? null;
  const hasFinals = Boolean(competition.has_finals && finalsRound);
  const hasSemifinal = Boolean(semifinalRound);
  const finalsAdvancementSourceRound =
    (finalsRound?.advancement_source_round_id
      ? rounds.find((round) => round.id === finalsRound.advancement_source_round_id) ?? null
      : null) ??
    (hasSemifinal ? semifinalRound : qualifierRound);
  const activeScheduleBlock = competition.schedule_blocks.find((block) => block.is_active) ?? null;
  const activeBlockRound = activeScheduleBlock?.round_id
    ? rounds.find((round) => round.id === activeScheduleBlock.round_id) ?? null
    : null;
  const semifinalScheduleBlock =
    competition.schedule_blocks.find((block) => block.round_id === semifinalRound?.id) ?? null;
  const finalsStarted = hasStartedFinals(competition.current_phase);
  const finalsLive = competition.current_phase === "finals_open";
  const resultsPublished = competition.current_phase === "results";
  const qualifierLocked = compareCompetitionPhases(competition.current_phase, "qualifier_closed") >= 0;
  const semifinalOpened = Boolean(
    hasSemifinal &&
      (finalsStarted ||
        competition.current_phase === "wall_reset" ||
        activeBlockRound?.id === semifinalRound?.id ||
        semifinalRound?.activated_at ||
        (semifinalRound?.status && semifinalRound.status !== "pending"))
  );
  const semifinalLocked = Boolean(
    hasSemifinal &&
      semifinalOpened &&
      (finalsStarted || resultsPublished || competition.current_phase === "qualifier_closed")
  );
  const semifinalLive = Boolean(hasSemifinal && semifinalOpened && !semifinalLocked && !finalsStarted);
  const sourceForFinals = finalsAdvancementSourceRound ?? qualifierRound;
  const currentSourceRound =
    hasSemifinal && !semifinalOpened ? qualifierRound : sourceForFinals;
  const nextTargetRound = hasSemifinal && !semifinalOpened ? semifinalRound : finalsRound;
  const advancementPreview = hasFinals
    ? buildAdvancementPreview({
        competition,
        sourceRound: currentSourceRound,
        targetRound: nextTargetRound,
        qualifierLeaderboard,
        projectedFinalists,
        qualifierLocked,
        semifinalOpened,
        semifinalLocked,
        finalsStarted,
        resultsPublished,
      })
    : null;
  const projectedCount = advancementPreview?.rows.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.projectedAdvancing, 0) ?? projectedFinalists.length;
  const sourceName = getRoundName(currentSourceRound, "Qualifier");
  const sourceNameLower = sourceName.toLowerCase();
  const qualifierStandingsCount = qualifierLeaderboard.length;
  const canAdvanceFromSource = hasSemifinal ? semifinalLocked : qualifierLocked;

  const steps: OrganizerOperationStep[] = [
    buildStep({
      id: "review-qualifiers",
      label: "Review qualifiers",
      description: "Check qualifier standings before scores are frozen.",
      statusLabel: qualifierLocked ? "Reviewed" : qualifierStandingsCount ? `${qualifierStandingsCount} ranked` : "Open",
      actionLabel: "Open leaderboard",
      action: "openLeaderboard",
      anchor: "organizer-open-leaderboard",
      complete: qualifierLocked || qualifierStandingsCount > 0,
      disabledReason: "",
    }),
    buildStep({
      id: "lock-qualifiers",
      label: "Lock qualifiers",
      description: hasSemifinal
        ? "Freeze qualifier scoring before semifinals open."
        : "Freeze qualifier scoring before finalists are selected.",
      statusLabel: qualifierLocked ? "Locked" : "Open",
      actionLabel: "Lock qualifiers",
      action: "lockQualifiers",
      anchor: "organizer-lock-qualifiers",
      complete: qualifierLocked,
      disabledReason: !canEditPhase
        ? "Only admins can lock qualifier scoring."
        : qualifierLocked
          ? "Qualifier scoring is already locked."
          : competition.current_phase !== "qualifier_open"
            ? "Move the event to qualifier live before locking qualifiers."
            : "",
    }),
  ];

  if (hasSemifinal) {
    steps.push(
      buildStep({
        id: "open-semifinals",
        label: "Open semifinals",
        description: "Activate the semifinal scoring round and its linked schedule block.",
        statusLabel: semifinalOpened ? "Open" : "Waiting",
        actionLabel: "Open semifinals",
        action: "openSemifinals",
        anchor: "organizer-open-semifinals",
        complete: semifinalOpened,
        disabledReason: !canEditPhase
          ? "Only admins can open semifinals."
          : !qualifierLocked
            ? "Lock qualifiers first."
            : semifinalOpened
              ? "Semifinals are already open or complete."
              : !semifinalScheduleBlock
                ? "Add a schedule block linked to the semifinal round first."
                : "",
      }),
      buildStep({
        id: "review-semifinals",
        label: "Review semifinals",
        description: "Check semifinal standings before the finals field is created.",
        statusLabel: semifinalLocked
          ? "Reviewed"
          : semifinalLive && qualifierStandingsCount
            ? `${qualifierStandingsCount} ranked`
            : "Waiting",
        actionLabel: "Open leaderboard",
        action: "openLeaderboard",
        anchor: "organizer-review-semifinals",
        complete: semifinalLocked || (semifinalLive && qualifierStandingsCount > 0),
        disabledReason: !semifinalOpened ? "Open semifinals first." : "",
      }),
      buildStep({
        id: "lock-semifinals",
        label: "Lock semifinals",
        description: "Freeze semifinal scoring before finalists are selected.",
        statusLabel: semifinalLocked ? "Locked" : semifinalLive ? "Live" : "Waiting",
        actionLabel: "Lock semifinals",
        action: "lockSemifinals",
        anchor: "organizer-lock-semifinals",
        complete: semifinalLocked,
        disabledReason: !canEditPhase
          ? "Only admins can lock semifinal scoring."
          : !semifinalOpened
            ? "Open semifinals first."
            : semifinalLocked
              ? "Semifinal scoring is already locked."
              : competition.current_phase !== "wall_reset"
                ? "Semifinals must be live before they can be locked."
                : "",
      })
    );
  }

  steps.push(
    buildStep({
      id: "advance-finals",
      label: "Advance finals",
      description: `Create the finals field from ${sourceNameLower} rankings and open finals scoring.`,
      statusLabel: finalsStarted
        ? "Finals live"
        : projectedCount
          ? `${projectedCount} projected`
          : "Waiting",
      actionLabel: "Advance + start finals",
      action: "advanceFinals",
      anchor: "organizer-advance-finals",
      complete: finalsStarted,
      disabledReason: !canEditPhase
        ? "Only admins can advance and start finals."
        : !hasFinals
          ? "Finals are not enabled for this competition."
          : finalsStarted
            ? "Finals are already running or complete."
            : !canAdvanceFromSource
              ? hasSemifinal
                ? "Lock semifinals before advancing finalists."
                : "Lock qualifiers before advancing finalists."
              : !projectedCount
                ? `No athletes are projected to advance yet. Check eligibility, cutoff, and ${sourceNameLower} scores.`
                : "",
    }),
    buildStep({
      id: "publish-results",
      label: "Publish results",
      description: finalsScoresReady
        ? "Finish live scoring and show final standings publicly."
        : "Finish live scoring once finals attempts are ready.",
      statusLabel: resultsPublished ? "Published" : "Pending",
      actionLabel: resultsPublished ? "Open public results" : "Publish results",
      action: resultsPublished ? "openPublicResults" : "publishResults",
      anchor: "organizer-publish-results",
      complete: resultsPublished,
      disabledReason: !canEditPhase
        ? "Only admins can publish results."
        : resultsPublished
          ? ""
          : hasFinals && !finalsStarted
            ? "Advance and start finals first."
            : !hasFinals && !qualifierLocked
              ? "Lock qualifier scoring first."
              : "",
    })
  );

  const overallStatusLabel = resultsPublished
    ? "Results published"
    : finalsLive
      ? "Finals live"
      : finalsStarted
        ? "Finals running"
        : hasSemifinal
          ? semifinalLocked
            ? "Semifinals locked"
            : semifinalOpened
              ? "Semifinals live"
              : qualifierLocked
                ? "Qualifiers locked"
                : "Qualifiers live"
          : qualifierLocked
            ? "Qualifiers locked"
            : "Qualifiers live";

  const summary = hasSemifinal
    ? "Review qualifiers, lock qualifiers, open semifinals, lock semifinals, advance finals, then publish results."
    : hasFinals
      ? "Review qualifiers, lock qualifiers, advance and start finals, then publish results."
      : "Review qualifiers, lock scoring, then publish results.";

  return {
    hasFinals,
    hasSemifinal,
    qualifierRound,
    semifinalRound,
    finalsRound,
    finalsAdvancementSourceRound,
    semifinalScheduleBlockId: semifinalScheduleBlock?.id ?? null,
    qualifierLocked,
    semifinalOpened,
    semifinalLocked,
    finalsStarted,
    finalsLive,
    resultsPublished,
    currentSourceRound,
    nextTargetRound,
    activeScheduleLabel: activeScheduleBlock?.label ?? null,
    overallStatusLabel,
    summary,
    steps,
    advancementPreview,
  };
}


--- src\lib\scorecard-access.test.ts ---

import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  SCORECARD_ACCESS_TOKEN_KEY,
  clearScorecardAccessToken,
  readScorecardAccess,
  saveScorecardAccessToken,
} from "./scorecard-access";

class MemoryStorage {
  private values = new Map<string, string>();

  get length() {
    return this.values.size;
  }

  clear() {
    this.values.clear();
  }

  getItem(key: string) {
    return this.values.get(key) ?? null;
  }

  key(index: number) {
    return Array.from(this.values.keys())[index] ?? null;
  }

  removeItem(key: string) {
    this.values.delete(key);
  }

  setItem(key: string, value: string) {
    this.values.set(key, value);
  }
}

describe("scorecard access storage", () => {
  const originalWindow = (globalThis as { window?: Window & typeof globalThis }).window;

  beforeEach(() => {
    (globalThis as { window?: Window & typeof globalThis }).window = {
      sessionStorage: new MemoryStorage() as unknown as Storage,
      localStorage: new MemoryStorage() as unknown as Storage,
    } as Window & typeof globalThis;
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    if (originalWindow) {
      (globalThis as { window?: Window & typeof globalThis }).window = originalWindow;
      return;
    }

    delete (globalThis as { window?: Window & typeof globalThis }).window;
  });

  it("stores scorecard access per competition slug", () => {
    saveScorecardAccessToken("token-one", "spring-send");
    saveScorecardAccessToken("token-two", "granite-open");

    expect(readScorecardAccess("spring-send")).toEqual({
      token: "token-one",
      competitionSlug: "spring-send",
    });
    expect(window.sessionStorage.getItem("scorecard_access_spring-send")).not.toBeNull();
    expect(readScorecardAccess("granite-open")).toEqual({
      token: "token-two",
      competitionSlug: "granite-open",
    });
  });

  it("migrates the legacy scorecard key when the slug matches", () => {
    window.localStorage.setItem(
      SCORECARD_ACCESS_TOKEN_KEY,
      JSON.stringify({
        token: "legacy-token",
        competitionSlug: "spring-send",
      })
    );

    expect(readScorecardAccess("spring-send")).toEqual({
      token: "legacy-token",
      competitionSlug: "spring-send",
    });
    expect(window.localStorage.getItem(SCORECARD_ACCESS_TOKEN_KEY)).toBeNull();
    expect(window.sessionStorage.getItem("scorecard_access_spring-send")).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it("clears all scoped scorecard access tokens when requested", () => {
    saveScorecardAccessToken("token-one", "spring-send");
    saveScorecardAccessToken("token-two", "granite-open");

    clearScorecardAccessToken();

    expect(readScorecardAccess("spring-send")).toBeNull();
    expect(readScorecardAccess("granite-open")).toBeNull();
    expect(window.sessionStorage.length).toBe(0);
  });
});


--- src\lib\scorecard-access.ts ---

"use client";

export const SCORECARD_ACCESS_TOKEN_KEY = "scorecard_access_token";
export const SCORECARD_ACCESS_TOKEN_PREFIX = "scorecard_access_";

export interface SavedScorecardAccess {
  token: string;
  competitionSlug: string;
}

function getSessionStorage() {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") {
    return null;
  }

  return window.sessionStorage;
}

function getLegacyStorage() {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") {
    return null;
  }

  return window.localStorage;
}

function buildScorecardAccessKey(competitionSlug: string) {
  return `${SCORECARD_ACCESS_TOKEN_PREFIX}${competitionSlug}`;
}

function parseSavedScorecardAccess(raw: string | null) {
  if (!raw) {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as Partial<SavedScorecardAccess>;
    if (typeof parsed.token !== "string" || typeof parsed.competitionSlug !== "string") {
      return null;
    }

    return {
      token: parsed.token,
      competitionSlug: parsed.competitionSlug,
    };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function saveScorecardAccessToken(token: string, competitionSlug?: string) {
  const normalizedToken = token.trim();
  const normalizedSlug = competitionSlug?.trim() ?? "";
  const storage = getSessionStorage();
  if (!storage || !normalizedToken || !normalizedSlug) {
    return;
  }

  const payload: SavedScorecardAccess = {
    token: normalizedToken,
    competitionSlug: normalizedSlug,
  };

  storage.setItem(buildScorecardAccessKey(normalizedSlug), JSON.stringify(payload));
  getLegacyStorage()?.removeItem(SCORECARD_ACCESS_TOKEN_KEY);
}

export function readScorecardAccess(competitionSlug?: string) {
  const storage = getSessionStorage();
  if (!storage) {
    return null;
  }

  const normalizedSlug = competitionSlug?.trim() ?? "";
  if (normalizedSlug) {
    const scoped = parseSavedScorecardAccess(storage.getItem(buildScorecardAccessKey(normalizedSlug)));
    if (scoped) {
      return scoped;
    }
  }

  const legacyStorage = getLegacyStorage();
  const legacy = parseSavedScorecardAccess(legacyStorage?.getItem(SCORECARD_ACCESS_TOKEN_KEY) ?? null);
  if (legacy && (!normalizedSlug || legacy.competitionSlug === normalizedSlug)) {
    storage.setItem(buildScorecardAccessKey(legacy.competitionSlug), JSON.stringify(legacy));
    legacyStorage?.removeItem(SCORECARD_ACCESS_TOKEN_KEY);
    return legacy;
  }

  if (!normalizedSlug) {
    for (let index = 0; index < storage.length; index += 1) {
      const key = storage.key(index);
      if (!key?.startsWith(SCORECARD_ACCESS_TOKEN_PREFIX)) {
        continue;
      }

      const scoped = parseSavedScorecardAccess(storage.getItem(key));
      if (scoped) {
        return scoped;
      }
    }

    return null;
  }

  return null;
}

export function readScorecardAccessToken(competitionSlug?: string) {
  return readScorecardAccess(competitionSlug)?.token ?? "";
}

export function clearScorecardAccessToken(competitionSlug?: string) {
  const storage = getSessionStorage();
  const legacyStorage = getLegacyStorage();
  if (!storage) {
    return;
  }

  const normalizedSlug = competitionSlug?.trim() ?? "";
  if (normalizedSlug) {
    storage.removeItem(buildScorecardAccessKey(normalizedSlug));
    const legacy = parseSavedScorecardAccess(legacyStorage?.getItem(SCORECARD_ACCESS_TOKEN_KEY) ?? null);
    if (legacy?.competitionSlug === normalizedSlug) {
      legacyStorage?.removeItem(SCORECARD_ACCESS_TOKEN_KEY);
    }
    return;
  }

  const keysToRemove: string[] = [];
  for (let index = 0; index < storage.length; index += 1) {
    const key = storage.key(index);
    if (key?.startsWith(SCORECARD_ACCESS_TOKEN_PREFIX)) {
      keysToRemove.push(key);
    }
  }
  keysToRemove.forEach((key) => storage.removeItem(key));
  legacyStorage?.removeItem(SCORECARD_ACCESS_TOKEN_KEY);
}

    expect(phaseToStageMode("wall_reset")).toBe("qualifier");
  });

  it("defaults registration and self scoring to closed unless qualifier_open", () => {

    expect(
      canRegisterDuringCompetition({

      canRegisterDuringCompetition({

        { label: "Awards", phase_type: "results", start_time: "2:00 PM" },
      ])

  });

  it("only opens the live boulder queue during a live self-scored qualifier block", () => {

    scrambleCompetition.schedule_blocks = [
      {
        id: "block-1",
        competition_id: scrambleCompetition.id,
        label: "Morning Session",
        phase_type: "qualifier_round",
        audience_label: "Open Session",
        is_active: true,
        start_time: "9:00 AM",
        end_time: "12:00 PM",
        capacity: 50,
        eligible_category_ids: [],
      },
    ];

    expect(canUseLiveBoulderQueue(scrambleCompetition)).toBe(true);
    expect(getActiveQueueSessionBlock(scrambleCompetition)?.label).toBe("Morning Session");

    expect(
      canUseLiveBoulderQueue({
        ...scrambleCompetition,
        current_phase: "qualifier_closed",
      })
    ).toBe(false);

    expect(
      canUseLiveBoulderQueue({
        ...scrambleCompetition,
        format: "flash_format",
      })
    ).toBe(false);
  });

  it("reports results before live schedule state when results are published", () => {
    expect(
      getCompetitionLifecycleLabel({
        status: "active",
        current_phase: "results",
        start_date: "2026-05-10",
        end_date: "2026-05-10",
        schedule_blocks: [
          {
            phase_type: "qualifier_round",
            is_active: true,
          },
        ],
      })
    ).toBe("Results published");
  });

  it("formats date-only values without timezone day shifts", () => {
    expect(formatDateLabel("2026-05-10")).toContain("May");
    expect(formatDateLabel("2026-05-10")).toContain("10");
    expect(formatDateRange("2026-05-10", "2026-05-10")).toBe(formatDateLabel("2026-05-10"));
    expect(formatCompetitionDateBadge({ start_date: "2026-05-10", end_date: "2026-05-11" })).toEqual({
      month: "MAY",
      day: "10 - 11",
    });
  });
});

          round_type: "qualifier",
          format: "scramble",
          status: "active",
          runtime_phase: "qualifier_open",
          is_enabled: true,
          is_active: true,
          activated_at: null,
          problem_count: 30,
          counting_climbs: 6,
          finals_cutoff: null,
          eligible_category_ids: [],
          advancement_source_round_id: null,
          advancement_cutoff: null,
          scoring_bucket: "qualifier",
          scoring_config: {},
          started_at: null,

        },
      ]
    );

    expect(competition.schedule_blocks[0]?.round_id).toBe("round-qualifier");
    expect(competition.rounds?.[0]?.id).toBe("round-qualifier");
  });

  it("only offers registration blocks whose linked rounds are active for the current phase", () => {
    const competition = normalizeCompetition(

  it("realigns demo competition dates to the current timeline", () => {
    const now = new Date();
    const expectedToday = new Date(now);
    expectedToday.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

    const expectedUpcoming = new Date(now);
    expectedUpcoming.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    expectedUpcoming.setDate(expectedUpcoming.getDate() + 14);

    const liveDemo = normalizeCompetition({
      id: "comp-5",
      name: "Bridgeport Community Boulder Scramble",
      slug: "mock-rec-scramble-live",
      start_date: "2026-04-02",
      end_date: "2026-04-02",
      registration_closes_at: "2026-04-02T12:00:00.000Z",
    });

    const upcomingDemo = normalizeCompetition({
      id: "comp-6",
      name: "Quebec City Junior Boulder Championship",
      slug: "mock-flash-upcoming",
      start_date: "2026-04-09",
      end_date: "2026-04-10",
      registration_opens_at: "2026-04-04T12:00:00.000Z",
      registration_closes_at: "2026-04-08T12:00:00.000Z",
    });

    expect(liveDemo.start_date).toBe(expectedToday.toISOString().slice(0, 10));
    expect(liveDemo.end_date).toBe(expectedToday.toISOString().slice(0, 10));
    expect(new Date(liveDemo.registration_closes_at ?? "").getTime()).toBeGreaterThan(now.getTime());

    expect(upcomingDemo.start_date).toBe(expectedUpcoming.toISOString().slice(0, 10));
    expect(upcomingDemo.end_date).toBe(
      new Date(expectedUpcoming.getTime() + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString().slice(0, 10)
    );
    expect(new Date(upcomingDemo.registration_opens_at ?? "").getTime()).toBeGreaterThan(now.getTime());
  });
});

describe("leaderboard category defaults", () => {
  function displayEntry(input: {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    categoryId: string;
    category: string;
    rank: number;
    score: number;
  }): QualifierLeaderboardEntry {
    return {
      climber_id: input.id,
      name: input.name,
      climber_number: input.id.replace("climber-", ""),
      province: "NS",
      category_id: input.categoryId,
      display_category: input.category,
      gender_division: input.category.split(" / ")[0] ?? "",
      age_group: input.category.split(" / ")[1] ?? "",
      time_slot_id: null,
      total_score: input.score,
      counting_climbs: [],
      all_climbs: [],
      topped_count: input.score,
      zone_count: input.score,
      counting_attempt_total: 1,
      overall_rank: input.rank,
      category_rank: input.rank,
    };
  }

  it("sorts public leaderboard rows by category setup order before category rank", () => {
    const sorted = sortQualifierLeaderboardForDisplay(
      [
        displayEntry({ id: "climber-3", name: "Kai", categoryId: "women-youth-b", category: "Women / Youth B", rank: 1, score: 100 }),
        displayEntry({ id: "climber-1", name: "Jade", categoryId: "men-junior", category: "Men / Junior", rank: 1, score: 80 }),
        displayEntry({ id: "climber-2", name: "Liam", categoryId: "men-junior", category: "Men / Junior", rank: 2, score: 70 }),
        displayEntry({ id: "climber-4", name: "Owen", categoryId: "men-youth-d", category: "Men / Youth D", rank: 1, score: 90 }),
      ],
      [
        { id: "men-junior", sort_order: 1, display_name: "Men / Junior" },
        { id: "men-youth-d", sort_order: 2, display_name: "Men / Youth D" },
        { id: "women-youth-b", sort_order: 3, display_name: "Women / Youth B" },
      ]
    );

    expect(sorted.map((entry) => `${entry.display_category} #${entry.category_rank} ${entry.name}`)).toEqual([
      "Men / Junior #1 Jade",
      "Men / Junior #2 Liam",
      "Men / Youth D #1 Owen",
      "Women / Youth B #1 Kai",
    ]);
  });

  it("prefers the largest qualifier category and breaks ties by sort order", () => {
    const preferred = pickPreferredQualifierCategory(
      [
        { id: "youth-d", sort_order: 3, display_name: "Youth D" },
        { id: "open", sort_order: 1, display_name: "Open" },
        { id: "rec", sort_order: 2, display_name: "Rec" },
      ],
      [
        { category_id: "open" },
        { category_id: "open" },
        { category_id: "rec" },
        { category_id: "rec" },
      ]
    );

    expect(preferred).toBe("open");
  });

  it("falls back to the first ordered category when no qualifier scores exist yet", () => {
    const preferred = pickPreferredQualifierCategory(
      [
        { id: "youth-d", sort_order: 3, display_name: "Youth D" },
        { id: "open", sort_order: 1, display_name: "Open" },
      ],
      []
    );

    expect(preferred).toBe("open");
  });
});

describe("finalist selection", () => {
  function qualifierEntry(input: {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    rank: number;
    score: number;
    attempts: number;
  }): QualifierLeaderboardEntry {
    return {
      climber_id: input.id,
      name: input.name,
      climber_number: input.id.replace("climber-", ""),
      province: "NS",
      category_id: "Men::Open",
      display_category: "Men / Open",
      gender_division: "Men",
      age_group: "Open",
      time_slot_id: null,
      total_score: input.score,
      counting_climbs: [],
      all_climbs: [],
      topped_count: 10,
      zone_count: 10,
      counting_attempt_total: input.attempts,
      overall_rank: input.rank,
      category_rank: input.rank,
    };
  }

  const tiedCutLineEntries = [
    qualifierEntry({ id: "climber-1", name: "Athlete 1", rank: 1, score: 100, attempts: 10 }),
    qualifierEntry({ id: "climber-2", name: "Athlete 2", rank: 2, score: 90, attempts: 10 }),
    qualifierEntry({ id: "climber-3", name: "Athlete 3", rank: 3, score: 80, attempts: 10 }),
    qualifierEntry({ id: "climber-4", name: "Athlete 4", rank: 4, score: 70, attempts: 10 }),
    qualifierEntry({ id: "climber-5", name: "Athlete 5", rank: 5, score: 60, attempts: 10 }),
    qualifierEntry({ id: "climber-6", name: "Athlete 6", rank: 6, score: 50, attempts: 10 }),
    qualifierEntry({ id: "climber-7", name: "Athlete 7", rank: 6, score: 50, attempts: 10 }),
    qualifierEntry({ id: "climber-8", name: "Athlete 8", rank: 8, score: 40, attempts: 10 }),
  ];

  it("keeps a shared cut-line rank to the row cutoff when tie advancement is disabled", () => {
    const competition = normalizeCompetition({
      id: "comp-finalists-no-ties",
      slug: "comp-finalists-no-ties",
      name: "No Tie Advances",
      format: "five_on_five_off",
      finals_cutoff: 6,
      finals_tie_advances: false,
      finals_eligible_age_groups: ["Open"],
    });

    const finalists = pickFinalists(tiedCutLineEntries, competition);

    expect(finalists.map((finalist) => finalist.climber_id)).toEqual([
      "climber-1",
      "climber-2",
      "climber-3",
      "climber-4",
      "climber-5",
      "climber-6",
    ]);
    expect(finalists).toHaveLength(6);
    expect(finalists.some((finalist) => finalist.advanced_with_tie)).toBe(false);
  });

  it("adds equal cut-line athletes beyond the row cutoff when tie advancement is enabled", () => {
    const competition = normalizeCompetition({
      id: "comp-finalists-with-ties",
      slug: "comp-finalists-with-ties",
      name: "Tie Advances",
      format: "five_on_five_off",
      finals_cutoff: 6,
      finals_tie_advances: true,
      finals_eligible_age_groups: ["Open"],
    });

    const finalists = pickFinalists(tiedCutLineEntries, competition);

    expect(finalists.map((finalist) => finalist.climber_id)).toEqual([
      "climber-1",
      "climber-2",
      "climber-3",
      "climber-4",
      "climber-5",
      "climber-6",
      "climber-7",
    ]);
    expect(finalists.at(-1)).toMatchObject({
      climber_id: "climber-7",
      advanced_with_tie: true,
    });
  });
});

export const DEFAULT_TOTAL_CLIMBS = 30;

export const FINAL_TOP_POINTS = 25;
export const FINAL_ZONE_POINTS = 10;
export const FINAL_ATTEMPT_DEDUCTION = 0.1;
export const CLIMBER_NUMBER_PATTERN = /^\d{1,4}$/;

export const COMPETITION_STATUSES = ["active", "archived"] as const;
export const EVENT_FORMATS = [
  "scramble",
  "five_on_five_off",
  "flash_format",
  "ifsc_finals_format",
] as const;
export const COMPETITION_PHASES = [
  "qualifier_open",
  "qualifier_closed",
  "wall_reset",
  "observation",
  "finals_open",
  "finals_closed",
  "results",
] as const;
export const SCHEDULE_PHASE_TYPES = [
  "check_in",
  "technical_meeting",
  "isolation",
  "qualifier_round",
  "wall_reset",
  "observation",
  "finals_round",
  "results",
  "custom",
] as const;
export const CATEGORY_DIVISIONS = ["Men", "Women", "X"] as const;

  "Youth D",

] as const;

export type CompetitionStatus = (typeof COMPETITION_STATUSES)[number];
export type EventFormat = (typeof EVENT_FORMATS)[number];
export type CompetitionPhase = (typeof COMPETITION_PHASES)[number];
export type StageMode = "qualifier" | "finals";

export type FinalEnteredBy = "staff";

}

}

export interface CompetitionScheduleBlock {
  id: string;
  competition_id: string;
  round_id?: string | null;
  sort_order?: number;

export type CompetitionLifecycleLabel = "Live / Ongoing" | "Results published" | "Upcoming" | "Future" | "Past";

export function createCategoryKey(genderDivision: string, ageGroup: string) {
  return `${genderDivision}::${ageGroup}`;
}

export function slugifyCompetitionName(value: string) {
  const normalized = value
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "");

  return normalized || "competition";
}

export function buildCompetitionPath(slug: string, section?: "" | "register" | "scorecard" | "leaderboard") {
  const cleanSlug = slug.trim();
  if (!section) {
    return `/c/${cleanSlug}`;
  }

  return `/c/${cleanSlug}/${section}`;
}

export function buildDisplayPath(slug: string) {
  return `/c/${slug.trim()}/display`;
}

export function buildStaffCompetitionPath(slug: string, section?: "" | "judge" | "preflight") {
  const cleanSlug = slug.trim();
  if (!section) {
    return `/staff/c/${cleanSlug}`;
  }

  return `/staff/c/${cleanSlug}/${section}`;
}

export function buildDisplayCategory(genderDivision: string, ageGroup: string) {
  return [genderDivision.trim(), ageGroup.trim()].filter(Boolean).join(" / ") || "Open";
}

export function getRoundStatusForCompetition(competition: Pick<Competition, "current_phase">, roundType: "qualifier" | "finals") {
  if (roundType === "qualifier") {
    switch (competition.current_phase) {
      case "qualifier_open":
        return "active" as const;
      case "qualifier_closed":
      case "wall_reset":
      case "observation":
      case "finals_open":
      case "finals_closed":
      case "results":
        return "closed" as const;
      default:
        return "pending" as const;
    }
  }

  switch (competition.current_phase) {
    case "observation":
      return "scoring" as const;
    case "finals_open":
      return "active" as const;
    case "finals_closed":
      return "closed" as const;
    case "results":
      return "results" as const;
    default:
      return "pending" as const;
  }
}

export function createCompetitionId() {
  if (typeof crypto !== "undefined" && typeof crypto.randomUUID === "function") {
    return crypto.randomUUID();
  }

  return `competition-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
}

export function getDefaultCompetitionCategories(competitionId: string): CompetitionCategory[] {
  return CATEGORY_DIVISIONS.flatMap((division, divisionIndex) =>
    CATEGORY_AGE_GROUPS.map((ageGroup, ageIndex) => ({
      id: createCategoryKey(division, ageGroup),
      competition_id: competitionId,
      gender_division: division,
      age_group: ageGroup,
      display_name: buildDisplayCategory(division, ageGroup),
      sort_order: divisionIndex * CATEGORY_AGE_GROUPS.length + ageIndex,
    }))
  );
}

const DAY = 24 * HOUR;
