create or replace function public.submit_qualifier_attempt(
  p_access_token text,
  p_competition_id uuid,
  p_climb_number integer,
  p_attempt_count integer,
  p_topped boolean
)
returns public.qualifier_attempts
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_climber public.climbers;
  v_attempt public.qualifier_attempts;
begin
  if not public.qualifier_self_scoring_open_for_competition(p_competition_id) then
    raise exception 'Qualifier self-scoring is not open for this competition';
  end if;

  select *
  into v_climber
  from public.climbers
  where access_token = trim(p_access_token)
    and competition_id = p_competition_id
  limit 1;

  if v_climber.id is null then
    raise exception 'Private qualifier link not recognized';
  end if;

  insert into public.qualifier_attempts (
    competition_id,
    climber_id,
    climb_number,
    attempt_count,
    zone,
    topped,
    attempts_to_top,
    attempts_to_zone,
    entered_by
  )
  values (
    p_competition_id,
    v_climber.id,
    p_climb_number,
    greatest(p_attempt_count, 0),
    p_topped,
    p_topped,
    case when p_topped then greatest(p_attempt_count, 1) else null end,
    case when p_topped then greatest(p_attempt_count, 1) else null end,
    'climber'
  )
  on conflict (climber_id, climb_number) do update
  set
    attempt_count = excluded.attempt_count,
    zone = excluded.zone,
    topped = excluded.topped,
    attempts_to_top = excluded.attempts_to_top,
    attempts_to_zone = excluded.attempts_to_zone,
    entered_by = 'climber',
    updated_at = now()
  returning *
  into v_attempt;

  return v_attempt;
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.advance_competition_to_finals(p_competition_id uuid)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_competition public.competitions;
begin
  if not public.is_admin() then
    raise exception 'Only admins can advance a competition to finals';
  end if;

  select *
  into v_competition
  from public.competitions
  where id = p_competition_id
  for update;

  if v_competition.id is null then
    raise exception 'Competition not found';
  end if;

  if v_competition.stage_mode <> 'qualifier' then
    raise exception 'Competition is not in qualifiers';
  end if;

  delete from public.final_attempts where competition_id = p_competition_id;
  delete from public.competition_finalists where competition_id = p_competition_id;

  with climber_scores as (
    select
      c.id as climber_id,
      c.name,
      c.category_id,
      c.display_category,
      c.gender_division,
      c.age_group,
      q.climb_number,
      q.attempt_count,
      coalesce(q.zone, q.topped, false) as zone,
      q.topped,
      q.attempts_to_top,
      q.attempts_to_zone,
      case
        when v_competition.format = 'flash_format'
          then greatest(
            case
              when q.topped then greatest(0::numeric, 25 - (greatest(coalesce(q.attempts_to_top, q.attempt_count, 1), 1) - 1) * 0.1)
              else 0::numeric
            end,
            case
              when coalesce(q.zone, q.topped, false)
                then greatest(0::numeric, 10 - (greatest(coalesce(q.attempts_to_zone, q.attempts_to_top, q.attempt_count, 1), 1) - 1) * 0.1)
              else 0::numeric
            end
          )
        when q.topped
          then greatest(0, q.climb_number * 1000 - least(greatest(q.attempt_count - 1, 0), 3) * 200)
        else 0::numeric
      end as score
    from public.climbers c
    left join public.qualifier_attempts q on q.climber_id = c.id
    where c.competition_id = p_competition_id
  ),
  counting_scores as (
    select *
    from (
      select
        climber_scores.*,
        row_number() over (
          partition by climber_id
          order by score desc, climb_number desc, attempt_count asc
        ) as score_row
      from climber_scores
      where score > 0::numeric
    ) ranked_scores
    where score_row <= case
      when v_competition.format = 'flash_format' then v_competition.total_climbs
      else v_competition.qualifier_counting_climbs
    end
  ),
  qualifier_totals as (
    select
      c.id as climber_id,
      c.name,
      c.category_id,
      c.display_category,
      c.gender_division,
      c.age_group,
      coalesce(sum(cs.score), 0::numeric) as total_score,
      coalesce(count(*) filter (where cs.topped), 0) as topped_count,
      coalesce(count(*) filter (where cs.zone), 0) as zone_count,
      coalesce(
        sum(
          case
            when cs.topped then greatest(coalesce(cs.attempts_to_top, cs.attempt_count, 0), 0)
            when cs.zone then greatest(coalesce(cs.attempts_to_zone, cs.attempt_count, 0), 0)
            else greatest(coalesce(cs.attempt_count, 0), 0)
          end
        ),
        0
      ) as counting_attempt_total
    from public.climbers c
    left join counting_scores cs on cs.climber_id = c.id
    where c.competition_id = p_competition_id
    group by c.id, c.name, c.category_id, c.display_category, c.gender_division, c.age_group
  ),
  ranked as (
    select
      qualifier_totals.*,
      row_number() over (
        partition by category_id
        order by total_score desc, topped_count desc, zone_count desc, counting_attempt_total asc, name asc
      ) as category_rank
    from qualifier_totals
    where gender_division in ('Men', 'Women')
      and age_group in (
        select jsonb_array_elements_text(v_competition.finals_eligible_age_groups)
      )
  ),
  cutoff as (
    select
      category_id,
      total_score,
      topped_count,
      zone_count,
      counting_attempt_total
    from ranked
    where category_rank = v_competition.finals_cutoff
  )
  insert into public.competition_finalists (
    competition_id,
    climber_id,
    name,
    category_id,
    display_category,
    gender_division,
    age_group,
    qualifier_rank,
    advanced_with_tie
  )
  select
    p_competition_id,
    ranked.climber_id,
    ranked.name,
    ranked.category_id,
    ranked.display_category,
    ranked.gender_division,
    ranked.age_group,
    ranked.category_rank,
    ranked.category_rank > v_competition.finals_cutoff
  from ranked
  left join cutoff using (category_id)
  where ranked.category_rank <= v_competition.finals_cutoff
     or (
       v_competition.finals_tie_advances
       and cutoff.category_id is not null
       and ranked.category_rank > v_competition.finals_cutoff
       and ranked.total_score = cutoff.total_score
       and ranked.topped_count = cutoff.topped_count
       and ranked.zone_count = cutoff.zone_count
       and ranked.counting_attempt_total = cutoff.counting_attempt_total
     );

  update public.competitions
  set
    format = 'ifsc_finals_format',
    stage_mode = 'finals',
    qualifier_locked_at = now(),
    finals_started_at = now(),
    finals_problem_count = 4
  where id = p_competition_id;
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.reset_competition(p_competition_id uuid)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
begin
  if not public.is_admin() then
    raise exception 'Only admins can reset a competition';
  end if;

  delete from public.final_attempts where competition_id = p_competition_id;
  delete from public.competition_finalists where competition_id = p_competition_id;
  delete from public.qualifier_attempts where competition_id = p_competition_id;
  delete from public.climbers where competition_id = p_competition_id;
  delete from public.competition_schedule_blocks where competition_id = p_competition_id;
  delete from public.competition_categories where competition_id = p_competition_id;

  insert into public.competition_categories (
    id,
    competition_id,
    gender_division,
    age_group,
    display_name,
    sort_order
  )
  select
    division || '::' || age_group,
    p_competition_id,
    division,
    age_group,
    division || ' / ' || age_group,
    row_number() over (order by division, age_group) - 1
  from (
    values ('Men'), ('Women'), ('X')
  ) as divisions(division)
  cross join (
    values ('Youth D'), ('Youth C'), ('Youth B'), ('Youth A'), ('Junior'), ('Rec'), ('Masters'), ('Open')
  ) as ages(age_group);

  update public.competitions
  set
    format = 'scramble',
    stage_mode = 'qualifier',
    total_climbs = 30,
    max_climbers = 80,
    qualifier_counting_climbs = 6,
    finals_cutoff = 6,
    finals_tie_advances = true,
    qualifier_eligible_age_groups = '["Youth D","Youth C","Youth B","Youth A","Junior","Rec","Masters","Open"]'::jsonb,
    finals_eligible_age_groups = '["Open"]'::jsonb,
    qualifier_locked_at = null,
    finals_started_at = null,
    finals_problem_count = 4
  where id = p_competition_id;
end;
$$;

--- supabase-seed.sql ---

do $$
begin
  if to_regclass('public.competitions') is null then
    raise exception 'Missing multi-competition schema. Run supabase-repair.sql or supabase-schema.sql first.';
  end if;

  if to_regclass('public.final_attempts') is not null then
    execute 'delete from public.final_attempts';
  end if;
  if to_regclass('public.competition_finalists') is not null then
    execute 'delete from public.competition_finalists';
  end if;
  if to_regclass('public.qualifier_attempts') is not null then
    execute 'delete from public.qualifier_attempts';
  end if;
  if to_regclass('public.climbers') is not null then
    execute 'delete from public.climbers';
  end if;
  if to_regclass('public.competition_schedule_blocks') is not null then
    execute 'delete from public.competition_schedule_blocks';
  end if;
  if to_regclass('public.competition_categories') is not null then
    execute 'delete from public.competition_categories';
  end if;

  execute 'delete from public.competitions';
end $$;

  );

insert into public.competition_categories (
  id,

select

  inserted_competitions.id,
  division,

  division || ' / ' || age_group,
  row_number() over (partition by inserted_competitions.id order by division, age_group) - 1
from inserted_competitions
cross join (values ('Men'), ('Women'), ('X')) as divisions(division)
cross join (values ('Youth D'), ('Youth C'), ('Youth B'), ('Youth A'), ('Junior'), ('Rec'), ('Masters'), ('Open')) as ages(age_group);

insert into public.competition_schedule_blocks (

select

with competition_map as (
  select id, slug from public.competitions
),
athletes as (
  select
    series.n as athlete_number,
    case when series.n <= 40 then 'test-rec-scramble' else 'test-youth-finals' end as competition_slug,
    case ((series.n * 7) % 15)
      when 0 then 'Alex' when 1 then 'Jordan' when 2 then 'Taylor'
      when 3 then 'Morgan' when 4 then 'Riley' when 5 then 'Casey'
      when 6 then 'Skyler' when 7 then 'Avery' when 8 then 'Quinn'
      when 9 then 'Parker' when 10 then 'Jamie' when 11 then 'Drew'
      when 12 then 'Reese' when 13 then 'Cameron' else 'Blake'
    end || ' ' ||
    case ((series.n * 11) % 10)
      when 0 then 'Stone' when 1 then 'Reid' when 2 then 'Cruz'
      when 3 then 'Chen' when 4 then 'Roy' when 5 then 'Sato'
      when 6 then 'Lopez' when 7 then 'Singh' when 8 then 'Bennett'
      else 'Nguyen'
    end || ' ' || series.n as athlete_name,
    case ((series.n * 13) % 13)
      when 0 then 'AB' when 1 then 'BC' when 2 then 'MB'
      when 3 then 'NB' when 4 then 'NL' when 5 then 'NS'
      when 6 then 'NT' when 7 then 'NU' when 8 then 'ON'
      when 9 then 'PE' when 10 then 'QC' when 11 then 'SK' else 'YT'
    end as province,
    case when series.n <= 40 then 'Rec' else
      (array['Youth D','Youth C','Youth B','Youth A','Junior'])[((series.n % 5) + 1)]
    end as age_group,
    case when (series.n % 2) = 0 then 'Men' else 'Women' end as gender_division
  from generate_series(1, 100) as series(n)
),
inserted_climbers as (
  insert into public.climbers (
    competition_id,
    name,
    climber_number,
    province,
    category_id,
    gender_division,
    age_group,
    display_category,
    access_token
  )
  select
    competition_map.id,
    athletes.athlete_name,
    lpad(athletes.athlete_number::text, 3, '0'),
    athletes.province,
    athletes.gender_division || '::' || athletes.age_group,
    athletes.gender_division,
    athletes.age_group,
    athletes.gender_division || ' / ' || athletes.age_group,
    'test-link-' || lpad(athletes.athlete_number::text, 3, '0')
  from athletes
  join competition_map on competition_map.slug = athletes.competition_slug
  returning id, competition_id, climber_number
)
insert into public.qualifier_attempts (
  competition_id,
  climber_id,
  climb_number,
  attempt_count,
  zone,
  topped,
  attempts_to_top,
  attempts_to_zone,
  entered_by
)
select
  inserted_climbers.competition_id,
  inserted_climbers.id,
  climbs.climb_number,
  1 + ((inserted_climbers.climber_number::int * climbs.climb_number) % 4),
  true,
  ((inserted_climbers.climber_number::int + climbs.climb_number) % 3) <> 0,
  case
    when ((inserted_climbers.climber_number::int + climbs.climb_number) % 3) <> 0
      then 1 + ((inserted_climbers.climber_number::int * 5 + climbs.climb_number) % 4)
    else null
  end,
  1 + ((inserted_climbers.climber_number::int * 7 + climbs.climb_number) % 4),
  case when climbs.climb_number <= 8 then 'climber' else 'staff' end
from inserted_climbers
cross join generate_series(1, 20) as climbs(climb_number)
where climbs.climb_number <= 5 + ((inserted_climbers.climber_number::int * 3) % 16);

delete from public.final_attempts
where competition_id = (select id from public.competitions where slug = 'test-youth-finals');

delete from public.competition_finalists
where competition_id = (select id from public.competitions where slug = 'test-youth-finals');

with target as (
  select *
  from public.competitions
  where slug = 'test-youth-finals'
),
climber_scores as (
  select
    c.id as climber_id,
    c.name,
    c.category_id,
    c.display_category,
    c.gender_division,
    c.age_group,
    q.climb_number,
    q.attempt_count,
    q.zone,
    q.topped,
    q.attempts_to_top,
    q.attempts_to_zone,
    case
      when (select format from target) = 'flash_format' or (select format from target) = 'five_on_five_off'
        then greatest(
          case
            when q.topped then greatest(0::numeric, 25 - (greatest(coalesce(q.attempts_to_top, q.attempt_count, 1), 1) - 1) * 0.1)
            else 0::numeric
          end,
          case
            when coalesce(q.zone, q.topped, false)
              then greatest(0::numeric, 10 - (greatest(coalesce(q.attempts_to_zone, q.attempts_to_top, q.attempt_count, 1), 1) - 1) * 0.1)
            else 0::numeric
          end
        )
      when q.topped
        then greatest(0::numeric, q.climb_number * 1000 - least(greatest(q.attempt_count - 1, 0), 3) * 200)
      else 0::numeric
    end as score
  from public.climbers c
  join target on target.id = c.competition_id
  left join public.qualifier_attempts q on q.climber_id = c.id
),
counting_scores as (
  select *
  from (
    select
      climber_scores.*,
      row_number() over (
        partition by climber_id
        order by score desc, climb_number desc, attempt_count asc
      ) as score_row
    from climber_scores
    where score > 0::numeric
  ) ranked_scores
  where score_row <= case
    when (select format from target) = 'flash_format' or (select format from target) = 'five_on_five_off'
      then (select total_climbs from target)
    else (select qualifier_counting_climbs from target)
  end
),
qualifier_totals as (
  select
    c.id as climber_id,
    c.name,
    c.category_id,
    c.display_category,
    c.gender_division,
    c.age_group,
    coalesce(sum(cs.score), 0::numeric) as total_score,
    coalesce(count(*) filter (where cs.topped), 0) as topped_count,
    coalesce(count(*) filter (where cs.zone), 0) as zone_count,
    coalesce(
      sum(
        case
          when cs.topped then greatest(coalesce(cs.attempts_to_top, cs.attempt_count, 0), 0)
          when cs.zone then greatest(coalesce(cs.attempts_to_zone, cs.attempt_count, 0), 0)
          else greatest(coalesce(cs.attempt_count, 0), 0)
        end
      ),
      0
    ) as counting_attempt_total
  from public.climbers c
  join target on target.id = c.competition_id
  left join counting_scores cs on cs.climber_id = c.id
  group by c.id, c.name, c.category_id, c.display_category, c.gender_division, c.age_group
),
ranked as (
  select
    qualifier_totals.*,
    row_number() over (
      partition by category_id
      order by total_score desc, topped_count desc, zone_count desc, counting_attempt_total asc, name asc
    ) as category_rank
  from qualifier_totals
  where gender_division in ('Men', 'Women')
    and age_group in (
      select jsonb_array_elements_text((select finals_eligible_age_groups from target))
    )
),
cutoff as (
  select
    category_id,
    total_score,
    topped_count,
    zone_count,
    counting_attempt_total
  from ranked
  where category_rank = (select finals_cutoff from target)
)
insert into public.competition_finalists (
  competition_id,
  climber_id,
  name,
  category_id,
  display_category,
  gender_division,
  age_group,
  qualifier_rank,
  advanced_with_tie
)
select
  target.id,
  ranked.climber_id,
  ranked.name,
  ranked.category_id,
  ranked.display_category,
  ranked.gender_division,
  ranked.age_group,
  ranked.category_rank,
  ranked.category_rank > target.finals_cutoff
from ranked
cross join target
left join cutoff using (category_id)
where ranked.category_rank <= target.finals_cutoff
   or (
     target.finals_tie_advances
     and cutoff.category_id is not null
     and ranked.category_rank > target.finals_cutoff
     and ranked.total_score = cutoff.total_score
     and ranked.topped_count = cutoff.topped_count
     and ranked.zone_count = cutoff.zone_count
     and ranked.counting_attempt_total = cutoff.counting_attempt_total
   );

update public.competitions
set
  format = 'ifsc_finals_format',
  stage_mode = 'finals',
  qualifier_locked_at = now(),
  finals_started_at = now(),
  finals_problem_count = 4
where slug = 'test-youth-finals';

update public.competition_schedule_blocks
set
  label = 'Finals live',
  phase_type = 'finals_round'
where competition_id = (select id from public.competitions where slug = 'test-youth-finals');

insert into public.final_attempts (
  competition_id,
  climber_id,
  climb_number,
  top,
  zone,
  attempts_to_top,
  attempts_to_zone,
  entered_by
)
select
  finalists.competition_id,
  finalists.climber_id,
  climbs.climb_number,
  ((finalists.qualifier_rank + climbs.climb_number) % 3) <> 0,
  true,
  1 + ((finalists.qualifier_rank + climbs.climb_number) % 4),
  1 + ((finalists.qualifier_rank + climbs.climb_number) % 5),
  'staff'
from public.competition_finalists finalists
cross join generate_series(1, 4) as climbs(climb_number);
